jobs.description:
About Merlin:

Merlin (NASDAQ: MRLN) is a publicly traded aerospace and defense company building a non-human pilot to deliver full-stack autonomy for any aircraft from takeoff to touchdown. The Merlin Pilot autonomy system powers a growing range of aircraft and mission profiles and has been proven through hundreds of autonomous flights from Merlin's global flight test facilities, including Kerikeri, New Zealand; Quonset Point, Rhode Island; and soon, Bedford, Massachusetts. Headquartered in Boston, Merlin is expanding its organization to accelerate the development and deployment of its autonomy platform, helping customers solve some of aviation's most pressing challenges, from pilot shortages to improving flight safety. Backed by some of the world's leading investors prior to its public listing, Merlin continues to advance the certification and commercialization of autonomous flight across commercial and defense aviation.

About You:

This role pairs deep, personal expertise in civil certification with the people leadership needed to manage two additional, interdependent certification disciplines: military airworthiness and cyber security certification. You are a proven certification leader with extensive, hands-on experience managing complex civil certification programs through FAA Part 23 and Part 25, EASA CS-23 and CS-25, and foreign validations. You also bring working experience in military airworthiness through MIL-HDBK-516C and MIL-STD-882E compliance. You understand the process rigor and collaborative relationships required to achieve airworthiness approvals across civil and military domains, and how airborne cyber security assurance requirements must be part of the initial design concepts on every new program. You lead by building relationships within the organization and externally with regulators, sponsoring offices, and your own team of certification leads, and you know how to translate emerging and often ambiguous guidance into a defensible, schedule-compatible certification strategy.
Merlin Labs builds autonomous aviation systems for civil and defense customers, and the engineering organization behind that work needs a leader who is personally expert in civil certification and who can manage the work of the military airworthiness lead and Cyber Certification Lead. You will own civil certification (FAA Part 23 and Part 25) directly, while leading the military airworthiness lead and cyber certification lead and their teams, reporting to the VP of Airworthiness & certification. If you want to grow and lead the certification and airworthiness teams that enable Merlin to field robust, certifiable autonomous systems to civil and defense customers on a demanding schedule, this is the role for you.

Responsibilities:

  • Support current New Zealand CAANZ certification activities for the U.S. based aspects and lead Merlin's civil certification strategy with the FAA and other foreign authorities, serving as primary technical authority and primary liaison with regulatory authorities for U.S. certifications.
  • Manage all aspects of new civil certification projects: Core process standardization, A&C initial assessments, compliance strategies and A & C plans, issue papers and risk assessments, and guide the Merlin team to final compliance.
  • Lead and grow the Military Airworthiness and Cyber Certification teams, setting priorities, establishing and standardizing core processes, mentoring, and reviewing technical work while the team executes day-to-day military airworthiness and cyber certification activities.
  • Oversee the military airworthiness certification strategy for Merlin's defense programs through the Military Airworthiness Lead, serving as an escalation point to mitigate technical, resource, and capability risks.
  • Oversee closure of Military Certification Review Items (MCRIs), Issue Papers, and related airworthiness documentation through the Military Airworthiness Lead, ensuring compliance with MIL-HDBK-516C, MIL-STD-882E, applicable DEF STANs, and JSSG guidance.
  • Oversee the cyber security certification strategy across civil and military programs through the Cyber Certification Lead, driving integration of airborne cyber security assurance activities with existing safety and development assurance processes and serve as an escalation point to mitigate technical, resource, capability risks.
  • Partner with the process assurance manager and engineering discipline leads to integrate civil certification, military airworthiness, and cyber security certification processes with Merlin's broader process assurance and configuration management framework.
  • Drive continuous improvement of civil certification, military airworthiness, and cyber security certification processes based on audit findings, program lessons learned, and evolving regulatory and DoD guidance.
  • Report to the VP of Airworthiness & certification on program health for civil certification and military airworthiness projects as well as the process improvement roadmap across all three disciplines.
  • Build scalable, repeatable civil certification, military airworthiness, and cyber security frameworks to ensure the success of all three functions as Merlin adds civil and defense programs to their portfolio.

Qualifications:

  • Direct, hands-on experience achieving FAA Part 23 and/or Part 25 type certificates, amendments, or Supplemental Type Certificates, including EASA CS-23/CS-25 or other foreign validation experience.

Who You’ll Work With

As a Layer1 software engineer, you will get to work on software that manages the physical layer, where packets meet the outside world. Stable and reliable physical connectivity is critical for any network and that is your challenge. You will get to write control software that brings to life everything from the ubiquitous 1GBASE-T connectors to 400G long reach optics that provide fiber connectivity across continents. Your software will need to work across a wide variety of forwarding engines, connectors and interface chips called gearboxes, which allow our hardware platforms to support diverse physical connectivity options within a product family. You will build instrumentation and telemetry tools that track physical link health parameters reported by the Layer1 components and enable operators to monitor and troubleshoot their links effectively. You will also work closely with our Optics teams to define standards for new media and bring them to market.

Arista Software Engineering roles demand a strong and broad software engineering background. While the primary focus area for this role is Layer1 software, the role will cover all aspects of software development spanning the addition of new features, debugging problems and fine tuning code for scalability and performance. You will own your projects from definition to deployment and customer interactions, and you will be responsible for the quality of everything you deliver.

Arista Software Engineering prides itself on a supportive and growth oriented culture. Over time, as your interests change, coupled with evolving business needs you will have the opportunity to switch from Layer1 to other areas, if you like.

What You’ll Do

  • Interface with customers, product management and hardware engineers to come up with innovative new Layer1 features.
  • Architect, design and manage the development of these features.
  • Develop and maintain features using C, C++ and Python, review and contribute to functional and design specifications. Build automated tests and test infrastructure to test the features.
  • Work with hardware and manufacturing teams to bring new Layer1 components like Phys and Transceivers to market.
  • Collaborate with hardware engineers to design optimal software control interfaces for managing Layer1 components.
  • Provide technical leadership across features, projects and tools.
  • Work with Customer Support Engineers and customers to analyze, mitigate and fix problems in customer networks.
  • Work with the System Test Engineers to analyze problems found in their tests and provide fixes for those problems.
  • Mentor new and junior engineers to bring them up to speed in Arista's software development environment.
  • BS Computer Science/Electrical Engineering/Computer Engineering + 3 years experience, or equivalent work experience
  • Expert knowledge of C or C++ and Python.
  • Knowledge of UNIX or Linux
  • Knowledge of digital communication technologies like modulation and signal encoding schemes is a plus.
  • Understanding of IP networking and/or distributed systems is a plus
  • Experience working with low level hardware components is a plus
  • Applied understanding of software engineering principles
  • Strong problem solving and software troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to design a solution and implement features independently.
  • Ability to work in small teams.

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. What sets us apart is our relentless pursuit of innovation. We leverage the latest advancements in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and software-defined networking to provide our clients with a competitive edge in an increasingly interconnected world. Our solutions are designed to not only meet the current demands of the digital landscape but to also anticipate and adapt to future challenges.

At Arista we value the diversity of thought and perspectives that each employee brings to the table. We believe that fostering an inclusive environment, where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome, is essential for driving creativity and innovation.

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as Best Engineering Team, Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest standards of quality and performance in everything we do.

  • 7+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, with at least 3 years focused on the Salesforce ecosystem or Salesforce-adjacent platforms.
  • Deep technical understanding of the Salesforce platform: metadata-driven architecture, deployment pipelines, sandboxes, packaging, security models, Apex, Lightning, and the ISV partner ecosystem.
  • Proven track record of shipping products that enterprise customers (Fortune 500, regulated industries) adopted and paid for. Not features; products.
  • Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, release management, or security/compliance tooling is strongly preferred.
  • You understand the competitive landscape: Copado, Gearset, AutoRABIT, Salto, and native Salesforce DX. You know where each is strong and where they are vulnerable.
  • Strong perspective on how AI/ML (especially Salesforce Agentforce, Einstein, Data Cloud) will reshape the Salesforce development and governance landscape.
  • Hands-on executor. You write PRDs, you talk to customers, you review wireframes, you sit in sprint reviews. You do not manage from a distance.
  • Exceptional communication skills. You can present a product vision to a C-suite audience and write a technical specification for an engineering team in the same day.
  • Intellectual curiosity and a bias toward action. When you see a problem, you solve it. When you don't know something, you go learn it.

What Will Make You Exceptional in This Role

  • You have experience building products in the Salesforce AppExchange ecosystem, ideally as an ISV or within a Salesforce-native product company.
  • You have worked at the intersection of DevOps and security/compliance in regulated industries.
  • You have led product-led growth initiatives within an enterprise product, designing self-serve onboarding, in-product conversion, and expansion mechanics.
  • You have a point of view on the future of AI in Salesforce DevOps and can articulate a 3-year vision for how autonomous agents will change how enterprises build on Salesforce.
  • You have experience going head-to-head against well-funded competitors and winning through product superiority rather than just marketing spend.

What We Expect in the First 12 Months

First 90 Days: Learn and Diagnose

  • Achieve deep fluency in Flosum's five product lines and their technical architecture.
  • Conduct 25+ customer and prospect interviews to build a firsthand understanding of enterprise pain points.
  • Complete a competitive audit with specific, actionable recommendations on where Flosum should invest to win.
  • Deliver your first product roadmap refresh with clear prioritization rationale.

Months 3-6: Ship and Win

  • Own and deliver at least one major product release that directly addresses a competitive gap or customer-requested capability.
  • Establish a product-led feedback loop between Sales, CS, and Engineering that accelerates deal velocity and reduces churn.
  • Define the next generation of Flosum's AI capabilities and present a detailed execution plan.

Months 6-12: Scale and Lead

  • Drive measurable improvement in competitive win rates against Copado and Gearset.
  • Launch at least one net-new product capability that opens a new revenue stream or market segment.
  • Establish Flosum as a thought leader in AI-driven Salesforce DevOps through content, speaking, and ecosystem engagement.

Benefits

Why Flosum

  • Category-defining opportunity: You will shape the future of how enterprises build on Salesforce. This is not incremental; it is transformational.
  • Direct CEO partnership: You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with a founder who is deeply technical, product-obsessed, and committed to building the best platform in the Salesforce ecosystem.
  • Fortune 100 customer base: Your product decisions will directly impact how the world's largest and most complex organizations operate.
  • AI inflection point: Agentforce and autonomous agents are rewriting the rules. Flosum is the first native platform to integrate these capabilities. You will define what comes next.
  • Missionary culture: We hire people who want to make a dent, not pad a resume. If you are looking for a place where your work matters and your ideas are heard, this is it.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary + performance bonus
  • Direct access to Salesforce ecosystem events, conferences (Dreamforce, TrailblazerDX), and customer engagement

jobs.excerpt: The Solution Owner is accountable for end‑to‑end ownership of one or more Sonexus solutions, with primary responsibility for Salesforce‑based platforms including ConnectSource and Marketing Cloud, ensuring predictable delivery, operational stability, financial stewardship, and strong alignment with business and product partners.
jobs.description:
The Solution Owner is accountable for end‑to‑end ownership of one or more Sonexus solutions, with primary responsibility for Salesforce‑based platforms including ConnectSource and Marketing Cloud, ensuring predictable delivery, operational stability, financial stewardship, and strong alignment with business and product partners. This role serves as the primary point of accountability for solution outcomes, reducing fragmented ownership, minimizing escalation‑driven delivery, improving consistency of execution, and ensuring build‑to‑run transitions and run stability are explicitly owned and measurable.

This role leads cross‑functional delivery teams responsible for building, implementing, and sustaining solutions on a customized Salesforce ecosystem (Salesforce Core, Marketing Cloud, integrations, and hybrid services). The Solution Owner ensures work is planned, governed, delivered, and transitioned to run in alignment with the Sonexus IT operating model, Salesforce best practices, and enterprise SDLC standards.

What Commercial Technologies Software Engineering contributes to Cardinal Health

Commercial Technologies manages the enterprise's portfolio of commercial technologies to maximize the business value of the technologies and enhance the customer experience. This function creates strategies for the portfolio and innovative solutions based on relationships with business leaders, develops back-end solutions and capabilities, and improves the front-end experience.

Commercial Technologies Software Engineering develops design options, process improvements and back-end solutions for commercial technologies to maximize performance and suitability for business needs. This job family manages engineering projects and plans for commercial technologies and interfaces with product managers to develop objectives. This job family assesses product systems, identifies opportunities for process and system improvements, and develops solutions through application of engineering principles.

Responsibilities

Solution Ownership & Delivery

  • Own end‑to‑end outcomes for assigned solutions across intake, build, implementation, transition to run, and ongoing support, with a primary focus on Salesforce ConnectSource and Marketing Cloud
  • Serve as the single accountable owner for Salesforce solution delivery, stability, and outcomes, eliminating fragmented ownership across onshore and offshore teams
  • Translate product and business goals into executable delivery plans with clear scope, milestones, dependencies, and success criteria across Salesforce configuration, development, integration, and data components
  • Ensure predictable delivery through disciplined planning, estimation, execution, and follow‑through
  • Establish and enforce solution‑level decision rights for Salesforce implementations, reducing day‑to‑day escalation by driving decisions with clear options, tradeoffs, and recommended paths

Planning, Financial & Capacity Management

  • Develop and manage delivery plans, schedules, and budgets for assigned Salesforce solutions
  • Translate Salesforce‑specific LOE (configuration, custom code, integrations, testing) into schedule and cost forecasts
  • Maintain onshore and offshore capacity plans, aligning priorities to Salesforce skill sets and avoiding role overlap or single‑threading
  • Own solution‑level resource management across Engineering, BA, QA, PM, Salesforce administrators, developers, integration specialists, and partner teams
  • Understand and manage capital vs. expense treatment aligned to enterprise finance standards for Salesforce initiatives
  • Protect Sonexus revenue by understanding financial impact, margin implications, and revenue risk tied to Salesforce delivery decisions

SDLC Governance, Delivery Discipline & Flow of Work

  • Define and operate a consistent, well‑understood flow of work for Salesforce solutions from intake through delivery, release, hypercare, and run
  • Ensure adherence to enterprise SDLC gates, QA standards, Salesforce release management practices, and structured change control
  • Maintain delivery hygiene through WBS, RAID logs, risk management, decision logs, and issue tracking for Salesforce initiatives
  • Apply governance that is disciplined and right‑sized, avoiding over‑engineered Salesforce processes used to compensate for weak delivery fundamentals
  • Identify recurring Salesforce delivery and operational breakdowns and drive targeted process improvements rooted in root‑cause analysis
  • Adjust planning, governance, and communication practices based on delivery phase and observed Salesforce outcomes, reinforcing continuous improvement

Build‑to‑Run Transition & Run Stability

  • Ensure Salesforce build‑to‑run transitions are clearly defined, documented, and executed, including readiness criteria, deployment documentation, and knowledge transfer
  • Be accountable for Salesforce solution stability post‑release, including ConnectSource and Marketing Cloud operations
  • Partner with support and run teams to triage, prioritize, and resolve Salesforce issues effectively
  • Own intake and prioritization of Salesforce break/fix work, technical debt, and remediation initiatives
  • Drive root‑cause analysis to prevent recurring Salesforce issues and reduce rework

Quality, Compliance & Evidence‑Based Readiness

  • Enforce consistent Salesforce requirements, configuration standards, and testing practices to strengthen end‑to‑end quality accountability
  • Ensure QA, accessibility, security, and compliance requirements are met for Salesforce solutions, including required evidence, sign‑offs, and remediation
  • Maintain clean, validated, PHI‑safe Salesforce demos, reports, journeys, and data views prior to internal or client‑facing reviews
  • Strengthen delivery confidence through evidence‑based readiness rather than last‑minute Salesforce escalation

Cross‑Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Alignment

  • Lead and align Engineering, BA, QA, PM, Product, APS, Business stakeholders, and Salesforce platform teams
  • Partner closely with offshore Salesforce development teams, providing clear priorities, decision ownership, and escalation paths
  • Maintain clear ownership, accountability, and communication across onshore and offshore Salesforce teams
  • Ensure consistent, aligned messaging across functions to reduce churn, rework, and conflicting direction
  • Partner effectively with APS and Product leadership on Salesforce roadmap impacts, client risks, and solution evolution

Stakeholder Leadership & Client Presence

  • Demonstrate strong executive presence in internal and client‑facing interactions, especially when representing Salesforce solutions
  • Prepare and lead Salesforce‑related meetings with clear pre‑reads, agendas, risks, decisions, and recommended paths
  • Communicate clearly in writing and verbally, maintaining appropriate internal vs. external voice when discussing Salesforce capabilities and constraints
  • Influence and negotiate without authority by presenting Salesforce tradeoffs grounded in data, platform constraints, and delivery realities

Leadership & People Development

  • Coach and develop BAs, PMs, Salesforce Technical Leads, Developers, Engineers, and QAs to build sustainable delivery and leadership capability
  • Hold Salesforce teams accountable for outcomes while fostering a culture of ownership and follow‑through across locations

Qualifications

  • 8-12 years of experience, preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree in related field, or equivalent work experience, preferred
  • Experience leading cross‑functional delivery teams (Engineering, QA, BA, PM)
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce‑based solutions and enterprise application environments
  • Demonstrated capability in estimation, planning, SDLC governance, and delivery execution
  • Demonstrated ability to manage delivery plans, budgets, and capacity across multiple initiatives
  • Experience operating in regulated environments (healthcare or adjacent industries preferred)
  • Demonstrated use of structured delivery artifacts (e.g., WBS, LOE-based estimates, schedules, RAID logs, change control)

What is expected of you and others at this level

  • Manages department operations and supervises professional employees, front line supervisors and/or business support staff
  • Participates in the development of policies and procedures to achieve specific goals
  • Ensures employees operate within guidelines
  • Decisions have a short term impact on work processes, outcomes and customers
  • Interacts with subordinates, peers, customers, and suppliers at various management levels; may interact with senior management
  • Interactions normally involve resolution of issues related to operations and/or projects
  • Gains consensus from various parties involved

This role is designed to keep the sales process organized and moving forward so Account Executives and sales leaders can focus on selling, closing deals, and building client relationships.

This is more than an administrative support position. You’ll help maintain pipeline accuracy, coordinate follow-ups, prepare sales materials, and ensure no lead, task, or opportunity slips through the cracks.

    • HubSpot
    • Salesforce
    • Zoho

  • Configure and publish learning content using standards such as SCORM and xAPI.

  • Follow accessibility standards and established eLearning development best practices.

  • Incorporate feedback from Instructional Designers, Project Managers, Quality teams, and clients while maintaining development quality and consistency.

Collaboration & Project Delivery

  • Communicate proactively regarding technical challenges, development considerations, timelines, and potential solutions.

  • Participate in development reviews and incorporate feedback efficiently.

Required Skills and Qualifications

jobs.title: Director of Development Strategy & Operations
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT NEW ENERGY NEXUSNew Energy Nexus (NEX) is an international NGO that supports climate solutions and builds a more equitable clean energy economy.
jobs.description:
ABOUT NEW ENERGY NEXUS

New Energy Nexus (NEX) is an international NGO that supports climate solutions and builds a more equitable clean energy economy. Our laser focus is on clean energy entrepreneurs: providing them with funds, accelerators, and networks to thrive. They are our main audience and our agent of change.

We started in California in 2004 and now operate across China, India, Southeast Asia, East and West Africa, and Australia. We have leveraged US$5.4 billion in investment and supported more than 11,000 entrepreneurs.

ABOUT THE ROLE & OPPORTUNITY

The Director of Development Strategy & Operations will lead the internal engine behind New Energy Nexus' global fundraising and business development efforts. Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, this role sits at the center of NEX's development team — turning what our development and partnerships staff and country teams learn on the ground with funders into a coherent, prioritized fundraising strategy, and making sure the team is coordinated, resourced, and focused on the highest-value opportunities.

This is not primarily a donor-facing relationship management role. It is a strategy, team leadership, and fundraising operations role for someone who understands the business and fund development cycle deeply enough to translate frontline intelligence — what funders are signaling, what's landing and what isn't, where proposals are stalling, which markets and programs are attracting interest — into clear direction for where the team should spend its time.

The Director will lead and develop NEX's global platform-level development team, ensuring that individual team members' skills and expertise are deployed effectively against organizational priorities, while bringing together the knowledge and fundraising capabilities of country leaders, chapter teams, and program leads. The ideal candidate has the analytical rigor and systems mindset of a strong operations leader, paired with real fluency in philanthropic and development finance fundraising, so they can be a credible internal leader and partner to a globally distributed team of fundraisers, country directors, and program leads.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Fundraising Strategy & Intelligence (50%)

  • Help develop a living, prioritized development strategy based on proposal outcomes, funder conversations, and market signals gleaned from team conversations and learnings from fundraisers, country directors, and program leads
  • Identify where NEX should be focusing time and effort across programs and geographies, based on funder appetite, pipeline strength, and organizational priorities.
  • Maintain a clear view of the funding pipeline across the network — by funder, program, chapter, and stage — and flag risks, gaps, or unrestricted-vs-restricted balance issues early.
  • Translate strategy into concrete guidance: which opportunities to prioritize, which proposals need repositioning, where the team is over- or under-invested.
  • Serve as a thought partner to the CEO and program leads on funding strategy, drawing on patterns across markets rather than any single relationship.

Team Coordination & Enablement (35%)

  • Lead and develop the global platform-level development team including recruiting, hiring, onboarding, coaching, and managing performance, and ensure team members' skills are effectively leveraged against NEX's development priorities.
  • Translate the development strategy into a clear rolling work plan for the team, aligning ownership, resources, and timelines.
  • Build strong collaboration across the global development function, bringing together the expertise and fundraising capabilities of platform-level staff, country leaders, fundraisers, and program leads to maximize collective impact.
  • Run the operating rhythm of the fundraising team: pipeline reviews, proposal coordination across programs/chapters/finance/communications, and prioritization check-ins.
  • Coordinate multi-country and multi-program proposals, including combining country and program inputs into a cohesive narrative and budget that aligns with broader NEX operational and growth priorities.
  • Build and own a central library of fundraising collateral - pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies, program summaries, impact data - so materials for funder meetings and conference talks can be assembled quickly rather than built from scratch each time.
  • Draft and maintain core funder and conference decks, adapting a standard set of modular slides/content to each audience so our fundraisers can focus their time on external relationship-building and speaking rather than deck production.
  • Partner with the Chief Communications Officer to keep collateral aligned with current messaging, program updates, and brand standards.
  • Provide country leads and fundraisers with the tools, templates, frameworks, and support to raise funds effectively and report consistently.
  • Build feedback loops so that what is learned through funder and country-level engagement consistently makes its way back into strategy, priorities, and team planning.

Systems, Data & Reporting (15%)

  • Accountable for the fundraising CRM and pipeline-tracking systems, ensuring data quality, consistent use across chapters, and useful reporting.
  • Produce regular and ad hoc reporting and dashboards for NEX leadership on pipeline health, funder trends, and progress against platform fundraising goals.
  • Standardize proposal, reporting, and stewardship templates and processes across the global platform-level team.
  • Track outcomes against the fundraising strategy and refine it as new data comes in.
  • Ensure fundraising protocols and internal as well as external reporting are completed on time and to consistent quality standards

SUCCESS IN THE FIRST 6–12 MONTHS

Success in this role will mean building a more coordinated, strategic, and effective global development function. By the end of the first 6–12 months, the Director will have:

  • Established clear visibility into NEX's global fundraising pipeline, priorities, risks, and opportunities, with leadership able to make decisions based on reliable, current information.
  • Built a strong operating rhythm across the global platform-level development team, with clear ownership, effective collaboration, and team members' skills deployed against the highest-priority fundraising opportunities.
  • Improved coordination across platform, country, and program teams so that high-value proposals are prioritized appropriately, developed collaboratively, and submitted on time and at a consistently high quality.
  • Established consistent CRM and pipeline management practices across the development function, with data being used to inform strategy, prioritization, and reporting.
  • Created a well-organized, accessible library of standardized fundraising collateral and tools that enables fundraisers and country teams to move more quickly and consistently.
  • Established effective feedback loops between funder and country-level intelligence, fundraising performance, and the organization's overall development strategy.

Requirements

Professional Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in fundraising, development operations, or a closely related strategy/operations function (e.g., sales operations, revenue operations, or enablement), with at least 5 years touching nonprofit or philanthropic fundraising directly.
  • Demonstrated experience turning frontline or field-level input into strategy and prioritization.

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.


The Role

We are looking for a Lead Recruiter (Corporate Functions) to lead hiring across Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Legal, Strategy, CEO Office, and other corporate functions globally.

This role combines hands-on recruitment execution with leadership responsibilities. You will partner closely with business leaders to attract high-impact talent, drive hiring strategy, and help build a scalable Talent Acquisition function capable of supporting BJAK’s rapid global growth.

You will play a critical role in shaping the organization by hiring exceptional talent while mentoring junior recruiters and establishing recruiting best practices across the business.


What You’ll Do

Business Recruitment Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end recruitment process for business and corporate functions globally, including Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Legal, CEO Office, and other key functions.

  • Partner closely with hiring managers and senior leaders to define hiring priorities, organizational needs, role requirements, and workforce planning strategies.

  • Act as a trusted talent advisor by providing market intelligence, compensation insights, hiring recommendations, and talent market trends.

  • Lead recruitment efforts for senior, niche, confidential, and business-critical positions across multiple regions.

  • Develop and execute creative sourcing strategies to attract high-caliber passive candidates in competitive talent markets.

Talent Pipeline & Market Intelligence

  • Build and maintain strong talent pipelines across key business functions to support both current and future hiring needs.

  • Conduct talent mapping exercises across target companies, industries, and markets.

  • Develop strong understanding of global labor markets, compensation trends, and talent availability across multiple countries.

Team Development & Process Excellence

  • Mentor and support junior recruiters, helping improve sourcing effectiveness, candidate assessment quality, and stakeholder management capabilities.

  • Establish recruiting best practices, interview calibration standards, sourcing frameworks, and hiring processes across business functions.

  • Review recruitment performance, pipeline quality, and hiring outcomes to identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Support the development and scaling of the global Talent Acquisition team.

Recruitment Operations & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate ATS data, candidate records, and recruitment reporting.

  • Track recruitment metrics including pipeline health, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, offer acceptance rates, and hiring quality.

  • Ensure a professional, positive, and consistent candidate experience across all recruitment stages.

  • Support compliance with local labor regulations and recruitment best practices across multiple regions.


The Right Fit Has

  • 5-8 years of full-cycle recruitment experience across multiple business and corporate functions.

  • Proven success recruiting for functions such as Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Legal, Strategy, Consulting, CEO Office, or other business-critical roles.

  • Demonstrated ability to hire senior, niche, and difficult-to-fill positions across multiple markets.

  • Strong expertise in sourcing passive candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter, networking, talent mapping, referrals, and other advanced sourcing techniques.

  • Experience managing multiple high-priority requisitions simultaneously while maintaining quality and speed.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence hiring decisions and challenge hiring assumptions when necessary.

  • Experience partnering with senior leaders on hiring strategy, organizational design discussions, and workforce planning initiatives.

  • Experience mentoring, coaching, or guiding junior recruiters is highly preferred.

  • Familiarity with global hiring practices, compensation structures, and recruitment across multiple countries.

  • Strong proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment analytics.

  • Excellent communication, project management, and relationship-building skills.

  • Experience in high-growth technology companies, startups, internet businesses, consulting firms, or fast-scaling organizations is strongly preferred.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently delivers high-quality hires across multiple business functions and regions.

  • Builds sustainable talent pipelines for critical and hard-to-fill business roles.

  • Becomes a trusted advisor to business leaders and hiring managers.

  • Improves recruitment efficiency, hiring quality, and candidate experience.

  • Successfully develops junior recruiters and contributes to building a scalable Talent Acquisition function.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities, ambitious hiring goals, and a high degree of ownership.


Why Join BJAK

  • Above-market remuneration.

  • Fast-track career growth and leadership opportunities.

  • High ownership, autonomy, and direct impact on business growth.

  • Exposure to global hiring across multiple countries and functions.

  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership on critical business hiring initiatives.

  • Flat organization where ideas and execution matter more than titles.

  • Meaningful work that directly contributes to building and scaling world-class teams.

jobs.description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a GTM Program Managerin our New Markets area in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

In this role, you will sit at the strategic intersection of Demand Generation, Revenue Operations, Marketing, and Technical teams. As an operational amplifier for our commercial organization, you will design, build, and optimize AI-powered automations, automated workflows, and data pipelines that power our outbound go-to-market motions and help Wellhub scale globally.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Automate GTM Infrastructure: Design and deploy AI-powered data enrichment systems and workflows (using tools like Clay, Zapier, n8n, Salesforce, and Salesloft) to identify Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) prospects and deliver high-intent leads directly to sales teams.
  • Drive Commercial Personalization: Build workflows that automate highly personalized messaging and deliver actionable account intelligence to SDRs and Closers to increase conversion rates.
  • Execute GTM Experiments: Drive, prioritize, and analyze A/B experiments and outbound pilots to accelerate regional pipeline generation and remove operational bottlenecks.
  • Act as Internal Operational Expert: Serve as the subject matter expert and day-to-day operator for Clay, Salesloft, and Salesforce across your designated region.
  • Cross-Functional Orchestration: Partner closely with Global Strategy, Sales Dev Directors, Marketing, and Revenue Ops leaders to track funnel performance, synthesize feedback loops, and influence regional commercial strategy.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders across international teams.
  • Technical Curiosity & Vibe Coding: Passionate about learning new tools, experimenting with AI tools (like Claude, Cursor, or AI Agents), and tinkering with automation platforms.
  • Relevant Experience: Proven track record in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, Technical Product Management, or Project Management managing complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives.
  • Systems & Tooling Familiarity: Experience building workflows and automations using CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot), sales engagement tools (Salesloft, Apollo), or orchestration platforms (Clay, n8n, Zapier, Make).
  • Commercial Bias & ROI Mindset: Relentlessly focused on practical outcomes—always asking "how will this workflow help an SDR validate more opportunities or close more deals?"
  • Experimental & Analytical: Comfortable testing hypotheses, analyzing data (SQL/Excel), validating signals, and navigating ambiguous requirements into structured, scalable processes.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that AI Tools expertise and Fluent English are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhuband LinkedIn!

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Solutions Engineer

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Solutions Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Solutions Engineer, you are the technical owner of the merchant relationship from first sales conversation through live integration and beyond. You will focus on our enterprise and strategic merchants: the national retailers and high-volume brands running custom, hand-built integrations across web, mobile app, and in-store. These are our most complex merchants and our largest revenue drivers, and they do not come with an off-the-shelf plugin.

You will partner with Sales, Product, and Engineering to scope what a merchant needs, design the integration that gets them there, and stay with them once they are live. You own the technical side of pre-sales: demos, architecture discussions, RFP responses, and solution proposals. When a merchant needs something custom, you define the requirement, shape the solution with our engineering team, and drive it to launch.

This is a customer-facing engineering role. You will spend as much time on calls with merchant developers as you will in documentation and test environments, and you need to be credible in both rooms.

This role combines technical expertise and sales acumen to support sales teams. They work closely with the sales team and clients, understanding customer needs and translating them into effective, tailored solutions. Acting as a bridge between technical and business functions, a Solutions Engineer not only helps demonstrate and implement the product’s capabilities but also communicates complex technical details in a way that resonates with clients. Their role requires both the ability to engage with customers directly and the technical know-how to ensure the product meets client requirements effectively.

What You'll Do:

  • Own technical discovery for prospective merchants: understand their stack, their checkout flow, and their constraints, then map them to the right Sezzle integration path
  • Lead product demos and technical presentations for merchant engineering and business stakeholders
  • Design integration solutions across our API, SDKs, and platform plugins (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, WooCommerce, Wix, and custom builds)
  • Write technical proposals and complete RFP and security questionnaire responses
  • Support merchant mobile app integrations: SDK implementation, in-app checkout, and native versus webview handoff
  • Validate integrations in sandbox and in production before launch, including checkout flow, widget and messaging placement, redirect and handoff behavior, and settlement
  • Troubleshoot live integration issues alongside Support and Engineering, and own the technical narrative back to the merchant
  • Translate recurring merchant needs into product feedback, and push for the fixes that unblock revenue
  • Build and maintain integration documentation, runbooks, and internal enablement so the team scales without you in every call
  • Act as the trusted technical advisor for your merchants after launch, spotting optimization opportunities they haven't asked for yet

What We Look For:

  • 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role: solutions engineering, sales engineering, implementation, solutions architecture, or technical account management
  • Experience with mobile SDK integrations on iOS and Android, including the ability to guide merchant mobile developers through implementation and debug what breaks
  • Experience supporting enterprise merchants through complex, multi-stakeholder integrations with custom-built commerce stacks
  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs, webhooks, and reading API documentation critically
  • Working knowledge of web technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
  • Familiarity with at least one major e-commerce platform (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, WooCommerce, Wix) and how payment methods integrate into it
  • Understanding of e-commerce workflows: cart, checkout, payment authorization and capture, refunds, shipping, and product management
  • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences, and business context clearly to engineers
  • Strong written communication. You will produce documentation and proposals that merchants and internal teams rely on
  • Comfort managing several merchant integrations at once in a fast-moving environment
  • Ability to read code in at least one language well enough to debug a merchant's implementation
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools effectively in day-to-day work, including research, technical documentation, problem-solving, and workflow automation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at a payments company, PSP, or BNPL provider
  • Familiarity with payment gateway architecture and how alternative payment methods are surfaced at checkout
  • Experience with in-store or omnichannel payment integrations
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

  • Extensive hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation.

  • Proven expertise building CI/CD pipelines and implementing DevOps, GitOps, and Infrastructure Automation practices.
  • Strong scripting skills using Python, Bash, and preferably Go or PowerShell.
  • Deep understanding of cloud security, IAM, encryption, key management, compliance, and Zero Trust architecture.
  • Experience implementing monitoring, observability, logging, alerting, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, stakeholder management, documentation, and technical leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, AWS DevOps Engineer – Professional, or equivalent advanced AWS certifications.
  • Experience managing AWS Organizations, Control Tower, enterprise landing zones, and cloud governance at scale.
  • Familiarity with service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd), eBPF-based observability, and modern Zero Trust networking principles.
  • Experience implementing FinOps, cloud cost optimization, and AWS Well-Architected Framework best practices.
  • Experience supporting regulated environments such as HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or FedRAMP.

About Us

Every year, millions die from preventable diseases because vital services do not reach them. A root cause is broken data: missing or unreliable IDs, fragmented records, and inflated reporting. Without accurate data on who receives services, governments and NGOs cannot deliver care effectively, track impact, or target life-saving resources.

Simprints is a nonprofit tech company that partners with ministries and funders to verify identities, digitise workflows, and enable evidence-based decisions so the right services reach the right people at the right time. We co-design end-to-end digital solutions with the people who use them, from the frontlines to national dashboards. Our biometric products integrate with health records to drive accuracy, accountability, and insights.

We build for scale with privacy-first, open-source, and cost-effective technology that strengthens national digital public infrastructure. Studies have shown that Simprints increases impact through real-time, precision data, for example, increasing maternal health visits by 38% in Bangladesh or accurate HIV tracing by 62% in Malawi. To date, we’ve worked in over 17 countries, helping deliver health, aid, and finance to over 4 million people.

Our mission is simple: make sure every vaccine, every dollar, and every public good reaches the people who need them most.

About the Role

The Partnerships Operations Manager will help build the operating engine behind Simprints’ growth. This role will support the Partnerships team to identify, qualify, and progress high-value opportunities more effectively, while improving the systems, data, and automation that underpin our revenue generation.

You will sit at the intersection of sales operations, market intelligence, AI-enabled automation, and proposal development. One day you might be improving our CRM and pipeline reporting; the next, building an AI-assisted workflow to scan donor opportunities; the next, coordinating inputs for a grant application or preparing a funder brief.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys creating structure, improving processes, and helping senior relationship-holders move faster and more strategically. You will make the Partnerships team sharper, more disciplined, and better equipped to grow a healthy and diversified pipeline.

Job Details

  • Job Title: Partnerships Operations Manager
  • Reporting To: Chief Strategy Officer
  • Grade: UK Grade IC5 - Up to £45,000
  • Location: Remote

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  1. Manage and improve Partnerships systems and pipeline operations
    Revamp our CRM engine and maintain CRM hygiene, pipeline data, opportunity and task tracking, dashboards, and reporting so the team has clear visibility on priorities, risks, next steps, and revenue forecasts.
  2. Build AI-enabled automation for growth and fundraising workflows
    Design practical automations to support funder scanning, opportunity alerts, donor research, meeting preparation, proposal content development, follow-up tracking, and pipeline reporting.
  3. Scout and qualify new opportunities
    Monitor the market for relevant grants, RFPs, funder calls, innovation challenges, and strategic partnership opportunities, using clear criteria to assess fit, competitiveness, revenue potential, impact, and internal effort required.
  4. Support grant applications and proposal development
    Coordinate timelines, internal inputs, compliance checks, and supporting materials for proposals and funder submissions; draft or refine selected sections where needed.
  5. Strengthen market, funder, and partner intelligence
    Produce concise research outputs such as funder briefs, opportunity summaries, country or sector snapshots, partner maps, and go/no-go recommendations to support better decision-making.

Skills and experience

  1. Must have experience specifically in a mission-driven, technology, global health, or international development context in sales operations, growth operations, fundraising operations, business development operations,
  2. Strong systems and process skills, including experience managing CRMs, pipelines, dashboards, spreadsheets, trackers, or workflow tools.
  3. Confidence using AI and automation tools to improve team efficiency, reduce manual work, and create scalable processes.
  4. Excellent research, analytical, and synthesis skills, with the ability to turn complex market or funder information into clear recommendations.
  5. Strong written communication and project coordination skills, including the ability to support proposals, support and produce presentations, funder briefs, internal decision documents, and cross-team deadlines.

How we work
We confront the grey. We practise transparency and radical candour, listen deeply, share information openly, and speak up when our ethical compass is challenged, so that psychological safety is real and everyone can do their best work.

We leave our egos at the door. We bring curiosity, kindness, and a positive attitude, seek first to understand, and remember to laugh together. We stay humble about our small part in big global problems, and we remain bold about our ambition to drive change.

We find a way. We plan with clear strategies, deliverables, deadlines, and metrics, step out of our comfort zones, and make it happen. When a plan is not working, we learn from the data, adapt quickly, and keep moving in service of the mission.

We remember why we are here. Impact for people comes first. We act like owners, hold ourselves to high standards, and work across teams to close data gaps and increase coverage, so the right services reach the right people at the right time.

We celebrate the differences. We treat every person with compassion, empathy, and respect, build inclusive spaces where diverse perspectives are welcomed, involve people in important decisions, and share credit generously, because our best ideas can come from anywhere.

Benefits

5 Reasons to Join Simprints

Life is short. We believe work should be inspirational, meaningful and fun. At Simprints, we’re taking on global development’s biggest challenges, powered by an amazing culture and incredible people. Work with us, and you will grow faster, learn more, and take on great responsibilities with the potential to make lasting change.

1. Genuine Impact. Work directly with our partners and users to deliver technology that has the potential to impact millions of lives across the globe. At Simprints, you’ll be part of a team that is passionate about driving real change.

2. An incredible, diverse team. Our work is at the intersection of technology and global development, and we’ve managed to build an amazing team drawn from all over the world. But don’t take our word for it—we’re an externally recognised as a Great Place to Work, and a 2025 Best Workplace for Women amonst many other accolades.

3. Mutual Flex. We champion a work culture where autonomy and trust are paramount, steering clear of mere face-time metrics. Whether it's managing life's essentials like healthcare appointments or adapting work hours to match your peak productivity times, we've got you covered. In return, we count on your reciprocal flexibility when mission-critical moments arise, like stepping up for a crucial client discussion on a Friday or tackling unexpected technical glitches beyond regular hours.

4. Ultimate work-life balance.

    1. We offer a 4-day workweek, meaning everybody has the option to have Fridays off.
    2. We also offer unlimited annual leave, which allows you to prioritise your well-being

Role Overview

California's energy code requires a third-party field verification step, a HERS or ECC test, for most HVAC permits. It's a fragmented, manual, and under-served market. PermitFlow is entering it.

We're looking for someone who has run a HERS/ECC operation before. This role isn't for a field technician; it's for an operator who understands the rater market, knows the unit economics, has relationships with raters across California, and can build a statewide network from the ground up. This is the first hire in this function, reporting directly to the COO.

What You'll Do

  • Build and own the statewide ECC-Rater network. Contract 2+ qualified rater firms across all major CA metros (LA/Orange County, San Diego, Bay Area, Sacramento/Central Valley, Inland Empire). Set commercial terms, SLAs, capacity commitments, and offboarding criteria.

  • Own Provider relationships. Manage PermitFlow's relationships with all three CA ECC Provider registries: CHEERS and Golden State Registry (GSR). These are the credentialing and oversight bodies for every rater in the network.

  • Build and run the QA program. Credential verification, E&O insurance review, pass rate tracking, SLA auditing, and rater performance scorecards. Hold or hire 1-2 certified ECC-Raters for technical and QA standards.

  • Be the technical voice in enterprise sales. Join calls with large HVAC customers where HERS/ECC capability is a key decision factor. You're the reason a customer believes PermitFlow can execute at volume.

  • Monitor the HERS-to-ECC transition. California's HERS program officially became the Energy Code Compliance (ECC) program in January 2026. You stay on top of Title 20 rulemaking and what it means for our network and operations.

  • Evaluate strategic options. Including potential acquisition targets where acquiring a rater firm accelerates coverage.

What We're Looking For

  • HERS/ECC operator: You've run a permit + HERS/ECC + rebate operation, not as a field technician, but as the person responsible for the network, the workflow, and the results. You understand what drives pass rates, SLA performance, and rater economics.

  • CA market native: You have real relationships in the CA rater market. You know who the raters are in Sacramento, the Bay Area, LA, and San Diego. You can get on the phone with CHEERS (and others) and get things done.

  • Network builder: You've built or managed a multi-vendor, multi-metro network of inspectors or raters. You know how to vet, contract, and if necessary, off-board a partner.

  • Builder orientation: There is no inherited infrastructure here. You're writing the playbook, setting the QA bar, designing the vendor contracts, and deciding who's in the network. You've done this before and you're good at it.

  • Technical credibility in customer conversations: You can sit across from a VP of Operations at a large HVAC company and speak with authority about HERS/ECC testing workflows, rater capacity, and what makes a compliant inspection. This is not a sales role, but your presence on a call needs to close the credibility gap.

jobs.excerpt: Impinj is a leading RAIN RFID provider and Internet of Things pioneer.
jobs.description:
Impinj is a leading RAIN RFID provider and Internet of Things pioneer. We’re inventing ways to connect every thing to the Internet — including retail apparel, retail general merchandise, healthcare items, automobile parts, airline baggage, food and much more. With more than 100 billion items connected to date, and multiple Fortune 500 enterprises around the world using our platform, we solve for a better understanding of our world. If it’s a thing, we’re working to connect it.Join Impinj and help us realize our vision of a boundless IoT— connecting trillions of everyday items to the Internet.

Team Overview:

The RAIN Reader IC (RIC) design group is part of the Impinj Silicon Engineering department and is responsible for the development of Impinj’s RIC products. Within the RIC Design group, the digital team owns the digital subsystems of these products, including the digital modem, the microcontroller subsystem, digital control loops, calibration engines, and the control and interface logic for analog IP. The team carries these designs from architecture and micro-architecture definition through RTL, verification, DFT, and timing closure to tapeout, post-silicon bring-up, and validation, partnering closely with chip architects, RF/analog designers, physical design, and CAD/EDA engineers and using state-of-the-art tools and methodologies. The team works to balance short-term goals needed to deliver products rapidly to market and long-term enhancements to methodologies and practices to enable future efficiencies.

What You'll Do:

  • Drive the digital design of Impinj's next-generation RAIN RFID Reader ICs from architecture through tapeout and silicon validation.
  • Develop micro-architectures, create executable models, and implement RTL for complex digital and mixed-signal IC subsystems.
  • Collaborate with chip architects and RF/analog engineers to partition and realize advanced mixed-signal architectures, including digital control loops, calibration engines, and interface logic for analog IP.
  • Partner with physical design and verification teams to ensure timing closure, signal integrity, and delivery of production-ready Reader ICs.
  • Define and implement DFT strategies — including scan insertion, BIST, and boundary scan — appropriate for mixed-signal Reader IC designs.
  • Work with CAD/EDA engineers to evolve Impinj's ASIC/SoC design flows, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Enhance existing RAIN RFID Reader products with new features, performance improvements, and power optimizations.
  • Support post-silicon bring-up and debug, correlating RTL and simulation results with lab measurements to validate design intent.

What You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, with 12 years of experience (or 8 years with MS or 5 years with a PhD) required.
  • 12+ years of RTL design experience, including at least 2–3 full tapeout cycles preferably on mixed-signal or RF-integrated ICs.
  • Strong skills in digital logic design, micro-architecture definition, synthesis, and timing closure.
  • Proficiency in Verilog and SystemVerilog for RTL development, behavioral modeling, and verification.
  • Solid understanding of digital design methodologies including CDC analysis, clock gating, low-power design (UPF/CPF), and static timing analysis.
  • Experience with UVM-based verification, functional coverage, assertion-based verification, and DFT implementation (scan, MBIST, ATPG).
  • Scripting proficiency in Python, Perl, or UNIX shell for flow automation and design productivity.
  • Proven ability to lead technical workstreams, mentor junior engineers, and communicate effectively across analog, digital, and systems disciplines.

EDF power solutions North America has been providing clean energy solutions throughout the U.S., Canada, and Mexico since 1987. Be a part of an innovative and collaborative team environment that fosters our goal of delivering renewable solutions to lead the transition to a sustainable energy future.

Benefits & Perks:

EDF power solutions offers best-in-class employee benefits, including the following:

  • Competitive bonus incentives. This position is eligible for our annual bonus program.
  • Comprehensive health coverage. We provide low-cost health & wellness coverage for employees and their eligible dependents.
  • Rewarding 401k. We provide a generous matching contribution.

We are also proud to offer:

  • Favorable paid time off programs, including paid parental leave after one year of service.
  • Rewarding learning & career development and advancement opportunities.
  • Supportive mentorship & buddy programs.

Salary Range: The full pay range for this role is $107,200 to $178,600 annually, and the good faith estimated starting pay for this position upon hire is $128,610 to $150,045 annually. We generally base our salary decisions on factors including but not limited to, relevant work and leadership experience, education, demonstrated performance, internal equity, and in some cases, geographic location.

Scope of Job: ISO Compliance Specialist oversees regulatory compliance for all U.S. independent system operators and regional transmission organizations. An Independent System Operator (ISO) is a neutral, federally regulated organization that coordinates, controls, and monitors the operation of the electrical power system within a single state or region. The primary focus is ERCOT, though the role covers PJM, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, and ISO-NE. This fully remote position requires expertise in market rules and protocols to ensure company compliance across multiple ISO/RTO markets.

Responsibilities

  • Serves as the company’s primary subject matter expert for ERCOT compliance, including nodal protocols, operating procedures, settlement processes, and market guides.
  • Tracks and reports rule changes in all U.S. ISO/RTO markets, focusing on ERCOT; evaluate business effects of PRRs and stakeholder developments.
  • Develops and maintains internal compliance policies, procedures, and controls tailored to each ISO/RTO in which the company participates.
  • Conducts regular internal audits and gap analyses across trading, scheduling, settlements, and operations functions for multi-market compliance exposure.
  • Manages all required filings, notifications, and reports to ERCOT, PUCT, FERC, and other applicable regulatory bodies on time and with accuracy.
  • Serves as primary liaison for ERCOT Market Surveillance, PUCT enforcement inquiries, and NERC/Regional Entity audit activities.
  • Coordinates cross-market compliance calendars and risk registers, ensuring obligations across all ISO/RTO footprints are tracked and met.
  • Designs and delivers compliance training programs for operational, trading, and scheduling staff across all relevant markets.
  • Collaborates with legal, finance, and operations teams to embed compliance requirements into new market strategies, products, and systems.
  • Participates in ISO/RTO stakeholder meetings and working groups, particularly within ERCOT, representing the company’s interests in rulemaking processes.
  • Prepares executive-level compliance reporting and escalate material risks to leadership in a clear, timely manner. Other duties as assigned.

Supervision of Others: No direct supervisory duties. Will need to manage consultants and contractors when needed

Working Conditions:

95% of time is spent in the office environment utilizing computers (frequent use of various Microsoft software/programs), phones, and general office equipment. 5% of time is spent outside of the office visiting vendors’ and/or internal customers’ sites in addition to attending various conferences and meetings.

Qualifications

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree required, master’s degree preferred.
  • 5+ years of regulatory compliance experience within U.S. ISO/RTO wholesale energy markets, with demonstrated ERCOT expertise as a primary requirement.
  • Experience with PUCT regulations and the Texas wholesale and retail energy market structure.

Skills/Knowledge/Abilities:

  • In-depth knowledge of ERCOT nodal protocols, market rules, QSE/LSE obligations, ancillary services, and settlement processes.
  • Working knowledge of at least one additional ISO/RTO (PJM, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, or ISO-NE) market rules and compliance frameworks.
  • Familiarity with applicable NERC Reliability Standards (FAC, BAL, IRO, TOP, COM, and related series) and their applicability to generation, transmission, and market participants.
  • Hands-on experience responding to ERCOT enforcement inquiries and preparing mitigation plans.
  • Multi-ISO/RTO compliance experience across two or more markets simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with ERCOT’s nodal settlement system.
  • Experience using compliance management tools.
  • Proven ability to manage multi-market compliance workstreams independently in a remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical, documentation, and organizational skills with exceptional attention to regulatory detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable translating complex regulatory requirements for non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work effectively as a self-directed remote employee, with strong time management and virtual collaboration skills.

Physical Requirements:

Must be able to sit or stand at computer for a reasonable length of time typing and reading. Regularly required to walk or stand. 100% of time is spent in the office environment, utilizing computers (frequent use of various Microsoft software/programs), phones, and general office equipment.
