ISP Network Support Engineer (BGP, MikroTik, Peplink, SD-WAN & Wireless) – Remote | U.S. Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
On-Call: Rotating after-hours emergency support — approximately 1 week per month

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re hiring an ISP Network Support Engineer for one of our clients to support customer-facing troubleshooting and production network operations across a growing multi-WAN ISP environment.

This is not a basic helpdesk role. You’ll work directly with live network infrastructure across fiber, fixed wireless, bonded WAN, Starlink, and SD-WAN deployments, troubleshooting complex connectivity issues and maintaining reliable, high-availability services.

You’ll work hands-on with technologies including MikroTik RouterOS, Peplink SpeedFusion, BGP, OSPF, Cambium, Ubiquiti, Siklu, Aviat, and enterprise wireless infrastructure.

This role is particularly well suited to someone with hands-on ISP, WISP, FTTH, or MSP experience who is comfortable troubleshooting production networks while communicating directly with customers.

What You’ll Own

Customer Network Support & Troubleshooting

  • Diagnose customer issues involving:
    • Connectivity and outages
    • Latency and packet loss
    • Routing instability
    • VoIP and call-quality problems
    • WAN and failover performance
  • Troubleshoot bonded WAN, SD-WAN, VPN, VLAN, and wireless connectivity issues.
  • Support routers, firewalls, and Customer Premise Equipment (CPE).
  • Investigate issues across multiple layers rather than simply escalating tickets.
  • Document troubleshooting steps, root causes, and configuration changes.
  • Communicate technical findings clearly to business customers.
  • Advise customers on redundancy, failover, and network optimization.
  • Participate in rotating after-hours emergency support.

ISP Network Operations

  • Monitor and maintain:
    • Edge routing infrastructure
    • Wireless backhaul systems
    • Bonded WAN infrastructure
    • Core ISP services
  • Provision and configure customer network deployments.
  • Configure:
    • Routers
    • VLANs
    • Firewall rules
    • NAT
    • QoS
    • VPNs
  • Diagnose BGP and OSPF routing issues, routing loops, WAN instability, and failover events.
  • Maintain configuration backups, firmware updates, IP documentation, and network hardening standards.

MikroTik, Peplink & SD-WAN

  • Configure and troubleshoot MikroTik RouterOS environments.
  • Support Peplink SpeedFusion and InControl2.
  • Troubleshoot multi-WAN bonding and failover behavior.
  • Support hybrid connectivity involving:
    • Fiber
    • Fixed wireless
    • Starlink
    • 5G
    • Terrestrial WAN connections
  • Optimize redundancy and high-availability configurations.

Fixed Wireless & Backhaul Infrastructure

  • Support fixed wireless environments using:
    • Cambium
    • Ubiquiti
    • PTP/PMP architectures
  • Work with high-capacity wireless backhaul technologies including:
    • Siklu
    • Aviat
    • mmWave infrastructure
  • Support tower deployments, backhaul upgrades, and infrastructure expansion.
  • Troubleshoot signal, connectivity, capacity, and backhaul performance issues.

VoIP & QoS

  • Troubleshoot SIP and VoIP quality issues.
  • Diagnose network conditions affecting voice traffic.
  • Configure and optimize QoS policies.
  • Prioritize latency-sensitive traffic appropriately.
  • Help maintain consistent voice quality across multi-WAN environments.

Documentation & Configuration Management

  • Maintain accurate:
    • Network diagrams
    • IP documentation
    • Device configurations
    • Troubleshooting records
    • Configuration backups
  • Document root-cause findings and remediation steps.
  • Keep infrastructure documentation current following network changes.
  • Help reduce repeat incidents through accurate documentation and preventative improvements.

Technical Environment

You may work across:

Routing & Networking

  • MikroTik RouterOS
  • BGP
  • OSPF
  • TCP/IP
  • VLANs
  • NAT
  • QoS
  • VPNs

SD-WAN & Multi-WAN

  • Peplink
  • SpeedFusion
  • InControl2
  • Starlink
  • 5G
  • WAN bonding and failover

Wireless & Backhaul

  • Cambium
  • Ubiquiti
  • Siklu
  • Aviat
  • PTP/PMP
  • mmWave

Enterprise Wi-Fi

  • Cambium cnMaestro
  • UniFi

Voice

  • SIP
  • VoIP
  • QoS and voice optimization

Required Experience & Skills

  • Hands-on networking experience within an ISP, WISP, FTTH, MSP, or similar production network environment.
  • Strong experience troubleshooting:
    • Routing
    • Switching
    • WAN connectivity
    • Network outages
    • Failover systems
  • Hands-on experience configuring:
    • Routers
    • Firewalls
    • VLANs
    • VPNs
  • Strong understanding of:
    • TCP/IP
    • NAT
    • QoS
    • VLANs
    • BGP
    • OSPF
  • Ability to troubleshoot live production networking issues methodically.
  • Strong documentation and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and customers.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Availability for rotating after-hours emergency support.

Strongly Preferred

  • Hands-on MikroTik RouterOS expertise.
  • Experience with Peplink, SpeedFusion, and InControl2.
  • Experience with:
    • Cambium
    • Ubiquiti
    • Siklu
    • Aviat
  • Fixed wireless or WISP deployment experience.
  • PTP/PMP and mmWave backhaul experience.
  • Starlink or hybrid WAN experience.
  • VoIP troubleshooting experience involving:
    • SIP

    • Voice-quality optimization
  • Experience supporting multi-WAN and high-availability network environments.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’ve worked on real production networks, not only lab environments.

In short: you help keep production ISP infrastructure stable, scalable, and highly available while solving complex customer and network issues across modern wired, wireless, and SD-WAN environments.

Key Metrics for Success

Why This Role Stands Out

About Us

At Quartermaster AI, we leverage cutting-edge AI and robotics technology to enhance maritime domain awareness. Our mission is to become the eyes, ears, and brain of the ocean by enabling every vessel to collaboratively sense, compute, and communicate. Quartermaster is a venture-backed Maritime Domain Awareness company providing near real-time insights to government and commercial partners via our SmartMast product. SmartMast is a COTS sensor system consisting of a camera, a software defined radio, and a proprietary onboard AI component installed on vessels worldwide, and managed by Quartermaster.

About the Role

As Head of Launch for Africa, you will lead Quartermaster's expansion across one of the world's most diverse and fast-evolving maritime regions. This is a high-stakes, dual-mandate role: you will serve as our chief diplomat and operational strategist. You will be responsible for proactively de-risking our business across a wide range of jurisdictions and regulatory regimes, while identifying and securing the maritime partnerships that anchor Quartermaster's growth. Success in this role is measured in SmartMast™ units installed, activated, and reporting on Africa’s coastal waters.

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Strategy & Market De-risking

  • Government & Regulatory Relations: Build and maintain proactive relationships with national maritime authorities, port authorities, and regional bodies across Africa’s varied regulatory landscape.
  • Policy & Compliance Mapping: Anticipate regulatory shifts, trade restrictions, and policy changes across the continent's overlapping port state control regimes, including the Abuja MoU and Indian Ocean MoU, along with continent-wide frameworks such as the African Union’s 2050 Africa’s Integrated Maritime Strategy, and develop strategies to neutralize risks before they impact operations.
  • Compliance Leadership: Partner with Legal and Compliance to ensure every market launch aligns with local labor, customs, trade, spectrum and equipment type-approval, data handling, and maritime safety requirements.

Market Entry & Local Infrastructure

  • Market Entry Playbooks: Develop scalable, repeatable launch strategies adaptable to the political, economic, and infrastructure realities of individual African markets.
  • Import & Logistics Setup: Establish the import, customs, and logistics framework needed to bring SmartMast™ hardware into target markets, including initial warehousing and staging ahead of deployment.
  • Vendor Ecosystem Development: Identify, vet, and onboard local installers, fabricators, and port-side vendors capable of supporting SmartMast™ deployment to Quartermaster’s quality and safety standards.

Maritime Stakeholder Engagement

  • Stakeholder Mapping & Outreach: Identify, engage, and convert commercial fleet operators, independent vessel owners, port authorities, and maritime organizations suitable for SmartMast™ deployment.
  • Partnership Structuring: Negotiate and close partnership and space-use agreements (the right to mount and operate our hardware on a vessel) that secure vessel capacity and long-term maritime relationships for Quartermaster.
  • Partner Onboarding: Oversee the transition from signed agreement to operational integration, ensuring new fleet, port, and vendor partners meet Quartermaster’s quality, safety, and performance standards from day one and that Field Operations can deploy without delay.
  • Relationship Management: Build durable, trust-based relationships with fleets, ports, and maritime organizations that build brand trust and reduce bureaucratic friction ahead of deployment.

Regional Leadership

  • Team Building: Recruit, scale, and mentor a local, cross-disciplinary team spanning field operations, market support, and stakeholder relations.
  • Cross-Functional Orchestration: Align global product, engineering, legal, and marketing teams with the specific requirements of the African market.
  • Market Intelligence: Serve as the primary feedback loop to Quartermaster leadership on regional dynamics, technical requirements, and localized risks.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience: 8+ years in senior operations, market launch, business development, or public policy roles, ideally within maritime, logistics, or other highly regulated sectors.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep understanding of the political, regulatory, and business diversity across Africa’s coastal regions and maritime economies.
  • Diplomatic Edge: Proven track record navigating government relationships, regional maritime bodies, and public-private partnerships across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Commercial Acumen: Demonstrated success closing complex B2B partnerships, joint ventures, or fleet agreements in emerging or frontier markets.
  • Execution Focus: A bias for action. The ability to draft a market entry plan in the morning and negotiate a stakeholder partnership in the afternoon.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English is required. Professional proficiency in French, Arabic, Portuguese, or Swahili is highly preferred.

About Lokal

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online. This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

    • Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
    • Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
    • Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
    • Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
    • Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
    • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
    • Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
    • Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.

We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.

  • Stay updated with the latest products, services, and promotional offers.
  • Train & Onboarding new Wellness buddy as per Guidelines of App.

You have experience working in financial aid administration and understand the importance of accuracy, compliance, and attention to detail when managing federal student aid. You are process-driven and organized, with the ability to manage competing priorities while consistently producing high-quality work. You naturally catch errors, ask questions when something doesn't seem right, and take ownership of your work. jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Effort estimate

Tasks for this project are estimated to take 20 hours to complete, depending on complexity. This is an estimate and not a schedule requirement; you choose when and how to work. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Up to $30/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

Additionally, this position is responsible for leading people and projects.

Essential Responsibilities

Data Analysis

  • Perform other duties as needed.

Experience and/or Education

Required

  • Minimum 6 years’ experience in quality improvement, population health or a related field, including minimum 4 years data analytics experience (including Tableau and SQL)
  • OR
  • Bachelor’s degree in social science, science, or math with minimum 5 years’ experience in quality improvement, population health or a related field, including minimum 3 years data analytics experience
  • OR
  • Master’s degree in data analytics (e.g., health informatics, biostatics, business, data analytics, etc.), public health, or health administration with minimum 3 years’ experience in quality improvement, population health, or related field, including minimum 2 years data analytics experience

Preferred

  • Experience with people and/or project leadership
  • SQL for Snowflake experience

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required

Knowledge

  • Advanced knowledge of program evaluation methodologies and analytic strategies in a payer managed care setting or advanced skills in data visualization
  • Advanced knowledge of healthcare quality metrics (e.g. CCO incentive measures, Medicare Stars measures, HEDIS or other measure sets)
  • Advanced knowledge of population health, quality of care concepts and methodologies, and FQHCs, as well as concepts of community health and social determinants of health
  • Working knowledge of health equity, inclusion and diversity frameworks and how to apply them to data analytics

Skills and Abilities

  • Strong understanding of SQL
  • Advanced proficiency with computer software programs, e.g. MS Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint
  • Advanced proficiency with MS Excel for data analysis and skills with large administrative database reporting functions and/or relational databases

  • Strategic thinker with ability to gather and analyze data, assess effectiveness of healthcare systems and work with system partners to develop, implement and evaluate Triple Aim improvement strategies
  • Understanding and ability to facilitate integration of clinical QI models and methods into existing programs
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Excellent communications skills to include: verbal, written, presentations, meeting facilitation and reports, specifically including the ability to present statistical and technical data in a clear and understandable manner utilizing appropriate visual aids and effectively facilitate and coordinate the work of a workgroup (including internal and external members) engaged in quality improvement activities
  • Ability to interface with and assist external stakeholders (providers, OHA staff, etc.)
  • Accountable, self-starter, able to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Possess a high degree of initiative and motivation along with the ability to effectively collaborate and plan with coworkers and others
  • Can independently manage timelines and deliverables with minimal supervision
  • Leadership capability and basic understanding of managerial concepts and techniques in areas such as work planning, training, delegating, coaching, mentoring, and evaluating.

  • Ability to identify solutions, collaborate with management team, generate consensus, and motivate staff toward results

  • Ability to learn, focus, understand, and evaluate information and determine appropriate actions

As an operational partner within our GTM ecosystem, you understand Salsify’s product, our field dynamics, and our cross-functional delivery motions. Reporting directly to the Senior Manager of GTM Operations, you will support the day-to-day execution of our commercial and services operations engine, focusing on operational coordination, services capacity planning, and team collaboration rather than deep technical data modeling or heavy system architecture.

Your objective is to leverage your organizational skills and collaborative mindset to keep our sales, marketing, and global services teams running efficiently. You will assist with GTM request triage, help coordinate tool access, manage staffing allocation tracking, maintain operational playbooks, and support general team needs using Google Sheets and core GTM tools. To maintain operational focus, the Senior Manager of GTM Operations will act as your strategic shield, handling high-level program escalations, technical roadblocks, and cross-departmental prioritization conflicts on your behalf.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as a central, collaborative hub between Sales, Marketing, Global Services, and Revenue Operations to support smooth deal handoffs, team bandwidth updates, and operational alignment.
  • Process Documentation & Knowledge Base: Maintain and organize standard operating procedures (SOPs), service playbooks, and change logs in Confluence and Google Docs, keeping team enablement tools searchable, clean, and accessible.
  • General Reporting & Administrative Assistance: Assist in gathering, organizing, and formatting operational inputs using Google Sheets to support routine capacity summaries, pipeline updates, team performance decks, and ad-hoc operational reporting requests.

Core Responsibilities & Focus Areas

  • 40% | Services Capacity Planning & GTM Operational Coordination Staffing Scheduling & Capacity Tracking: Assist in managing consultant availability, scheduling, and project assignments within Kimble, maintaining up-to-date visibility into services capacity and utilization targets.
  • Request Triage & Coordination: Assist in triaging incoming GTM support requests, ensuring field inquiries regarding tools, staffing allocations, or process updates are addressed or routed promptly.
  • Cross-Functional Handoff Support: Coordinate administrative steps as deals transition from sales to active implementation, ensuring services delivery teams are properly assigned in Kimble and aligned with project scope.
  • 40% | Reporting Assistance, Documentation & System Coordination Google Sheets & Reporting Support: Utilize Google Sheets to consolidate data, build tracking templates, and format routine operational summaries, team availability updates, and performance slides for operations leadership.
  • Documentation Maintenance: Support the ongoing creation, formatting, and organization of GTM and Services playbooks, workflow guides, and team enablement sites to ensure a clear "single source of truth."
  • System & Administrative Support: Provide basic administrative support across core GTM and Services platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Kimble, Gong, or Jira), assisting frontline users with user updates, basic troubleshooting, and process guidance.
  • 20% | Ticket Queue Facilitation, Stakeholder Alignment & Team Support Queue Triage: Act as a helpful first line of contact for day-to-day operational inquiries, escalating complex system configurations or architectural changes to senior ops leadership.
  • Feedback Gathering: Maintain regular touch-points with delivery leads, sales reps, and marketing managers to gather feedback on daily process friction and tool usability.
  • Cross-Functional Backup: Proactively provide coverage, administrative backup, and operational support across other areas of the operations team as needed to ensure continuous business coverage.

You'll Enjoy This Role If You Have:

  • Seamless Services Capacity Planning: Scheduling updates and capacity tracking in Kimble are maintained accurately, allowing delivery and sales managers to easily assess team bandwidth and assignment availability.
  • High Team Collaboration & Growth: You are viewed as a proactive, dependable operational partner who excels at cross-functional communication and shows readiness to take on broader RevOps, Services Ops, or GTM Strategy initiatives over time.
  • Effective Upward Collaboration: You work in tight lockstep with your Senior Manager, proactively surfacing scheduling bottlenecks, data gaps in Google Sheets, and field requests so they can manage priorities on your behalf.
  • Reliable Operational Backup: Routine administrative tasks, documentation updates, and support requests are handled efficiently, keeping broader GTM commercial and services operations organized and fully supported.

Seize your opportunity as Solution Architect on the Centers for Medicaid & Medicare Services (CMS) Hosting, Operations, and Maintenance (HOM) program. At GDIT, people are our differentiators. The Solutions Architect (SA) will be strategizing multi-year roadmaps to enable business growth, ensure compliance and reduce the complexity of key business and IT processes.

The Solution Architect (SA) will play a vital role across the enterprise IT landscape, defining the applications, establishing architecture principles, support/lead cloud transformation, developing enterprise frameworks, decommissioning or transforming legacy applications, data migration, security, privacy, etc. The SA will also be mentoring the team to move an organization toward its target architecture.

The Solution Architect provides strategic and technical leadership across the CMS HIGLAS Hosting, Operations, and Maintenance (HOM) program. This role defines multi‑year technology roadmaps, drives architectural modernization, and ensures solutions are scalable, secure, and compliant. The SA works across ERP, cloud, data, AI/ML, and security domains while guiding teams toward a target enterprise architecture.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Solution & ERP Architecture

  • Lead end‑to‑end architecture for complex Oracle ERP environments (EBS R12.2, Hyperion, Oracle Identity and Access Management, OKTA, OBIEE/Oracle Analytics Server (OAS) , and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)).
  • Translate business requirements into secure, scalable solution designs and architectural documents.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise standards and recommend ERP modules, extensions, and third‑party solutions.

Cloud Architecture & Integration

  • Design ERP and adjacent applications for OCI and other cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Architect hybrid/multi-cloud models, network/security patterns, and integration frameworks (REST, SOAP, event‑driven, messaging).
  • Collaborate with middleware teams on SOA, Oracle Integration Cloud, and ERP performance optimization.

Artificial Intelligence(AI) and Machine Learning (ML), Analytics & Automation

  • Identify and architect AI/ML, analytics, and automation use cases for ERP processes.
  • Partner with data/ML engineers to define pipelines, models, and reference architectures for AI‑enabled applications.
  • Promote governance, MLOps, and adoption of automation/RPA to enhance operational efficiency.

Data, Security & Compliance

  • Work with data architects on data models, warehouses/lakes, and analytics solutions.
  • Ensure data quality, governance, and compliance with security and regulatory frameworks (HIPAA, FedRAMP).
  • Define and enforce security controls including IAM, SSO, encryption, and access models.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Governance

  • Partner with CMS stakeholders to align solutions with strategic objectives.
  • Lead architecture reviews, workshops, and enterprise standards development.
  • Support portfolio planning, prioritization, and governance (including ARB participation).

Delivery Support & Continuous Improvement

  • Provide technical leadership through design, testing, cutover, and hyper care.
  • Conduct impact analysis, resolve complex issues, and drive solution optimization.
  • Evaluate technology strategy, perform gap analyses, and lead proof‑of‑concept efforts.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience & Education

  • Bachelor’s or master’s in computer science, IT, or related field.
  • 15+ years in technology and solution architecture for large Oracle ERP environments.
  • Experience in federal, large commercial, or complex IT environments.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep ERP knowledge: Oracle EBS, Hyperion, Oracle SOA, IAM, OAS/OBIEE, RAC, Exadata.
  • Strong enterprise, solution, and cloud architecture capabilities (TOGAF, OCI/AWS/Azure).
  • Integration experience across SOA, microservices, APIs, event‑driven architectures.
  • AI/ML and analytics experience with cloud platforms, MLOps, and BI tools (such as Oracle Analytics Server, Incorta, or similar).
  • Strong understanding of security, compliance, High Availability (HA) / Disaster Recovery (DR), and performance tuning.

Professional Skills

  • Strong problem‑solving, consensus‑building, communication, and leadership abilities.
  • Skilled in creating architectural artifacts, roadmaps, and standards.

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized and proactive Virtual Assistant (VA) to provide reliable executive, administrative, CRM, and operational support.

This is not a passive administrative role. You’ll serve as an execution partner, helping keep calendars, communication, records, projects, and day-to-day priorities organized and moving forward.

You’ll work across multiple business functions and may support founders, executives, clients, vendors, and internal teams.

If you’re someone who takes initiative, communicates professionally, and makes sure nothing falls through the cracks, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Calendar, Inbox & Executive Support

  • Prioritize important emails and flag time-sensitive requests.
  • Draft professional:
    • Emails
    • Memos
    • Documents
    • Internal communications
  • Prepare meeting agendas and notes.
  • Track action items and follow-ups after meetings.
  • Help executives stay organized and focused on their highest-priority work.

CRM & Data Management

  • Maintain accurate records within CRM platforms such as:
    • HubSpot
    • Salesforce
    • Zoho
  • Update contacts, activities, notes, and relevant business information.
  • Maintain spreadsheets using Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel.
  • Review records for missing, duplicate, or outdated information.
  • Ensure business data remains accurate, organized, and accessible.

File & Document Management

  • Maintain organized digital filing systems using:
    • Google Drive
    • Dropbox
    • Microsoft SharePoint
  • Create consistent folder structures and naming conventions.
  • Keep documents organized, searchable, and up to date.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, and business documents when needed.

Research & Task Execution

  • Conduct online research related to:
    • Competitors
    • Vendors
    • Market opportunities
    • Business initiatives
  • Organize findings into clear summaries, spreadsheets, or presentations.
  • Handle ad hoc administrative and operational requests.
  • Support small projects from assignment through completion.

Client & Vendor Communication

  • Respond to routine client inquiries or route them to the appropriate person.
  • Follow up with vendors, clients, and internal stakeholders.
  • Track outstanding requests and ensure timely completion.
  • Maintain professional and responsive communication across stakeholders.

Operations & Project Support

  • Maintain project and task trackers using tools such as:
    • Asana
    • Trello
    • Notion
    • Monday.com
  • Track deadlines, priorities, and outstanding action items.
  • Support invoicing and expense tracking.
  • Assist with light bookkeeping when required.
  • Help maintain organized operational workflows.
  • Identify missing information, overdue tasks, or potential bottlenecks and follow up proactively.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely succeed in this role if you:

  • Are highly organized and detail-oriented.
  • Take initiative instead of waiting for constant instructions.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally.
  • Follow through until tasks are fully completed.
  • Can manage multiple responsibilities without losing track of details.
  • Learn new systems and processes quickly.
  • Are comfortable working independently.
  • Understand the importance of confidentiality and professionalism.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 1–2+ years of experience as a Virtual Assistant, Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, or Operations Support professional.
  • Strong proficiency with:
    • Google Workspace
    • Microsoft Office
  • Experience managing calendars, meetings, and professional communication.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  • Reliable high-speed internet and professional remote work setup.
  • Ability to work during U.S. business hours.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Zoho.
  • Familiarity with QuickBooks or Xero.
  • Experience with project management tools such as Asana, Monday.com, Trello, or Notion.
  • Experience supporting:
    • Founders
    • Executives
    • Startups
    • U.S.-based businesses
    • Remote teams
  • Experience supporting multiple executives or clients simultaneously.
  • Basic reporting, spreadsheet, or operational tracking experience.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing the executive’s calendar and inbox, identifying urgent requests, confirming meetings, and organizing priorities.

Throughout the day, you’ll update CRM records, prepare documents or reports, conduct research, coordinate meetings, follow up with clients and vendors, and keep project trackers current.

Before finishing, you’ll review outstanding tasks and make sure priorities and follow-ups are organized for the next day.

In short: you keep communication, administration, and operations organized so the people you support can stay focused on higher-value work.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Tasks completed accurately and on time.
  • Minimal scheduling errors or missed meetings.
  • Fast and professional communication.
  • Accurate and up-to-date CRM records.
  • Organized files and documentation.
  • Consistent completion of follow-ups.
  • Strong stakeholder satisfaction.
  • Reliable day-to-day operational execution.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High ownership and autonomy.
  • Exposure to multiple areas of business operations.
  • Direct collaboration with executives, clients, and teams.
  • Opportunity to develop CRM, project management, and operational skills.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Executive Assistant
    • Senior Virtual Assistant
    • Project Coordinator
    • Operations Coordinator
    • Operations Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  3. Practical Administrative / Operations Task
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you have experience in virtual assistance, executive support, administration, or operations and are known for being organized, proactive, and dependable, we’d love to hear from you.

This is a strong opportunity for someone who wants to build a career in executive support, CRM management, and business operations.

jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Effort estimate

Tasks for this project are estimated to take 20 hours to complete, depending on complexity. This is an estimate and not a schedule requirement; you choose when and how to work. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Up to $50/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

About the Company 

At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business.A leader in autonomous driving since 2007, Torc has spent over a decade commercializing our solutions with experienced partners. Now a part of the Daimler family, we are focused solely on developing software for automated trucks to transform how the world moves freight. Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer. 

Meet The Team:

The Pseudo-Labeling team's goal is to create high-quality annotations on sensor data (images, point clouds). The annotations include 2D, 3D bounding boxes, classes, trajectories, lane lines, segmentations, depths, and high-definition map elements. The annotations are then used by different downstream users — for example, perception teams use them to train various models, mapping teams use them to build and maintain HD maps, and simulation teams use them for generating new data.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design, implement, test and deploy offline 3D reconstruction, lane line detection, and automatic mapping/map creation modules to generate high-quality annotations on Cloud Services from logged sensor data (Cameras, Lidars, Radars, GPS/IMU).
  • Build and refine lane line annotation pipelines, applying the latest lane line detection and creation machine learning models to automate and scale map creation.
  • Develop and improve pose estimation algorithms to support accurate localization, sensor fusion, and 3D scene reconstruction.
  • Demonstrate project management skills, serving as project lead guiding less experienced team members in multiple facets of project execution.
  • Stay up to date with the latest developments in AI and ML for autonomous driving, 3D reconstruction, and automated mapping.
  • Independently develop offline perception and mapping models or algorithms using disciplined software development processes, making recommendations for developing new code or re-using existing code, implementing version control, and maintaining documentation of created applications.
  • Define and implement ingestion, data preparation, curation, and governance of large, multi-faceted data sets supporting analytics models and workflows.

  • Develop guidelines and standards for analytics and machine learning models, their deployment, and associated processes.
  • Provide technical guidance or business process expertise, technical leadership, coaching and mentoring to team members.

  • Considered highly skilled and proficient in discipline; conducts complex, important work under minimal supervision and with wide latitude for independent judgment.
  • Scope of Influence: Expected to drive alignment across team interfaces to the rest of the organization. Designs, maintains and owns team technical solutions and drives consensus. Mentors and guides engineers within the group.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering or related technical field plus demonstrated competencies and technical proficiencies typically acquired through 6+ years of experience OR;
  • Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering or related technical field plus demonstrated competencies and technical proficiencies typically acquired through 3+ years of experience OR;
  • Required Qualifications (some combination of the following skills):
    • Experience in lane line annotation creation or automatic mapping/map creation.
    • Familiarity with the latest lane line detection and creation machine learning models.
    • Familiarity with pose estimation.
    • Active Learning & Pseudo-labeling – Computer Vision, Deep Learning, Model training.
    • Two of the following: 2D/3D Object Detection, Tracking, Sensor Fusion, Semantic Segmentation, SLAM, BEV.
    • Scaled ML Operations (MLOps) and Tooling – ML Frameworks, experiment tracking, model registry, MLflow, Weights and Biases, ML Metrics and Evaluation / Quality.
    • Distributed machine learning frameworks – PyTorch, Lightning, Ray.
    • Model Data Curation – Parquet data processing (PyArrow, Daft, Pandas, etc).
    • Development Tools & Eco-System (at scale) – Proficiency in Python software development. Also, VDI and cloud-based development environments, CI Systems (GitHub Actions), and Docker.

Bonus Points!

  • PPK/RTK (Post-Processed Kinematic / Real-Time Kinematic) GPS experience.
  • GIS (Geographic Information Systems) experience.

Improve affordability, network performance, provider collaboration, and clinical value through physician leadership and provider influence.

Network, contracting, provider relations, market leadership, clinical operations, analytics, actuarial, finance, and provider organizations.

Market-facing physician leader with responsibility for translating relationships and insights into measurable affordability and network outcomes.

We're a remote-first company with a collaboration hub in downtown Kitchener — and we're growing.

📌 About the Role

Restoration contractors choose Encircle because the first conversation feels different: people who know their industry, understand their business and show them exactly how Encircle makes them money. As Senior Account Executive, you'll own the full sales cycle - prospecting, discovery, demo, proposal and close - for a book of restoration, independent adjusting and multi-location accounts.

This is an end to end sales position. You’ll be held accountable to hunting your own deals, not just working the marketing funnel. You'll build pipeline of your own alongside meetings sourced by our BDR team, and you'll be coached to the same formula every AE runs on: discovery and demo, demo-to-proposal, proposal-to-close, sales cycle length and ACV, using the SPICED methodology and the documented playbook. As a senior member of the team, you're expected to perform at or above benchmark, take on the more complex, multi-stakeholder deals — franchise locations, multi-site operators, independent adjusting relationships — and help sharpen the playbook for the reps coming up behind you.

You'll work closely with Onboarding & Activation and Account Management so every new customer starts with a plan, and with our BDR team so sourced pipeline converts cleanly into revenue.

🔧 What You'll Be Doing

Own the full sales cycle

  • Prospect and build pipeline in your territory: self-sourced outbound plus inbound and BDR-sourced meetings, managed as one connected funnel
  • Run discovery, demo, proposal and negotiation using SPICED and the documented playbook, converting at or above benchmark at every stage
  • Build and defend a monthly forecast — pipeline coverage, stage conversion and deal velocity you can stand behind
  • Own deal strategy for complex, multi-stakeholder accounts: franchise and network structures, multi-location operators and independent restoration relationships

Be the trusted advisor restoration contractors remember

  • Run demos and presentations tailored to the room, from field crews to owners and executive leadership
  • Build account-based plans for named target accounts, including multi-location and franchise prospects

Close clean and hand off cleaner

  • Close deals with signed contracts and accurate CRM data that sets up a smooth transition
  • Partner with Onboarding & Activation on a mutual onboarding plan at the point of close, so every new customer starts strong
  • Partner with Account Management on account context and handoff for multi-location and franchise-influenced accounts

Raise the bar for the team

  • Mentor newer AEs through call reviews, deal strategy and territory planning as a senior peer on the team
  • Lead by example on activity and pipeline discipline, hitting or exceeding published benchmarks

Collaborate across the business

  • Partner with BDRs on outbound targeting, meeting quality and handoff feedback
  • Partner with Marketing on lead quality, campaign feedback and product-led buying signals
  • Feed win-loss insights, objection patterns and competitive intelligence back to Marketing and Product

Key Metrics You'll Own

•Pipeline coverage

•Stage conversion rates vs. benchmark

•ACV and product attach rate

•Sales cycle length

•Forecast accuracy

Immediate Priorities

In your first few months, you'll ramp to the formula and start proving it:

1.Complete onboarding and ramp to full quota productivity on the defined timeline

2.Build pipeline to target coverage against quota within your first 90 days

3.Run discovery, demo and proposal stages at or above published benchmarks

4.Close your first deals with a clean, documented handoff to Onboarding & Activation

✅ What You'll Bring

🤝 Why Encircle?

jobs.description:
Job Title: Solutions Engineer

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Solutions Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Solutions Engineer, you are the technical owner of the merchant relationship from first sales conversation through live integration and beyond. You will focus on our enterprise and strategic merchants: the national retailers and high-volume brands running custom, hand-built integrations across web, mobile app, and in-store. These are our most complex merchants and our largest revenue drivers, and they do not come with an off-the-shelf plugin.

You will partner with Sales, Product, and Engineering to scope what a merchant needs, design the integration that gets them there, and stay with them once they are live. You own the technical side of pre-sales: demos, architecture discussions, RFP responses, and solution proposals. When a merchant needs something custom, you define the requirement, shape the solution with our engineering team, and drive it to launch.

This is a customer-facing engineering role. You will spend as much time on calls with merchant developers as you will in documentation and test environments, and you need to be credible in both rooms.

This role combines technical expertise and sales acumen to support sales teams. They work closely with the sales team and clients, understanding customer needs and translating them into effective, tailored solutions. Acting as a bridge between technical and business functions, a Solutions Engineer not only helps demonstrate and implement the product’s capabilities but also communicates complex technical details in a way that resonates with clients. Their role requires both the ability to engage with customers directly and the technical know-how to ensure the product meets client requirements effectively.

What You'll Do:

  • Own technical discovery for prospective merchants: understand their stack, their checkout flow, and their constraints, then map them to the right Sezzle integration path
  • Lead product demos and technical presentations for merchant engineering and business stakeholders
  • Design integration solutions across our API, SDKs, and platform plugins (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, WooCommerce, Wix, and custom builds)
  • Write technical proposals and complete RFP and security questionnaire responses
  • Support merchant mobile app integrations: SDK implementation, in-app checkout, and native versus webview handoff
  • Validate integrations in sandbox and in production before launch, including checkout flow, widget and messaging placement, redirect and handoff behavior, and settlement
  • Troubleshoot live integration issues alongside Support and Engineering, and own the technical narrative back to the merchant
  • Translate recurring merchant needs into product feedback, and push for the fixes that unblock revenue
  • Build and maintain integration documentation, runbooks, and internal enablement so the team scales without you in every call
  • Act as the trusted technical advisor for your merchants after launch, spotting optimization opportunities they haven't asked for yet

What We Look For:

  • 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role: solutions engineering, sales engineering, implementation, solutions architecture, or technical account management
  • Experience with mobile SDK integrations on iOS and Android, including the ability to guide merchant mobile developers through implementation and debug what breaks
  • Experience supporting enterprise merchants through complex, multi-stakeholder integrations with custom-built commerce stacks
  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs, webhooks, and reading API documentation critically
  • Working knowledge of web technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
  • Familiarity with at least one major e-commerce platform (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, WooCommerce, Wix) and how payment methods integrate into it
  • Understanding of e-commerce workflows: cart, checkout, payment authorization and capture, refunds, shipping, and product management
  • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences, and business context clearly to engineers
  • Strong written communication. You will produce documentation and proposals that merchants and internal teams rely on
  • Comfort managing several merchant integrations at once in a fast-moving environment
  • Ability to read code in at least one language well enough to debug a merchant's implementation
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools effectively in day-to-day work, including research, technical documentation, problem-solving, and workflow automation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at a payments company, PSP, or BNPL provider
  • Familiarity with payment gateway architecture and how alternative payment methods are surfaced at checkout
  • Experience with in-store or omnichannel payment integrations
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

  • Represent Anthesis externally through conferences, industry events, and other forums, strengthening our position as a leader in LCA and sustainability.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

Service Operations Support

  • Maintain accurate customer records, notes, and follow-up tasks.

Administrative & Reporting Support

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

Experience

Technical Skills

Nice-to-Have

Tools & Platforms

  • ServiceTitan
  • Microsoft Excel
  • Google Sheets
  • CRM & Service Management Platforms
  • Microsoft Office
  • Google Workspace

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Highly organized with excellent multitasking abilities.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Calm, solution-oriented, and composed during busy periods.
  • Takes ownership of issues and follows through until resolution.
  • Thrives in fast-paced, customer-focused environments.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review incoming service requests and technician schedules.
  • Answer customer inquiries and schedule appointments.

Why This Role Stands Out

jobs.excerpt: About PacasoPacaso exists to enrich lives by making second home ownership possible and enjoyable for more people.
jobs.description:
About Pacaso

Pacaso exists to enrich lives by making second home ownership possible and enjoyable for more people. We've reimagined the second home category — pairing a thoughtfully designed co-ownership model with simplified financials, equitable scheduling, and dedicated local property management, so owners get the joy of a true second home without the hassle.

Since launch, Pacaso has facilitated more than $1.2 billion in gross real estate transactions and service fees across 40+ destinations in the U.S., Mexico, and Europe — including Aspen, Lake Tahoe, Napa, Malibu, Palm Springs, Cabo, Paris, London, and most recently Florence, Milan, and Rome. We've raised over $300 million in cumulative equity funding, closed the largest real estate Regulation A+ offering of 2025, and reserved the Nasdaq ticker PCSO as we build toward a public listing.

Our work has been featured in The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, Fortune, Forbes, CNBC, Bloomberg, and others.

Recognition

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for both our culture and our category-defining work:

  • No. 5, Forbes America's Best Startup Employers (2026) — our second consecutive Top 10 ranking
  • Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2025)
  • Winner, 2025 Inman Best of Proptech Awards — Consumer Experience & Marketplace Innovation
  • Fortune & Great Place To Work Best Workplaces in Real Estate (2024)
  • Best Workplace in the Bay Area™ (2023)
  • LinkedIn Top Startup (2022) · Glassdoor Best Places to Work, #6 (2022)

Social & Influencer StrategistThe Social & Influencer Strategist owns Pacaso's social presence and influencer strategy end to end, bringing a strong point of view, a data-driven mindset, and experience growing audience, reach, and engagement through effective social tactics and AI tools. This role requires experience working with high-end, luxury brands and the ability to translate that fluency into social content that reads as elevated and intentional.

The Strategist operates as an expert in social strategy, building a content calendar grounded in performance data. Fluency in social listening tools, data analysis, and social platforms such as Hootsuite is required. This person will also be proficient in AI tools, (we use Claude here!) and building AI systems for social frameworks. This role also requires experience developing and running influencer programs and is expected to own that function fully, from creator identification through negotiation and campaign management.

This role sits on the brand team alongside content production, which is owned by Pacaso's Creative team. While content creation is not the main responsibility, this role does require a strong visual eye: sharp instincts for photo selection, working knowledge of high-end photography and editing, and the ability to edit video content.

Core Responsibilities

Social Strategy and Growth

  • Develop Pacaso's foundational social strategy across Instagram, LinkedIn, Threads, and YouTube, with a channel-specific approach to content, format, and voice rather than a single asset repurposed across every platform
  • Conduct ongoing social listening and trend tracking across the luxury, design, travel, wealth, and wellness landscape, translating findings into brand-right recommendations for growth; partner cross-functionally with PR and Sales to ensure social strategy stays aligned with broader brand and business priorities
  • Report out on performance on a standard cadence, with new initiatives defined based on trends and insights. Bring new ideas and recommendations to marketing leadership with a clear point of view and the data to support it.
  • Use AI tools, social listening platforms, and performance analytics to inform content, campaign, and growth decisions

Content & Cadence

  • Run a daily publishing rhythm across all social channels, including proactive scheduling and management through Hootsuite or similar social management tools
  • Maintain fluency in Pacaso's brand voice, messaging pillars, and underlying brand story, applying that understanding consistently across all content
  • Collaborating with the brand and production team, as well as Product team, maintain a content calendar populated at least two weeks ahead at all times, working independently and bringing fresh ideas to the table

Influencer Strategy, Brand Partnerships, and Executive Communications

  • Build Pacaso's influencer program from the ground up: identify, source, and vet creators in the luxury, design, travel, economics/entrepreneur/wealth, and wellness spaces
  • Own outreach, rate negotiation, contracting, briefing, content development, and campaign management through delivery and reporting
  • Develop a collaboration pipeline with high-end brands and names
  • Manage and write LinkedIn content for Pacaso's CEO, along with additional thought leadership content as needed

Community & Reporting

  • Monitor and engage with Pacaso's social communities, responding to comments and DMs in an authentic, brand-aligned way
  • Own performance reporting and run regular competitive analysis, bringing findings forward with clear, actionable recommendations

Candidates should have:

  • Experience running social for a brand where the bar was high and the audience was discerning- luxury, design, hospitality, real estate, travel, premium consumer
  • A strong, well-formed point of view on brand and content, with the confidence to advocate for it and push back when needed
  • Proven proficiency in building AI-driven workflows and advanced experience working with a wide range of AI tools to optimize social strategy and content creation
  • Direct experience negotiating with influencers and their representation; experience managing influencer agency relationships a plus
  • Fluency in performance data, with the ability to translate it into a clear recommendation, not just a report
  • Strong, concise writing skills, with the range to write convincingly in a brand's or executive's voice
  • Experience operating independently at a senior level, with the judgment to build systems rather than rely on oversight
  • A genuine expert in social platforms and emerging formats, with curiosity and enthusiasm toward testing new tools and methods
  • Experience working alongside sales teams, using social as a true tool to increase and improve conversion rates
  • Working knowledge of media monitoring tools and practices, and genuine fluency in how PR and press coverage intersect with brand and social strategy

Compensation

  • Around $125,000 with equity

Why You'll Love Working Here

We invest in our Crew the way we invest in our homes — thoughtfully, generously, and with care.

  • Competitive base salary and meaningful equity — every Crew member shares in what we're building
  • Discretionary time off — take the rest you need, when you need it
  • Premium medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family
  • Sponsored memberships to One Medical, Peloton, and WellHub for whole-person, modern healthcare
  • 401(k) to help you build long-term security
  • Paid parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers
  • Home office stipend and a monthly internet and cell phone reimbursement to set you up for great remote work
  • Quarterly team gatherings and ongoing learning and development investment

Our Commitment

Pacaso is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, ability, and background — including veterans and individuals with disabilities. We believe a Crew as diverse as the owners we serve makes Pacaso stronger, and we're committed to building a workplace where every voice belongs.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Design
jobs.excerpt: At RecargaPay, we’re on a mission to deliver the best payment experience for Brazilian consumers and small businesses, by building a powerful digital ecosystem where the banked and unbanked connect, and where consumers and merchants have a one-stop shop for all their financial needs.
jobs.description:
At RecargaPay, we’re on a mission to deliver the best payment experience for Brazilian consumers and small businesses, by building a powerful digital ecosystem where the banked and unbanked connect, and where consumers and merchants have a one-stop shop for all their financial needs.

We serve over 10 million users and process more than USD 4 billion annually. We’ve been profitable since 2022 and operate our own credit business. We are an AI-first, 100% remote team, scaling in the rapidly changing Brazilian financial market.

Our goal? Deliver the best payment experience in Brazil for people and small businesses alike.

We value autonomy, ownership, and a bias for action. We’re looking for people who are curious, hands-on, and driven by impact, who want to solve real problems, work with strong teams, and rethink what’s possible.

If you’re ready to do your best work, at scale, with purpose, this is your place.


Responsibilities

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer who takes ownership of the end-to-end experience within their squad, combining product thinking, data analysis, and craft to deliver solutions that work for users and drive business results.

What you'll do

  • Partner with PMs and engineers to define product strategy and shape experiences grounded in user needs and business goals;
  • Identify improvement opportunities proactively, formulating hypotheses and designing data-driven experiments to validate them;
  • Translate data-research findings and analytics into tangible product decisions;
  • Use AI tools actively to accelerate concept generation, iterate faster, and improve the quality of UX writing and design decisions;
  • Contribute to the Design System, maintaining and expanding it as the product evolves;
  • Collaborate across the UX team, including writers, frontend engineers, and DesignOps;
  • Raise the bar for design quality, with solid command of UI, usability, and interaction patterns;
  • Document your process and share knowledge with the team.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in Product Design, ideally within the Brazilian financial ecosystem;
  • Strong grasp of the end-to-end design process, with emphasis on fast prototyping and experimentation;
  • Ability to identify and prioritize opportunities, create experiments, and define success metrics collaboratively;
  • Fluency with AI tools as part of the daily design workflow, not as a novelty but as a productivity and quality multiplier;
  • Clear communication with cross-functional teams, especially engineering;
  • Familiarity with accessibility best practices and multi-device UX;
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in fast-paced, interdisciplinary environments;
  • Ability to present and defend design decisions to senior leadership and C-level stakeholders;
  • Owner mentality: business-oriented, data-driven, and accountable for results.

Benefits

  • Competitive and market-aligned salary.
  • Remote work — wherever you are, you’re part of the team!
  • Home office allowance through a monthly deposit in the RecargaPay app.
  • Health and dental plans with no co-pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Flexible meal allowance (via Flash).
  • TotalPass membership to take care of your health.

Diversity & Inclusion at RecargaPay

At RecargaPay, you’ll have the freedom to be who you are because we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us more creative and stronger. Here, everyone is welcome to express themselves authentically. We value the richness of each journey and the multiple ways of seeing the world, without distinctions of gender, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic that makes us unique.

About the use of your Data

By sharing your resume with us, you authorize the use of your data for analysis during the selection process and possibly for other opportunities within the RecargaPay group. You can request the update or deletion of your information at any time, in accordance with LGPD (General Data Protection Law).

Industry-Specific Knowledge

It is desirable to have practical familiarity with one or more core financial domains such as lending, payments, credit cards, open finance, fraud prevention, merchant acquiring, or investment services, along with an understanding of their fundamental workflows and business drivers. Experience in how these domains intersect to influence revenue, risk management, and customer satisfaction is highly valued.

Ideally, candidates will have applied this knowledge to deliver solutions such as loan-origination engines with real-time decisioning; scalable payment-processing platforms integrated with core banking systems and third-party gateways; secure open-finance interfaces compliant with industry regulations; automated fraud-detection pipelines leveraging behavioral analytics; or financial reporting and reconciliation engines for regulatory compliance. The ability to translate complex compliance mandates (e.g., KYC/AML, PCI-DSS, GDPR) into resilient, high-performance systems without compromising user experience is considered a strong asset.

jobs.title: Directeur médical adjoint-oncologie/ Associate Medical Director-Oncology (CAN)
jobs.excerpt: Chez Allucent™, nous nous engageons à aider les petites et moyennes entreprises biopharmaceutiques à naviguer efficacement dans l’univers complexe des essais cliniques afin d’offrir des traitements qui changent la vie aux patients qui en ont besoin partout dans le monde.
jobs.description:
Chez Allucent™, nous nous engageons à aider les petites et moyennes entreprises biopharmaceutiques à naviguer efficacement dans l’univers complexe des essais cliniques afin d’offrir des traitements qui changent la vie aux patients qui en ont besoin partout dans le monde.

At Allucent™, we are dedicated to helping small-medium biopharmaceutical companies efficiently navigate the complex world of clinical trials to bring life-changing therapies to patients in need across the globe.

Nous recherchons un directeur médical adjoint pour rejoindre notre équipe d’élite (télétravail). En tant que directeur médical adjoint chez Allucent, vous serez chargé de veiller, de manière autonome, à l’intégrité et à la qualité des aspects médicaux, cliniques et de sécurité des essais menés par Allucent. Vous servirez de personne-ressource en tant que moniteur médical dans les protocoles d’étude auprès des chercheurs et des équipes des centres d’étude pour toute question relative au protocole et à la sécurité des participants recrutés. Une expérience en oncologie est obligatoire pour ce poste.

We are looking for an Associate Medical Director to join our A-team (remote). As an Associate Medical Director at Allucent, you are responsible for working independently to ensure the medical/clinical and safety integrity and quality of trials conducted by Allucent, serving as the medical monitor contact in study protocols to investigators and study sites team regarding protocol related questions and safety of the subjects enrolled. Experience in Oncology is a requirement for this position.

Dans le cadre de ce poste, vos principales tâches consisteront à:

  • Fournir de manière autonome un soutien en matière de surveillance médicale aux études cliniques qui vous sont attribuées, par exemple en répondant aux questions d’ordre médical posées par l’équipe de l’étude et/ou le site, en aidant à l’interprétation du protocole et à l’examen médical des données générées, y compris, mais sans s’y limiter, les données de laboratoire clinique et les formulaires de rapport de cas, selon les besoins, afin de garantir le respect du protocole, la cohérence et la validité scientifique des données. Au besoin, et avec l’appui nécessaire de ses supérieurs, aider le gestionnaire de projet dans les discussions avec les clients concernant les questions ou les préoccupations liées à la sécurité qui pourraient avoir été soulevées.
  • Préparer les plans de surveillance médicale et autres plans pertinents pour les études assignées menées par Allucent avant le début de l’étude et conformément aux livrables prévus dans le contrat.
  • Examiner les événements indésirables graves, les SUSAR, les rapports de sécurité et effectuer l’analyse des événements similaires.
  • Assister l’équipe de gestion des données cliniques dans le codage MedDRA et OMS pour les essais assignés.
  • Contribuer à l’examen des documents relatifs aux études cliniques afin d’en vérifier la cohérence et la pertinence sur le plan médical, avec l’appui des membres chevronnés de l’équipe médicale au besoin, notamment, mais sans s’y limiter, le protocole d’essai clinique (CTP), le formulaire de consentement éclairé (ICF) et le rapport d’étude clinique (CSR), ainsi que d’autres rapports sur l’innocuité (p. ex., DSUR, PSUR)
  • Contribuer à la mise en place et à la conduite des comités de sécurité des données (DSMB, DMB ou équivalents) et des réunions d’augmentation de la dose (DEC)
  • Assister, participer et faire des présentations lors de la réunion de lancement, de la réunion des chercheurs et d’autres réunions pertinentes dans le cadre des projets attribués, selon les besoins.
  • Fournir un soutien médical d’urgence 24 heures sur 24, 7 jours sur 7, pour des conseils médicaux et de sécurité, au besoin
  • Assurer la formation des équipes de projet sur les aspects médicaux de l’essai et la formation thérapeutique, au besoin
  • Examen des écarts par rapport au protocole
  • Cerner les risques liés à l’étude et contribuer à l’élaboration du plan de gestion des risques
  • Examiner et comprendre les livrables médicaux de l’étude tels qu’ils sont définis dans le contrat de l’étude assignée, avec l’appui de collègues plus expérimentés, et contribuer au suivi des dépenses budgétaires tout au long des études qui leur sont confiées
  • Assiste à d’importantes conférences sur les traitements thérapeutiques et le développement de médicaments, et peut être amené à y faire une présentation
  • Assure une bonne communication et entretient de bonnes relations avec les (futurs) clients
  • Contribue et participe, avec le soutien de collègues plus expérimentés si nécessaire, aux évaluations des clients, aux visites et aux présentations d’offres

In this role your key tasks will include:

  • Independently provide medical monitor support to assigned clinical studies, for example answering medical questions from study team and/or site, assist with protocol interpretation and medical review of generated data including but not limited to clinical laboratory data and case report forms as necessary to ensure adherence to the protocol, consistency and scientific validity of the data. When appropriate, and with the necessary support from senior colleagues, assist the Project Manager in discussions with clients on safety issues or concerns that may have arisen
  • Prepare the Medical Monitoring and other relevant plans for assigned studies conducted by Allucent prior to the start of the study and in accordance to deliverables contracted.
  • Review Serious Adverse Events, SUSARs, safety narratives and perform Analysis of Similar Events
  • Assist clinical data management with MedDRA and WHO coding in assigned trials
  • Assist by reviewing clinical study documents for medical consistency and relevance, with support of senior medical team members if needed, including but not limited to the clinical trial protocol (CTP), the Informed Consent (ICF) and clinical study report (CSR) other safety reports (e.g., DSUR, PSUR)
  • Assist in the set up and conduct of Data Safety Boards (DSMB, DMB or similar) and Dose escalation meetings (DEC)
  • Attend, participate and present in Kick-Off, Investigators’ meeting, and other relevant meetings in assigned projects, as requested.
  • Provide 24/7 urgent medical support for medical and safety advice if required
  • Training of project teams on medical aspects of the trial and therapeutic training as required
  • Review of Protocol Deviations
  • Identify study risks and provide input to the Risk plan
  • Review and understand study medical deliverables laid down in the assigned study’s contract with support of senior colleagues and help track budget spent throughout their assigned study(ies)
  • Attends and may need to present at major therapeutic conferences and drug development conferences
  • Assure good communication and relationships with (future) clients
  • Contribute and take part with support from senior colleagues as needed in client evaluations, visits and bid defenses

Requirements

Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous devrez posséder :

  • Un diplôme de docteur en médecine (MD)
  • Expérience en tant qu’oncologue
  • au moins trois ans d’expérience professionnelle pertinente, avec une solide expertise en oncologie
  • Une bonne connaissance des normes GxP
  • Une situation en règle auprès des autorités de réglementation et d’agrément locales, provinciales (aux États-Unis) et nationales, ainsi qu’auprès des organismes de certification
  • Connaissance des exigences réglementaires applicables (locales), notamment celles du RGPD/HIPAA, du CFR/CTR/CTD
  • Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale, y compris une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais
  • Présentable, extraverti et axé sur le client
  • Capacité à travailler dans l’environnement dynamique et stimulant d’une entreprise en pleine croissance
  • Excellence administrative
  • Maîtrise requise de divers logiciels tels que Word, Excel et PowerPoint

To be successful you will possess:

  • MD degree
  • Experience as an Oncologist
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience with solid Oncology expertise
  • Good knowledge of GxP
  • Good standing with local, state (in the US), and national licensing and regulatory authorities and certifying bodies
  • GDPR/HIPAA, CFR/CTR/CTD and applicable (local) regulatory requirements understanding
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language
  • Representative, outgoing and client focused
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced challenging environment of a growing company
  • Administrative excellence
  • Proficiency with various computer applications such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint required

Benefits

Voici quelques-uns des avantages liés au fait de travailler chez Allucent :

  • Ensemble complet d’avantages sociaux selon le lieu de travail
  • Salaires concurrentiels selon le lieu de travail
  • Budget de formation et d’études alloué par service pour favoriser le perfectionnement professionnel
  • Horaires de travail flexibles (dans la mesure du raisonnable)
  • Possibilité de travail à distance ou hybride* selon le lieu de travail
  • Possibilités d’accéder à des postes de direction et de bénéficier d’un mentorat
  • Participation à notre programme de jumelage, que ce soit en tant que nouvel employé ou employé déjà en poste
  • Possibilités d’évolution interne et de progression de carrière
  • Programme de recommandation de candidats par les employés, financièrement avantageux
  • Accès à des formations en ligne sur les compétences générales et techniques via ADP et nos plateformes internes
  • Admissibilité à notre programme de primes ponctuelles, qui récompense les efforts exceptionnels déployés dans le cadre de projets
  • Admissibilité à notre programme de récompenses de fidélité, qui reconnaît la loyauté et l’engagement des employés de longue date

Avertissements :

*Notre politique de travail hybride favorise un milieu de travail dynamique et prévoit deux journées de présence au bureau par semaine pour les employés résidant à une distance raisonnable de l’un de nos bureaux à l’échelle mondiale.
