jobs.excerpt: Loan Coordinator / Lender Liaison (Mortgage Operations) – Remote | U.
jobs.description:
Loan Coordinator / Lender Liaison (Mortgage Operations) – Remote | U.S. Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Loan Coordinator / Lender Liaison to manage loan files and ensure they move efficiently from submission through closing.

You’ll serve as the primary coordination point between lenders, underwriters, and internal teams, maintaining clear visibility across every active loan and ensuring documentation, conditions, follow-ups, and deadlines stay on track.

This role is ideal for someone with experience in:

  • Mortgage operations
  • Loan processing
  • Loan coordination
  • Lender communication
  • Real estate financing

If you’re highly organized, proactive with follow-ups, and comfortable managing multiple deadline-sensitive loan files simultaneously, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Lender Communication

  • Serve as the primary point of contact with lending partners.
  • Maintain consistent communication throughout the loan lifecycle.
  • Follow up on:
    • Outstanding documentation
    • Underwriting conditions
    • Lender requests
    • Pending approvals
  • Communicate updates clearly to internal stakeholders.
  • Escalate issues proactively to prevent funding or closing delays.

Loan Pipeline Management

  • Track active loan files from submission through closing.
  • Review loan reports and lender updates daily.
  • Maintain accurate visibility into:
    • Current loan status
    • Outstanding conditions
    • Required documentation
    • Upcoming deadlines
    • Next steps
  • Identify bottlenecks before they impact closing timelines.
  • Ensure every active loan has clear ownership and follow-up.

Internal Team Coordination

  • Coordinate with internal teams to gather required documentation.
  • Manage responses to lender and underwriting requests.
  • Support timely submission of loan packages and updates.
  • Follow up proactively on outstanding internal items.
  • Keep stakeholders aligned on deadlines, requirements, and closing timelines.

Documentation & File Management

  • Maintain complete and organized loan files.
  • Ensure lender correspondence and documentation are properly recorded.
  • Keep CRM and loan management systems accurate and current.
  • Verify file completeness before important milestones.
  • Maintain clear records throughout the entire lending process.

Closing Coordination

jobs.description:
Suppliers remember two things about a business: whether it pays correctly, and whether it pays on time. You will be the reason the answer is yes to both.

Job Overview

Our UK-based client is hiring a full-time, remote Accounts Payable Clerk based in South Africa. You will own the purchase ledger: capturing invoices, matching them to orders, resolving queries and preparing payment runs with clockwork reliability. This is a long-term role on UK business hours.

About Our Client

The client is an established UK business with steady supplier volumes and a finance team that values accuracy over drama. They want a payables professional who treats the ledger as their own - clean, current and audit-ready at any moment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Capture and code supplier invoices accurately into the accounting system
  • Match invoices to purchase orders and delivery notes, investigating mismatches
  • Reconcile supplier statements and resolve queries promptly
  • Prepare weekly and monthly payment runs for approval
  • Maintain clean vendor records and chase missing documentation
  • Support month-end close with accruals and ledger housekeeping
  • Flag duplicate, unusual or suspicious invoices before they cost money

What You Will Be Doing Day-to-Day

Your day starts with the invoice inbox: capturing, coding and routing everything that arrived overnight. You will work through matching exceptions, contact suppliers about discrepancies, and keep the query log short and honest.

As payment runs approach you will prepare schedules, double-check details, and make sure approvals happen on time. At month-end you will reconcile statements and hand the ledger to the accountant in a state that needs no apology.

This suits a South African professional who is precise, methodical and quietly proud of a clean ledger. You know the difference between fast and rushed - and you never confuse the two with other people's money.

If you are based in South Africa with solid payables experience and good English, this is a stable remote career with a UK employer that respects careful finance work. Apply today.

Requirements

  • 2+ years' experience in accounts payable or bookkeeping
  • Good written and spoken English for supplier and team communication
  • Proven reliability: stable fibre internet, backup power for load shedding, and a quiet home office
  • Confident with tech tools: Xero, Sage or QuickBooks, plus Excel or Google Sheets
  • Meticulous accuracy with numbers, coding and reconciliations
  • Trustworthy, deadline-driven and calm under month-end pressure

Benefits

Full-time remote position working for a UK-based employer. Competitive salary paid in ZAR. Long-term stable role. Supportive team environment. Direct access to founder-led business.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.excerpt: Help Universities Discover Human Potential.  Become a Trusted Partner.
jobs.description:
Help Universities Discover Human Potential. Become a Trusted Partner.

The best customer relationships begin with trust: understanding what a partner is trying to achieve, helping them work through difficult challenges, and showing up with insights when it matters.

At Acuity Insights, those conversations happen in a uniquely meaningful context. We partner with higher education institutions making some of the most important decisions they’ll make: who gets the opportunity to enter a profession, how potential is understood beyond grades alone, and how learners are supported throughout their journey.

As our next Customer Success Manager, you’ll build trusted partnerships with admissions leaders, educators, and program teams, helping them realize the full value of our products while uncovering new opportunities to deepen those relationships over time.

This is a Customer Success role where helping customers realize long-term value naturally leads to renewals, growth, and lasting partnerships. The difference is how you get there. Our strongest partnerships grow because customers trust our guidance, see meaningful outcomes, and choose to deepen their relationship with us over time.

If you enjoy turning thoughtful conversations into trusted partnerships and meaningful growth, you’ll find work here that reaches far beyond the account itself.

This is a fully remote role open to candidates based anywhere in Canada.

Before you apply: Thoughtful use of AI is encouraged. If you use it to support your application, please make sure it helps communicate your experience clearly and accurately. The strongest applications are authentic, original, and unmistakably yours.

The Work You’ll Do

In your first few weeks, you’ll immerse yourself in our customers’ world. You’ll learn how admissions and learner development work across higher education, get to know the institutions in your portfolio, and build a deep understanding of the challenges they’re trying to solve.

You’ll gradually take ownership of your portfolio, giving you the opportunity to understand each institution, build meaningful relationships, and grow your confidence before independently managing your full portfolio. You’ll have the autonomy to own your customer relationships while knowing you’ll always have experienced teammates to collaborate with as you begin leading customer conversations, supporting renewals, and identifying opportunities to create value for the institutions you support.

You’ll support a diverse portfolio of higher education institutions across North America, building long-term relationships with admissions leaders, educators, and program teams. While much of your work happens remotely, you’ll also have opportunities to meet customers in person through campus visits, conferences, and industry events because some of the strongest partnerships are built face to face. Your workday will naturally align with the time zones of the customers you support.

As your confidence grows, you’ll become a strategic partner to your customers. You’ll lead renewal conversations, identify opportunities for growth, and help institutions navigate new challenges as their needs evolve. You’ll connect customer needs with the broader capabilities of Acuity, helping institutions get more value from the solutions they use today while identifying opportunities where we can support them in new ways.

You’ll also join us at an exciting point in the evolution of Customer Success at Acuity. We’re intentionally building a more strategic, and customer-centered approach to partnering with our institutions. You’ll help shape that evolution by working closely with Sales, Product, and cross-functional teams to strengthen the customer experience and contribute to the next chapter of Customer Success.

What You’ll Help Make Possible

The relationships you build will have an impact far beyond your own portfolio. You’ll help higher education institutions get more value from their partnership with Acuity while contributing directly to our growth and the continued evolution of Customer Success.

Build partnerships customers want to grow.
Develop trusted, long-term relationships that help institutions achieve meaningful outcomes and choose to continue growing with Acuity year after year.

Help customers solve bigger challenges.
Understand where your customers are headed and connect them with the products, insights, and support that help them achieve their goals. Growth follows because you’re creating genuine value, not pursuing opportunities for their own sake.

Bring the voice of the customer into Acuity.
Share customer insights across Product, Sales, Marketing, and other teams, helping shape better products, stronger customer experiences, and smarter business decisions.

Help define the next chapter of Customer Success.
As Customer Success continues to evolve at Acuity, you’ll contribute ideas, refine playbooks, and help shape a more strategic, commercially accountable, and customer-centered function.

The impact of your work will be visible in stronger customer relationships, healthier renewals, meaningful commercial growth, and institutions that continue choosing Acuity as a trusted partner. More importantly, every partnership you strengthen helps educators make better decisions about people and gives more learners the opportunity to be seen for their full potential.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role isn’t about quick wins. It’s about earning trust, creating momentum, and delivering meaningful outcomes for both your customers and the business.

In your first three months, you’ll have built a strong understanding of your customers, their goals, and the challenges they’re working to solve. You’ll be confidently managing your initial portfolio with support from your team, establishing a healthy renewal rhythm, and beginning to identify opportunities to deepen customer partnerships over time.

By the end of your first year, you’ll be a trusted advisor to your customers, confidently leading renewals, navigating complex conversations, and contributing directly to retention and revenue growth. You’ll have helped customers adopt new capabilities where they create meaningful value, strengthening both their success and Acuity’s.

Throughout the year, you’ll build strong habits around customer health, proactive communication, and thoughtful account planning. Your customers will know they can count on you, your teammates will value your perspective, and your insights will help shape decisions across Customer Success, Product, Sales, and beyond.

As Customer Success continues to evolve, you’ll contribute ideas, refine playbooks, and help shape how we continue raising the bar. You’ll be part of a team that’s building a more strategic, commercially accountable, and customer-centered approach to partnering with our customers.

Who You’ll Work With

You’ll report to the leader of our Assessments Customer Success function, joining a team that’s intentionally evolving how we partner with customers.

Customer Success is deeply collaborative at Acuity. You’ll work closely with colleagues across the business to create a seamless experience for our customers and help shape how we grow.

Sales, to ensure smooth handoffs, align on growth opportunities, and create a consistent customer journey.

Product, to bring customer insights into roadmap conversations and help shape the future of our products.

Marketing, to share customer stories, identify emerging needs, and strengthen how we communicate the value of our solutions.

Support Operations, to remove friction quickly, coordinate through critical customer moments, and ensure institutions have confidence in every interaction with Acuity.

The best ideas rarely come from one team alone. Some of your biggest contributions will come from connecting people, bringing the voice of the customer into the business, and helping teams make better decisions because of those insights.

How You’ll Succeed Here

There’s no single profile for success in this role. But the people who thrive here tend to share a few things in common. They’re curious, thoughtful, strategically minded, and genuinely invested in helping their customers succeed.

You stay curious.
You want to understand the problems your customers are trying to solve, not just the products they use. You ask thoughtful questions, connect information from different sources, and uncover opportunities others might miss.

You build expertise.
You enjoy learning. Whether it’s our products, admissions processes, or the higher education landscape, you know that the best customer conversations are grounded in deep understanding, not surface-level knowledge.

You take ownership.
You see your portfolio as something you own, not something you manage. When something is unclear or still evolving, you move work forward, follow through, and stay engaged until there’s a clear outcome.

You communicate with clarity and confidence.
You’re thoughtful, direct, and comfortable having difficult conversations when they’re needed. You create clarity, build trust, and help people move forward together.

You thrive in change.
You’re energized by growth and comfortable working in an environment that’s continually evolving. You adapt quickly, stay resilient when priorities shift, and use new tools, including AI, thoughtfully to work more effectively and better support your customers.

You balance customer success with commercial thinking.
You understand that lasting customer relationships and strong business outcomes go hand in hand. You’re comfortable leading renewals, identifying opportunities for growth, and helping customers invest where they’ll see genuine value.

Experience That Will Help You Hit the Ground Running

There’s no single path into this role, and we don’t believe great Customer Success talent is measured by years of experience alone. What matters most is that you’ve had the opportunity to build customer relationships, take ownership of outcomes, and grow from those experiences.

You’ll likely bring experience in:

  • Customer Success, account management, consulting, implementation, or another customer-facing role where you’ve owned customer relationships or a portfolio of accounts.
  • Guiding customers through implementation, adoption, and renewals while balancing customer value with business outcomes.
  • Building relationships with multiple stakeholders, navigating challenging conversations, and earning trust over time.
  • Using CRM and Customer Success platforms such as Salesforce, ChurnZero, or similar tools.
  • Working independently in a remote environment with a high degree of ownership, sound judgment, and initiative.
  • Supporting customers across North American time zones.

If you’re earlier in your Customer Success career but have demonstrated exceptional curiosity, ownership, and a track record of building trusted customer relationships, we’d still love to hear from you.

How We Support You

  • Transparent compensation. A salary between $85,000 - $110,000 CAD, aligned to role scope, experience, and internal equity.
  • Learning that grows with you. A $3,000 annual learning budget to invest in your development, whether that’s deepening technical skills, building confidence, or exploring new areas of interest.
  • Shared success. Access to employee stock options, so you share in the value you help create.
  • Remote-first work. Fully remote within Canada, with up to six weeks per year to work internationally.
  • Time to rest and reset. Self-directed vacation (most teammates take 4–6 weeks annually), monthly Acuity Days (a collective Friday off), plus a two-week company-wide closure each December.
  • Comprehensive care. Health benefits from day one for you and your dependents.
  • Future-focused support. A 2% GRSP matching program to help you plan ahead.
  • Support for growing families. A 16-week parental leave top-up beyond EI, available to all parents.

What Happens After You Apply

We review every application carefully. Whether you apply directly, are referred, or connect through a recruiter or hiring manager, you’ll receive equal consideration.

We don’t use AI to evaluate applications, though you may be automatically screened out if you don’t meet baseline requirements (e.g. Canadian residency and valid work authorization). In some interviews, AI may help with note-taking, but all evaluations and decisions are made by real humans.

Our interviews are two-way conversations. We want to understand your career, abilities, and goals, and help you assess whether this opportunity and team are the right fit for you.

Steps in the Process

Our hiring process typically takes 2–4 weeks from initial conversation to final decision.

  • Application Review. A real person reviews your application for potential fit.
  • Intro Conversation. A conversation with a member of our Talent team to learn about your career journey, what you’re looking for next, and to introduce you to Acuity, Casper, and the role.
  • Hiring Manager Conversation. A conversation about how you build trusted customer relationships, navigate ambiguity, and balance customer outcomes with commercial success. You’ll also have the opportunity to learn more about the evolution of Customer Success at Acuity, the portfolio you’ll support, and the challenges we’re working to solve alongside our partners.
  • Team Conversations. You’ll meet members of our Customer Success and Growth Enablement & Execution teams to explore how we work together across the customer journey. It’s also an opportunity for you to ask questions, get to know future teammates, and see what it would be like to work together day to day.
  • Decision. The hiring manager reviews feedback from the interview team and typically makes a decision within 2 to 4 business days.
  • Offer & Reference Checks. If it’s a match, we’ll move to references and a formal offer.

Life at Acuity Insights

We’re a remote-first team of 140+ people who care deeply about our work and about each other.

Our culture is intentionally designed. As we’ve grown, we’ve made deliberate choices about how we work together, prioritizing trust, flexibility, and a sustainable pace so people can do meaningful work over the long term.

That commitment has been recognized externally. Acuity Insights has been named one of Canada’s Top Small & Medium Employers for the second consecutive year, reflecting our focus on building a strong, people-first environment.

Day to day, that shows up in how we collaborate:

  • High trust and autonomy in how work gets done
  • Thoughtful, async-friendly communication across a distributed team
  • Space for deep work, balanced with intentional moments of connection
  • A culture grounded in care, curiosity, and shared purpose

As we continue to grow, we’re focused on maintaining that balance, building a company where people can do their best work and grow over time, without losing what makes the environment feel human.

About Acuity Insights

Acuity Insights builds products that help higher education institutions make better decisions about people, from admissions through to development.

Our work is grounded in a simple idea: that people are more than their grades, and that potential can be understood and developed, not just measured.

Our Casper situational judgment test (SJT), created by researchers at McMaster University, has been completed by over 1 million applicants and is one of the most widely used open-response SJTs in higher education, backed by nearly 20 years of research.

Today, we are evolving our products to better connect assessment, insight, and development, helping institutions not just identify potential, but actively support its growth over time.

Who We Are:

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

Disclaimer: We're currently on the lookout for potential candidates to join our talent pool via this job listing. Your qualifications will be assessed for both present positions and future opportunities. Should your skills align with a role and an opening arise, our recruitment team will reach out to you promptly. However, please keep in mind that this doesn't guarantee immediate placement or communication.


A day in the life:

A Creative Strategist will be the lead ideator on strategic accounts. They are required to have a robust understanding of paid social creative best practices, their client’s brand, performance goals, historical data, current ecommerce trends, and consumer behavior, to develop winning paid social advertising that impacts their client's growth.

Creative Strategists know how to act fast to capitalize on good results, or on the flip side know what to change if an ad isn’t performing to their goal. This means testing with the intention of moving the needle on key performance metrics — from improving CPA, CTR, or ROAS to driving brand awareness. Creative Strategists pitch new ideas and concepts to clients, write scripts, and follow the execution and review of ads through to production and delivery to clients.

An ideal candidate for the Creative Strategist role is a self-starter who is passionate about maximizing success for their clients through creative strategy, and is eager to take the lead on developing creative concepts that are intentionally produced to generate clear testing results and insights. They have mastered presenting creative reporting to clients and team members through storytelling, and are constantly implementing learnings to enhance future campaign results. Sr. Creative Strategists are zealous about continuously testing various creative concepts to develop a strong understanding of how to not only effectively and efficiently meet client goals, but to surpass them. If creative deliveries are not meeting client expectations, or creative tests are not hitting target goals, Sr. Creative Strategists will be relentless in the pursuit to troubleshoot and problem solve with a growth mindset.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Leads the paid social creative strategy for 8-10 clients
  • Using data insights along with consumer and brand research to design high performing creative assets
  • Collaborating closely with team members across internal departments and roles
  • Maintaining client communications and sentiment
  • Driven to iterate and ideate towards stated performance goals
  • Develops rapport with client to build a foundation of open discussion, including understanding client product and goals, as well as explaining Power Digital processes
  • Researches client brand, competitors, and industry trends, and effectively implements performance creative best practices by platform
  • Continually audits account to identify winning ads, present data to client, and dictate hypotheses and test strategy via monthly roadmaps
  • Writes strategic consumer-centric, direct response copy and messaging strategy
  • Manages requests and output with production team using Asana
  • Reviews video/image assets and provides clear and actionable feedback to editors
  • Leads productive internal creative team syncs and brainstorms
  • Works alongside client management team as client POC for all things creative strategy
  • Understands scope of requested edits, reshoots, and other deliverables
  • Pushes back on client on matters of timeline, scope, feedback, and direction to drive performance based on creative best practices
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements:

  • Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, and/or similar performance data tools (TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, etc)
  • Technically skilled at pulling and using creative performance data to analyze trends, insights, and inform creative roadmaps
  • Understanding of best practices for performance-driven creative & ability to apply these insights in work
  • Ability to write effective ad copy, structure a script, and see through on the execution with corresponding visuals
  • Ability to communicate and collaborate with clients, production, and post-production teams to deliver best possible creative output
  • Ability to yield strong campaign results for clients through strategizing top performing creative

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Job Title: Bilingual Medical Virtual Assistant (Dental)

Position type: Full-Time

Work hours: 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM Pacific Daylight Time

Work days: Monday to Friday

Salary: $6 - $8 per hour, depending on experience

Workplace: Remote

Preferred Candidate Location: Philippines

About the role

We are seeking an experienced, highly organized, and patient-focused Bilingual Medical Virtual Assistant (Dental) to provide front-desk, scheduling, insurance, and administrative support for a busy U.S.-based dental practice.

This is a patient-facing role that requires fluency in both English and Spanish, excellent phone communication skills, and the ability to confidently manage a high volume of patient interactions throughout the day. You will serve as an important point of contact for patients, helping them schedule appointments, understand treatment-related costs, complete necessary follow-ups, and navigate insurance-related processes.

In addition to virtual reception responsibilities, you will support insurance verification, treatment plan preparation, co-payment collection, claim creation, and coordination with the practice's external billing company. You will also help keep the appointment schedule organized and ensure patient communications and administrative tasks are handled accurately and on time.

The ideal candidate has previous dental or healthcare administrative experience and understands the importance of balancing efficiency with compassionate patient service. Dentrix experience is highly preferred, while familiarity with Delta Dental and Weave is a significant advantage.

We are looking for someone who is reliable, proactive, detail-oriented, and eager to become a long-term member of the team. The practice values quality, accuracy, professionalism, and finding the right person for the role rather than simply filling the position quickly.

Scope of Work / Responsibilities

Virtual Reception & Patient Communication

  • Answer and manage a high volume of inbound patient calls professionally
  • Serve as a friendly and knowledgeable first point of contact for patients
  • Respond to patient questions and route inquiries appropriately
  • Manage patient communications through the Weave phone and communication platform
  • Maintain a professional, compassionate, and patient-focused approach during every interaction

Appointment Scheduling & Patient Follow-Up

  • Schedule, confirm, and reschedule patient appointments
  • Maintain an organized and optimized appointment schedule
  • Conduct patient follow-ups regarding appointments and treatment plans
  • Help reduce scheduling gaps and ensure appropriate follow-up is completed
  • Follow practice-specific scripts, workflows, and scheduling procedures

Insurance Verification & Treatment Coordination

  • Verify patient insurance eligibility and benefits, primarily through Delta Dental
  • Review relevant insurance information before appointments
  • Prepare treatment plans with detailed fee and patient cost breakdowns
  • Communicate treatment-related financial information clearly and professionally
  • Collect patient co-payments according to practice procedures

Claims & Billing Coordination

  • Create insurance claims for submission and coordination with the external billing service
  • Coordinate with the practice's billing company regarding claim processing and follow-ups
  • Maintain accurate insurance and billing-related documentation
  • Follow up on outstanding information when necessary to keep claims moving efficiently

Administrative Support

  • Maintain accurate and organized patient information within Dentrix
  • Provide general front-desk and administrative support
  • Complete assigned documentation and patient-related administrative tasks
  • Learn and consistently follow the practice's customized workflows, scripts, policies, and procedures
  • Assist the team with additional administrative responsibilities as needed

Top 3 Priorities

1. Virtual Reception & Call Management

Provide professional bilingual phone coverage, manage a high volume of inbound patient calls, address inquiries, and ensure patients receive timely and helpful assistance.

2. Patient Follow-Up & Administrative Support

Manage scheduling, appointment confirmations, treatment plan follow-ups, and day-to-day administrative responsibilities while maintaining an organized patient experience.

3. Insurance Verification & Billing Coordination

Verify insurance eligibility and benefits, prepare treatment-related cost information, create claims, collect co-payments, and coordinate effectively with the external billing team.

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

Bilingual Communication

  • Fluency in both English and Spanish is required
  • Excellent spoken and written communication skills in both languages
  • Confident communicating with patients over the phone
  • Able to explain scheduling, insurance, treatment, and payment information clearly and professionally
  • Compassionate and patient-focused communication style

Dental & Healthcare Administrative Experience

  • Previous dental or healthcare administrative experience is strongly preferred
  • Experience in a patient-facing dental or medical office role is highly desirable
  • Experience supporting a U.S.-based dental or healthcare practice is preferred
  • Familiarity with dental front-desk workflows, scheduling, treatment coordination, or insurance processes is a strong advantage

Scheduling & Patient Support

  • Experience managing appointment scheduling, confirmations, rescheduling, and patient follow-ups
  • Comfortable managing a high volume of calls and appointments
  • Strong customer service and patient interaction skills
  • Ability to stay calm, organized, and professional during busy periods

Dental Insurance & Billing Coordination

  • Experience with insurance eligibility and benefits verification
  • Comfortable navigating insurance portals and reviewing patient coverage
  • Experience preparing or supporting treatment plans and patient cost breakdowns
  • Comfortable collecting co-payments and discussing patient financial responsibility professionally
  • Experience creating insurance claims and coordinating with billing teams is strongly preferred
  • Comfortable working with an external billing service and following up on insurance-related tasks

Systems & Software Experience

The practice currently uses:

  • Dentrix – Primary dental practice management/EHR system
  • Delta Dental – Primary insurance platform for eligibility and benefits verification
  • Weave – Phone and patient communication platform

Hands-on Dentrix experience is highly preferred. Familiarity with Delta Dental and Weave is also a significant advantage.

Candidates should be tech-savvy, quick to learn, and comfortable adapting to the practice's customized systems and workflows.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Bilingual in English and Spanish
  • Experienced in dental or healthcare administration
  • Confident handling high-volume patient calls
  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail
  • Comfortable with insurance verification and billing coordination
  • Professional and compassionate when communicating with patients
  • Proactive and able to anticipate administrative needs
  • Reliable, dependable, and consistent
  • Able to multitask effectively in a busy dental environment
  • A quick learner who follows instructions and established processes carefully
  • Comfortable working independently while remaining collaborative with the practice team
  • Interested in a stable, long-term opportunity
  • Fully committed to the required Monday through Friday work schedule

Basic Requirements

  • Must be fluent in both English and Spanish
  • Must have relevant dental, healthcare, or administrative work experience
  • Must be able to submit an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory)
  • Must be available for video meetings with camera on when required

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

jobs.excerpt: Who we areAdlib is the AI Production Layer for regulated industries.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Adlib is the AI Production Layer for regulated industries. We turn complex, unstructured documents into governed, validated, AI-ready data so that enterprises can make defensible decisions without rebuilding their stack.

For insurance carriers, that means agentic intake across the documents that drive the business: FNOL packets, police reports, medical records, adjuster notes, loss runs, submissions, endorsements and certificates. Adlib classifies, extracts, validates and scores each document for trust, then hands clean data to the core systems and AI models already in place. Customers see 60% fewer exceptions, 50% faster cycle times and 70% less manual handling.

On top of that trusted data layer sits our agentic intake capability. Agents read the packet, decide what it is, apply carrier rules, route the exception and trigger the next action in the workflow. The document layer establishes trust in the data. The agentic layer acts on it. Together they take work out of the claim file rather than simply digitizing it.

We are model-agnostic and system-agnostic by design. We sit in front of Guidewire, Duck Creek, Sapiens, Majesco and the rest of the core stack rather than replacing any of it. Adlib is backed by Diversis Capital and serves Fortune 1000 customers across insurance, life sciences and public sector.

Who you are

You have sold enterprise software into insurance and you know the difference between selling to a Chief Claims Officer and selling to IT. You can walk into a claims operation, understand where documents create leakage and cycle time, and translate that into a business case a COO will sign.

You are a hunter. This is a new logo territory build across North America, focused on mid-market and upper mid-market carriers, MGAs, TPAs and brokers, with cross-sell into the existing base. You want the ownership that comes with an open field, and you are comfortable being measured on it.

You are credible in an AI conversation without overpromising. Our biggest competitive risk is being boxed as "just another OCR or IDP tool." You will need to hold the line on the trust layer and agentic intake story, in front of buyers who have been pitched by every extraction vendor in the market and are now being pitched agentic AI by their core platform vendor as well.

The details

Role

Account Executive, Insurance

Territory

North America (United States and Canada)

Reports to

General Manager, Insurance

Location

Remote, North America. Approximately 30% travel.

Target start date

September 15, 2026

$125,000 – 145,000 USD

What you will own


  • Build and own the North America insurance new logo territory. Source, qualify and close new business against a $1M annual new ARR target, with a disciplined focus on the ~15 named ABM accounts in the insurance vertical plus self-sourced expansion.
  • Executive access. Run multi-threaded deals across Claims, Underwriting, Operations, IT and Data or AI leadership. Reach and hold the attention of Chief Claims Officers, Chief Underwriting Officers, COOs, CIOs and Chief Data Officers.
  • Domain depth. Become fluent in how claims and underwriting actually run: FNOL and loss intake, adjuster workflows, subrogation, SIU and fraud referral, submission triage, policy issuance and endorsements, and the document handoffs that slow each one down.
  • Technical fluency. Understand where Adlib sits relative to the core platform. Be able to whiteboard the flow from document intake through validation and agentic routing into Guidewire ClaimCenter or Duck Creek, and explain what changes for the adjuster and the underwriter.

  • Sell the agentic intake story on business outcomes, not model hype. Defend the trust and governance layer against core platform vendors and extraction point tools now claiming the same ground.
  • Partner leverage. Work with our Strategic Partnerships lead and the insurance SI ecosystem, including Guidewire-connected implementation partners, to source and co-sell partner-originated opportunities.
  • Forecast rigor. Keep Salesforce clean and your forecast honest. Weekly pipeline and forecast discipline is non-negotiable, and the number you call is the number we take to the Board.
  • Land and expand. Land a first use case, prove trust and accuracy against a defined baseline, then expand across lines of business and adjacent processes.

What you bring

  • Insurance sales experience. 5+ years closing complex enterprise software into insurance carriers, MGAs, TPAs, brokers or reinsurers, with a track record of quota attainment at or above $1M in new ARR.
  • Core process knowledge. Direct experience selling into or working within claims, underwriting, policy administration or compliance functions. You understand the claims lifecycle end to end and can speak to loss ratio, expense ratio, cycle time, leakage and straight-through processing.
  • Systems familiarity. Working familiarity with the insurance core and content stack: Guidewire (ClaimCenter, PolicyCenter, BillingCenter), Duck Creek, Sapiens, Majesco, Origami Risk or Insurity, plus content platforms such as OnBase, ImageRight, FileNet or SharePoint. You do not need to configure them. You do need to know how data moves through them.
  • Data and regulatory context. Comfort with ACORD forms and standards, ISO forms, unstructured claim and submission documents, and the data quality problems that come with them. Awareness of NAIC and state DOI expectations, HIPAA where health data is in scope, and audit and retention requirements.

  • You can craft and deliver a business case, not a feature tour. You can present to a room of C-level executives and to a technical evaluation team on the same day, and be equally credible in both.

  • Disciplined use of a structured sales methodology (MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or equivalent), with accurate CRM hygiene and forecasting.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Existing relationships with insurance systems integrators and Guidewire or Duck Creek implementation partners.
  • Experience selling in a private equity backed environment with a clear growth mandate.
  • Canadian market experience alongside the United States.
  • Prior work at a carrier, MGA or TPA in claims or underwriting operations.

What is in it for you

Working closely with architects, software teams, silicon designers, and external IP partners, you will translate HPC/AI workload requirements into scalable CPU architectures that optimize performance, power, and area (PPA) while enabling future HPC/AI computing platforms. This role is ideal for an architect/micro-architect who enjoys working across hardware and software boundaries, defining next-generation compute architectures, and shaping how CPUs and HPC/AI workloads work together.

This role isremote, based out of North America.

Who You Are

  • Passionate about designing next-generation compute architectures for AI, HPC, and large-scale datacenter systems.

  • Collaborative technical leader who enjoys influencing cross-functional engineering teams.

  • Experience defining architectural specifications and leading cross-functional teams from concept through silicon implementation.
  • Experience with RTL development with cutting edge AI frontier models.

What You Will Learn

  • Gain deep expertise in the co-design of CPUs, AI accelerators, and memory subsystems.

Customer Success Manager – HVAC & Plumbing | Inbound Sales & Scheduling

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Customer Success Manager with HVAC and/or plumbing industry experience to handle inbound customer calls, convert service inquiries into booked appointments, coordinate scheduling, and deliver an excellent customer experience.

This is not a passive customer support role. Your performance will directly impact bookings, revenue, membership sales, and customer retention.

You’ll be the first point of contact for customers who need HVAC or plumbing services, helping them understand their options, confidently guiding the conversation, and getting the right service booked quickly.

If you have experience in the home services industry and know how to turn inbound calls into appointments without sacrificing customer experience, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Inbound Calls & Appointment Booking

  • Handle high-volume inbound HVAC and plumbing service calls.
  • Convert customer inquiries into confirmed appointments.
  • Assist customers with:
    • Emergency service requests
    • Repairs and maintenance
    • Scheduling inquiries
    • General service questions
  • Ask the right questions to understand the customer’s needs.
  • Build appropriate urgency and confidence to maximize booking rates.
  • Maintain a professional, helpful experience on every call.

Scheduling & Dispatch Coordination

  • Schedule service appointments accurately based on customer needs and technician availability.
  • Coordinate with dispatch and field teams to maintain an efficient schedule.
  • Categorize service requests correctly.
  • Capture complete customer and appointment information.
  • Follow scheduling and dispatch procedures consistently.
  • Help minimize scheduling conflicts and missed opportunities.

Membership Sales & Upselling

  • Introduce HVAC and plumbing maintenance memberships when appropriate.
  • Recommend relevant additional services based on customer needs.
  • Explain membership benefits clearly and confidently.
  • Handle common objections without being overly aggressive.
  • Contribute toward membership, booking, and conversion targets.

Customer Experience & Retention

  • Provide empathetic, solutions-focused customer service.
  • Handle frustrated or concerned customers calmly.
  • Ensure customers feel heard, informed, and supported.
  • Resolve routine concerns while escalating issues appropriately.
  • Help create an experience that encourages repeat business and long-term loyalty.

CRM & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate records of:
    • Customer information
    • Service requests
    • Appointment details
    • Call notes
    • Follow-up requirements
  • Keep CRM records complete and current.
  • Follow established call scripts, workflows, and documentation standards.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Previous HVAC and/or plumbing customer service experience is required.
  • Proven experience converting inbound calls into booked service appointments.
  • Strong phone communication and active listening skills.
  • Experience with CRM, scheduling, dispatch, or customer service systems.
  • Strong appointment scheduling and coordination skills.
  • Experience with upselling or membership/service-plan sales.
  • Confident objection-handling ability.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication.
  • Ability to work reliably during U.S. business hours.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely succeed in this role if you:

  • Understand how HVAC and plumbing service calls work.
  • Are comfortable handling a high volume of inbound calls.
  • Can confidently guide customers toward booking.
  • Are persuasive without sounding scripted or pushy.
  • Stay calm when customers have urgent service problems.
  • Balance customer service with sales and conversion goals.
  • Work quickly while maintaining accurate records.
  • Take ownership of every customer interaction through resolution.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Answering inbound HVAC and plumbing calls.
  • Identifying customer needs and urgency.
  • Converting inquiries into booked appointments.
  • Coordinating technician schedules and dispatch availability.
  • Selling maintenance memberships and relevant services.
  • Handling customer objections and concerns.
  • Updating customer and appointment information in the CRM.
  • Following up on open customer requests.
  • Coordinating with dispatch and operations teams.
  • Reviewing booking and conversion performance.

In short: you turn inbound service inquiries into booked appointments, satisfied customers, and recurring revenue.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Call-to-booking conversion rate.
  • Total appointments booked.
  • Membership sales and close rate.
  • Customer satisfaction and call quality.
  • Scheduling accuracy and efficiency.
  • CRM documentation accuracy.
  • Response and call-handling times.
  • Customer retention and repeat-service opportunities.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on both customer experience and company revenue.
  • High-ownership role with clear, measurable performance goals.
  • Opportunity to combine customer service, sales, scheduling, and home-service operations.
  • Stable full-time remote position.
  • Exposure to fast-paced U.S. HVAC and plumbing operations.
  • Growth opportunities into:
    • Customer Service Team Lead
    • Customer Success Manager
    • Dispatch/Scheduling Lead
    • Home Services Operations Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screening Call
  2. Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you have HVAC or plumbing customer service experience, know how to convert inbound calls into appointments, and enjoy balancing customer care with sales performance, we’d love to hear from you.

This is a strong opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced home services environment and wants direct ownership over bookings, customer experience, and revenue performance.

About the Role:

    We are looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test Apprentice to join our Quality Engineering function for a structured 12-month apprenticeship. This full-time apprenticeship is designed for someone who wants to build a strong foundation for a career in software engineering.

    Apprentices will work on real testing and automation initiatives that directly contribute to product quality, supported by mentorship, technical guidance, and structured learning throughout the programme. They will work alongside experienced SDETs and software engineers while developing practical knowledge of automation frameworks, API testing, defect analysis, CI/CD processes, and software quality practices.

    Programme Details:
  • Work Type: Apprenticeship
  • Department: Engineering
  • Sub Department: SDET
  • Duration: 12 months
  • Monthly Stipend: 50,000 INR
  • Location: Remote - India
  • Programme Start: September 2026

Responsibilities:

  • You'll be placed on one team with one charter. Depending on where you land, that could look like: -
  • Domain services in Go — designing protobuf contracts, implementing ConnectRPC handlers, and taking a service from ADR to production behind a flag. -
  • Ledger and accounting— posting commerce events into a double-entry ledger in real time, building chart-of-accounts translation, and shipping journal APIs that external systems can read.
  • Payments infrastructure— provider integrations, capability registries, idempotency and replay semantics for operations that must never double-charge. -
  • Document rendering — a cross-runtime templating engine with a conformance suite that keeps Go, JS, and Dart implementations honest. -
  • Developer tooling and MCP— protobuf-first code generation, manifest generators, and governance annotations that let AI agents call our APIs safely.
  • You'll write ADRs, review other people's designs, and carry your own on-call context for what you ship. Interns here merge to `main` in week two.

Requirements:

  • You'll be a strong fit if you have: -
  • A completed term in a recognized open source mentorship or contribution program, with merged and reviewed work in a real project — we will read your PRs.
  • Working fluency in Go, or demonstrated depth in another systems language plus evidence you pick things up fast.
  • Comfort with distributed systems fundamentals: idempotency, retries, consistency models, and what happens when the network lies to you.
  • Familiarity with containers and Kubernetes at the level of "I have debugged why my pod won't start."
  • The habit of writing things down — design docs, issue threads, commit messages that explain why.
  • Graduation timeline that allows a full-time conversion at the end of the term.
  • Signals we weight heavily - Sustained contribution to a single project across many months.
  • Public review threads where you argued a position and changed your mind well.
  • Anything you've built that handles money, correctness invariants, or multi-tenant isolation.
  • Conference talks, blog posts, or upstream spec proposals (SEPs, KEPs, RFCs).
  • Curiosity about the business problem underneath the ticket.

What the six months look like:

  • Weeks 1–3: Environment, codebase tour, and a scoped starter charter that touches production. Y
  • Weeks 4–16.: Your primary charter. One substantial piece of the platform that is yours to design, build, instrument, and ship. You'll present the design to the org and defend the tradeoffs.
  • Weeks 17–24: Hardening, migration, and handoff — or extension into a second charter if the first lands early. Conversion conversations begin around week 18.

jobs.description:
Not all heroes wear capes — but plenty of them use toilet paper

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business

We are a leading eco-friendly household essentials business and we donate 50% of our profits to help everyone gain access to clean water and a toilet. As of June 2026, we’ve contributed over $20 million AUD to this mission. Basically, we’re really good at making it easy to do good.

Our business is scaling in the UK, US, Australia and Canada, and our amazing team is spread across Australia, the UK, the Philippines, China, and the US. Our 250+ people aim to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next 5-10 years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role

As our Social Creative, you’ll be one of the creative voices shaping our organic social presence — dreaming up ideas that are unmistakably Who Gives A Crap, then actually making them happen. You’re a writer first: someone who thinks in captions, scripts and copy before anything else. Most of your time (around 80%) is spent deep in our social channels: spotting what’s worth jumping on,finding the angle no one else has taken, and writing copy that sounds like a person, not a brand. The other 20% is broader creative work — pitching in on presentations, campaigns and other through-the-line projects as part of the Copy team, and alongside the wider Creative department.

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in

  • Jumped into a weekly brainstorm to figure out which trends, formats and conversations we could jump on (and which we should steer clear of)
  • Found new ways to talk about our impact, connecting customers with the stories of people we're helping around the world
  • Wrote, shot and edited a short-form video on your phone, start to finish, for one of our channels
  • Pitched a handful of ideas for a product launch and helped bring the strongest one to life across platforms
  • Joined a cross-functional brief alongside an art director or designer for a piece of broader campaign work

Let’s talk about you

You can’t help but notice what’s working on the internet

You’re genuinely curious about internet culture — not just what’s trending, but why. You’ve got a maker’s instinct too: when an idea lands, you don’t just pitch it, you’re comfortable picking up a phone and shooting it yourself.

You’re a wizard with words

You can write a caption that’s short, sharp and sounds like a real person — and you know when a bit of brand tone of voice needs bending to work on a given platform. You get our particular flavour of silly, and you know it’s different from just being try-hard or worthy.

You’ve got a couple of years under your belt

This isn’t an entry-level gig. You can tell a good idea from a bad one without much hand-holding, and you’re comfortable taking loose direction and running with it.

You give a crap. Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too!

Why should you work with us?

First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the high standards of social and environmental impact. We’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (over 90%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?

If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

Ziply Fiber is a local internet service provider dedicated to elevating the connected lives of the communities we serve. We offer the fastest home internet in the nation, a refreshingly great customer experience, and affordable plans that put customers in charge.

As our state-of-the-art fiber network expands, so does our need for team members who can help us grow and realize our goals.

Our Company Values:

  • Genuinely Caring:We treat customers and colleagues like neighbors, with empathy and full attention.
  • Empowering You:We help customers choose what is best for them, and we support employees in implementing new ideas and solutions.
  • Innovation and Improvement:We constantly seek ways to improve how we serve customers and each other.
  • Earning Your Trust:We build trust through clear, honest, human communication.

Job Summary

Ziply Fiber's network runs on infrastructure — the compute, hypervisors, databases, containers, and bare metal platforms that power everything from network functions and OSS/BSS systems to subscriber-facing services. The Principal Architect for Infrastructure is the technical authority for this entire stack. This role will lead the VMware-to-OpenStack migration, define our containerization and orchestration strategy, architect redundant and geographically diverse compute environments, and ensure every platform we run meets carrier-grade reliability standards.

This is a hands-on senior independent contributor role. You will set the standards, own the architecture, and work directly with engineering teams to design and deliver infrastructure that is scalable, automated, and built for operational independence.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The Essential Duties and Responsibilities listed below are a range of duties performed by the employee and not intended to reflect all duties performed.

Virtualization & Compute

●Own the hypervisor and private cloud strategy: OpenStack/KVM architecture, cluster topology, and operational model — including the full migration program from VMware.

●Define Proxmox deployment architecture for environments requiring lightweight, flexible virtualization: cluster design, storage integration, and operational standards.

●Architect bare metal server infrastructure: provisioning automation, lifecycle management, firmware governance, and integration with virtualization and container platforms.

●Lead the VMware → OpenStack migration program: workload inventory and assessment, migration sequencing, dependency mapping, and zero-impact cutover execution.

Containers & Orchestration

●Define and own the Kubernetes platform architecture: cluster design, networking (CNI), storage (CSI), RBAC, and multi-cluster strategy across on-premise and cloud environments.

●Establish Docker image lifecycle governance: base image standards, registry management, vulnerability scanning, and build pipeline integration.

●Design CI/CD pipeline for infrastructure and network function delivery: GitOps workflows, automated testing, and rollout orchestration using ArgoCD, Flux, or equivalent.

Databases & Storage

●Own the database platform architecture: PostgreSQL deployment patterns, high-availability configuration (Patroni, pgBouncer, or equivalent), replication, backup, and disaster recovery.

●Define storage architecture across tiers: block (Ceph, iSCSI), object (S3-compatible), and file storage — with backup, replication, and RPO/RTO targets aligned to service criticality.

●Establish database governance standards: schema versioning, migration tooling, performance monitoring, and operational runbooks.

Cloud & Hybrid Architecture

●Define hybrid and multi-cloud integration patterns: workload placement strategy, cloud bursting, and private/public interconnect architecture (AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, or equivalent).

●Establish infrastructure-as-code standards across on-premise and cloud environments: Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent — with version control, peer review, and automated compliance checks.

Redundancy, Diversity & Resilience

●Own redundancy and geographic diversity planning for all infrastructure tiers: compute clusters, database platforms, storage, and network connectivity — with documented failure domain analysis and RTO/RPO targets for every critical system.

●Design active-active and active-passive architectures for carrier-grade availability: load balancing, failover automation, and health monitoring across sites.

●Define and test disaster recovery playbooks: regular DR exercises, runbook validation, and post-exercise gap remediation.

Other Duties

·Performs other duties as required to support the business and evolving organization.

Required Qualifications:

·High school diploma or GED.

·Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and directly relevant infrastructure architecture experience.

·10+ years of infrastructure engineering with deep expertise in virtualization, private cloud, and data center operations in a network operator or telco environment.

·Demonstrated senior independent contributor experience setting infrastructure architecture standards, influencing technical direction, mentoring engineers, and driving cross-functional architecture decisions without direct people-management responsibility.

·Expert-level OpenStack knowledge: Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Glance, Keystone — architecture, deployment, and operations at production scale.

·Hands-on Kubernetes experience: production cluster design, CNI/CSI selection, RBAC, and multi-cluster management.

·Strong PostgreSQL expertise: HA architecture, replication, performance tuning, and operational management in production environments.

·Proven VMware → OpenStack (or equivalent hypervisor migration) program delivery: workload assessment, migration tooling, and zero-impact cutover execution.

·Experience with bare metal provisioning and lifecycle management: Ironic, MAAS, or equivalent.

·Solid redundancy and diversity planning background: failure domain analysis, RTO/RPO definition, and DR program execution.

·Infrastructure-as-code proficiency: Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent in a network or telecom production environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

●Experience with Proxmox VE in production ISP or data center environments.

●Familiarity with DPDK, SR-IOV, or high-performance networking in virtualized environments for network function hosting.

●Experience with ETSI NFV/MANO frameworks and virtual network function (VNF) or cloud-native network function (CNF) onboarding.

●Prior work in co-location data center operations: power, cooling, cross-connect standards, and colo vendor management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

·Ability to work independently and apply sound judgment and reasoning skills to a variety of situations.

·Ability to multi-task and collaborate effectively with other personnel to meet deadlines.

·Strong verbal and written communication, attention to detail, and organizational skills.

·Ability to work within critical deadlines.

·Ability to adjust to rapidly changing priorities and schedules.

·Ability to provide excellent customer service.

·Senior technical leadership skills with the ability to influence engineering direction, mentor technical teams, establish standards, and build alignment without direct people-management authority.

·Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills with the ability to balance reliability, scalability, security, operational independence, cost, and delivery risk.

·Executive presence and communication skills to explain complex infrastructure architecture decisions clearly and credibly to Technology, Operations, Finance, Security, vendors, and senior leadership.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the US for any employer. Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Essential and marginal functions may require maintaining physical condition necessary for bending, stooping, sitting, walking, or standing for prolonged periods of time; most of time is spent sitting in a comfortable position with frequent opportunity to move about. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

Work is performed in an office setting with exposure to computer screens and requires extensive use of a computer, keyboard, mouse, and multi-line telephone system. The work is primarily a modern office setting.

At all times, Ziply Fiber must be your primary employer. Unless otherwise prohibited by law, employees may not hold outside employment nor be self-employed without obtaining approval in writing from Ziply Fiber. In holding outside employment or self-employment, employees should ensure that participation does not conflict with responsibilities to Ziply Fiber or its business interests.

Diverse Workforce / EEO:

Ziply Fiber is an equal opportunity employer. Ziply Fiber will consider all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, age, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, and the presence of a non-job-related handicap or disability or any other legally protected status.

Ziply Fiber requires a pre-employment background check as conditions of employment. Ziply Fiber may require a pre-employment drug screening.

Ziply Fiber is a drug free workplace.

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. Our Vision:

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

Overview

Reporting to the Head of Digital, the Senior Manager, Web will lead Neo4j’s web strategy and execution across a global digital ecosystem. This critical role blends strategic vision with analytical precision and strong stakeholder management to ensure Neo4j’s web presence delivers a cohesive, high-performing experience that advances brand, engagement, and conversion goals.

Web Strategy & Stakeholder Management

A/B Testing & Optimization Roadmap

  • Develop and execute a test-and-learn agenda focused on improving traffic quality, engagement, and conversion rates.
  • Design and oversee A/B and multivariate testing initiatives — from hypothesis to experiment design, execution, and insights.
  • Partner with analytics and UX to prioritize tests that deliver measurable impact and contribute to a culture of continuous optimization.
  • Document learnings and socialize best practices across teams to inform broader digital and marketing efforts.

Who You Are

  • 7+ years of experience in web, digital marketing, or product management, ideally within a B2B or SaaS environment.
  • Proven ability to develop strategy and lead cross-functional alignment for complex digital ecosystems.

  • Strong familiarity with A/B testing tools (e.g., Optimizely, Google Optimize, VWO) and SEO/SEM principles.
  • Excellent communicator with the ability to translate data and strategy into clear, persuasive narratives.
  • Highly organized project manager experienced in agile workflows and tools like Asana or Jira.

Success in This Role Looks Like

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an E-commerce Operations & Data Analyst to support the day-to-day logistics, inventory management, operational reporting, and data analysis of a growing e-commerce business.

This is an operations-first role, not a highly technical data engineering position. You’ll coordinate freight and inventory, maintain accurate operational data, manage Shopify information, build reports and dashboards, and use spreadsheets to help the business make better operational decisions.

You’ll also use modern AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude to streamline repetitive work, improve reporting, and make internal processes more efficient.

The ideal candidate combines logistics and e-commerce experience with strong spreadsheet and analytical skills and enjoys continuously improving how operations are run.

What You’ll Own

Logistics & Freight Coordination

  • Manage freight and shipment coordination from start to finish.

  • Keep accurate and organized logistics records.
  • Ensure day-to-day logistics workflows run smoothly.

Inventory & Purchase Order Management

  • Create and manage purchase orders based on inventory needs.

E-commerce Operations

  • Manage and update product and operational data within Shopify.
  • Maintain accurate product information and internal records.
  • Support day-to-day e-commerce operational workflows.
  • Coordinate information across inventory, logistics, sales, and customer operations.
  • Identify operational issues and help resolve them before they impact customers.

Reporting & Data Analysis

  • Maintain structured operational spreadsheets and trackers.
  • Generate recurring reports covering:
    • Sales
    • Inventory
    • Returns
    • Customer service
    • Product performance
    • Logistics
  • Analyze operational data to identify trends, issues, and opportunities.
  • Build and maintain dashboards that give leadership clear visibility into performance.
  • Support inventory forecasting and operational planning using reliable data.

AI & Workflow Improvement

  • Use ChatGPT, Claude, and similar AI tools to improve day-to-day operational workflows.
  • Identify repetitive processes that can be simplified or automated.
  • Use AI to support:
    • Reporting
    • Data organization
    • Dashboard workflows
    • Analysis
    • Documentation
    • Repetitive task automation
  • Develop practical AI-assisted processes that improve speed and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with developers when more technical integrations or automations are required.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to make operations more efficient.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’re highly organized and comfortable managing multiple operational workflows.
  • You understand how logistics, inventory, and e-commerce operations connect.
  • You enjoy working with spreadsheets and turning operational data into useful insights.
  • You proactively identify problems rather than waiting for them to escalate.
  • You look for better, faster ways to complete repetitive work.
  • You’re comfortable experimenting with AI tools without needing to be a developer.
  • You can independently manage responsibilities in a remote environment.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Previous experience in logistics, inventory management, supply chain coordination, or e-commerce operations.
  • Experience coordinating freight, shipments, warehouses, or inventory workflows.
  • Strong spreadsheet skills using Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Strong operational reporting and data management abilities.
  • Experience building or maintaining dashboards, reporting systems, or operational trackers.
  • Experience with Shopify or a similar e-commerce platform.
  • Practical experience using ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools in a business environment.
  • Experience improving workflows or automating repetitive operational tasks.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment during U.S. business hours.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with growing e-commerce or DTC brands.
  • Inventory forecasting or demand-planning experience.
  • Experience coordinating with third-party warehouses or fulfillment partners.
  • Experience creating automated reports or dashboards.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted data analysis and workflow automation.
  • Experience collaborating with developers on operational integrations.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may:

  • Review inventory levels and upcoming stock requirements.
  • Track active freight shipments and follow up with warehouse partners.
  • Create or update purchase orders.
  • Update Shopify and operational records.
  • Maintain inventory and logistics spreadsheets.
  • Review sales, returns, and product performance data.
  • Prepare operational reports and dashboards.
  • Investigate discrepancies or unusual trends.
  • Use AI to streamline a repetitive reporting or administrative process.
  • Coordinate with developers when a workflow requires deeper automation.

In short: you keep logistics, inventory, reporting, and e-commerce operations accurate and organized while continuously finding smarter ways to run them.

Key Metrics for Success

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Opportunity to combine operational expertise with data analysis.

  • Opportunity to build better dashboards, reporting, and internal systems.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.

  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross-source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

  • Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML)
