jobs.description:
Job Summary:

The Enterprise Enablement, Analytics and Toolchain Integration Lead owns enterprise adoption, visibility, analytics, and AI-enabled tool use that support consistent, high-quality requirements delivery across federated teams. This role is not an AI-specific role; it requires strong AI literacy because the enablement environment includes native AI tools, including Nexus, along with BI dashboards, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, and related delivery platforms. The role integrates standards, patterns, metrics, and governance gates into the working environments business analysts use every day, and builds dashboards, leading indicators, automation, and portfolio-level decision support that improve delivery predictability, reduce rework, strengthen adoption, and enable executive storytelling for business and technology leaders.

Essential Functions:
  • Design and maintain the federated BA enablement curriculum; curate content, certify capabilities, and establish standards for consistent enterprise requirements delivery without operating as a centralized training service
  • Own toolchain integration so federated BAs access standards, patterns, templates, governance gates, and enablement assets from within their working environments, including Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, NEXUS surfaces, BI dashboards, and AI platforms
  • Build, maintain, and mature dashboards for the four success metrics, including defining leading indicators, improving metric quality, and ensuring portfolio leaders use insights to drive decisions
  • Drive enterprise BA standards adoption measured through use in delivered artifacts, requirement quality, readiness, traceability, and reduced rework rather than downloads, page views, or passive engagement metrics
  • Surface trends to portfolio leadership, including where standards are working, where adoption is lagging, where rework is concentrated, and where intervention is needed to improve delivery outcomes
  • Apply AI-enabled and agentic tooling as part of daily enablement, analytics, and toolchain integration work, including dashboard narratives, executive communications, content development, requirement decomposition, synthesis, automation, and policy analysis
  • Lead enterprise enablement, adoption, and change management activities, including communities of practice, stakeholder engagement, curriculum adoption, communications, and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Partner with enterprise governance, architecture, delivery, analytics, AI enablement, and business leaders to align standards, tooling, metrics, automation, and adoption strategies across portfolios
  • Partner with Enterprise Requirements Governance Lead, the Requirements Quality and Validation Lead, analytics, delivery, and technology stakeholders to align standards, validation frameworks, tooling, automation, AI-enabled evaluation capabilities, and adoption strategies across portfolios
  • Perform any other job related duties as requested.

Education and Experience:
  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, information technology, healthcare management, data analytics, or related field required
  • Equivalent years of relevant work experience may be accepted in lieu of required education
  • Eight (8) years of experience in analytics, enablement, requirements management, enterprise tooling integration, delivery operations, portfolio management, or related disciplines within a healthcare or regulated environment required
  • Experience integrating and operationalizing Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Power BI, NEXUS surfaces, AI platforms, or similar enterprise delivery and requirements management tools required
  • Experience using AI/LLM tools, agentic tooling, automation, and data analytics platforms to improve enablement, content quality, workflow efficiency, decision support, and toolchain adoption required
  • Experience building decision-oriented dashboards, defining leading indicators, maturing success metrics, and communicating insights to portfolio or executive leadership required
  • Experience operating at enterprise or portfolio level preferred
Competencies, Knowledge and Skills:
  • Advanced expertise in Power BI, analytics, KPI development, reporting design, dashboard architecture, data quality, readiness metrics, and performance measurement
  • Data and reporting design fluency with the ability to build dashboards that drive decisions, define leading indicators, mature success metrics, and support portfolio-level decision-making
  • Strong toolchain integration capability; understands how to make CoE assets, standards, patterns, and gates accessible inside the working environments BAs actually use
  • Experience designing and integrating enterprise tooling ecosystems, including Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Power BI, NEXUS surfaces, Copilot, Copilot Studio, Claude, AI platforms, analytics solutions, and related delivery technologies
  • Strong AI literacy with demonstrated use of AI-enabled tools to support analysis, dashboard narratives, executive communications, requirement decomposition, synthesis, policy analysis, automation, and continuous improvement within enterprise enablement and toolchain integration work
  • Ability to translate complex operational, delivery, and requirement data into actionable insights that drive strategic decision-making, portfolio optimization, adoption interventions, and business outcomes
  • Strong understanding of Agile, project, hybrid, bi-modal requirement lifecycle, Lean Portfolio Management, product, portfolio, and flow-based delivery practices
  • Change management and community engagement capability; able to grow a federated community of practice without allowing it to become a status forum
  • Comfort moving between technical integrations, analytics design, AI-enabled automation, stakeholder communication, and executive storytelling
  • Experience supporting traceability, governance, compliance, and audit-readiness practices in regulated environments

  • Power BI, analytics, Agile, Six Sigma, or AI/ML-focused certifications preferred

jobs.description:
Who are we, and why should you join us?
ADHDAdvisor.org is on a mission to remove the conventional barriers to ADHD diagnosis and treatment and make mental health care more accessible to everyone, no matter where they live. Our telehealth platform——was founded to integrate technology, clinical expertise, and progressive approaches to emotional wellness.
What are we looking for?
We’re looking for Wyoming licensed Physicians to join our provider network. You can focus on providing clinical expertise while we take care of everything else. Wyoming license and DEA required.
Who Should Apply?
  • Physicians looking for an easy, all-in-one technology platform for telehealth.
  • Physicians who are experienced in prescribing stimulant and non stimulant medication when necessary and following federal and state laws.
  • Physicians who want to focus 100% on clinical work – not on acquiring clients, billing, support, or operations. (We handle all of that!)

What Will You Do?

  • Provide holistic mental healthcare to your patients including diagnostic and medication management.
  • Develop and implement treatment plans tailored to your patient's needs and follow the best practices and clinical guidelines.
  • Collaborate with our team of mental health professionals to ensure that your patients receive comprehensive, coordinated care.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient records following legal and ethical standards.
  • Help shape our treatment philosophy and contribute to developing clinical policies and procedures.

Requirements

  • Active and unrestricted license in Wyoming (required).
  • Active Wyoming DEA license (required).
  • Currently carry (or be willing to obtain) independent malpractice liability insurance.
  • Experience diagnosing and treating adult ADHD (ages 18+).
  • Experience prescribing medication, preferably on a telehealth platform.
  • A private and professional environment for conducting sessions.
  • Excellent written communication.
  • Reliable Internet connection.
  • Currently residing in the US.

Benefits

  • Flexible schedule: You’re always in control of your schedule and appointment times.
  • Location: We are fully remote – you can work anywhere in the US.
  • License reimbursement: We pay for your license in states where we face a high demand.
  • Minimum bureaucracy: We handle operations and ongoing client support.
  • Visibility: We regularly work with leading mental health online publications (Forbes, Ver Well Mind, etc.) to feature articles or case studies written by our team members

Hourly Pay: $150-$200
  • Diagnosis + Medication Management (45 minutes): $112.50-$150
  • Medication Management (30 minutes): $75.00-$100
  • Medication Management Follow-Up (15 minutes): $37.50-$50

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend (Online Storage)
jobs.excerpt: Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.
jobs.description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

The Data and Storage Services team is responsible for Affirm's data infrastructure across OLTP and OLAP systems, spanning critical online checkout databases, batch orchestration, streaming infrastructure, event-driven frameworks, BI, analytics tooling, large-scale data platforms, and agentic data tools such as semantic layers and internal platform data applications. Our mission is to provide trustworthy, intuitive, and cost-efficient solutions for Affirmers to secure, store, analyze, and transform data at exceptional scale.

The Online Storage team provides a set of managed databases as a platform, used to persist data for all Affirm services. Our platform enables self-service access to OLTP storage systems, including Relational DB(MySQL), DynamoDB, Distributed SQL, Cache(Redis). As a team, we are responsible for various data and access patterns, including but not limited to mission-critical financial transactional data, data science models, and any new persistence use case. These responsibilities require us to learn and gain deep expertise in various database systems.

We are looking for a highly skilled and detail-oriented Staff Software Engineer who can drive the technical roadmap for our Databases (Relational and KeyValue) identifying opportunities to improve how we build, productize, operate and improve this mission-critical infrastructure to unlock substantial value within our business. You’ll have the opportunity to directly influence your team’s roadmap in close collaboration with your peers, share your knowledge and expertise with others and learn from some of the best on our shared mission to deliver honest financial products that improve lives.

What You'll Do

As an integral member of the Online Storage team,

  • You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects.

  • You will work closely with and contribute to other teams - including product, infrastructure, and site reliability engineering (SRE).

  • You will design and build components of a scalable datastore platform, contributing to the overall Affirm's goals, and leveraging experience in creating multi-region, horizontally scalable, globally available, and high-performance datastore solutions.

  • You will develop control planes for management, self service of hundreds of databases at scale automating schema/data migrations, disaster recovery, sharding and performance tuning.

  • You will collaborate across teams in the product development lifecycle, focusing on database solutions, by collaborating with product management, design & analytics to ensure technical sustainability, risks and trade-offs are well understood and managed.

  • You will act as a force-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes.

  • You take ownership of your team’s operations and availability by ensuring you have the right monitoring, triage rotations, playbooks, policies, testing and alerting in place to support “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.

  • You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.

  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

What We Look For

  • You have 8+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.

  • You have an extensive track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, Spark and Kubernetes.

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on Database Expertise, leveraging your deep knowledge of Relational and/or Distributed SQL such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, TiDB/Vitess to optimize database performance, ensuring data integrity, and implementing efficient data access patterns. Should possess deep understanding of Database fundamentals including schema design, query optimization, scaling, partitioning, sharding and performance tuning in multiple functional environments. Strong background and expertise in building and operating databases in cloud environments. Expertise in database benchmarking, load testing, and capacity planning. Familiarity with connection poolers and proxies such as ProxySQL, RDS Proxy, Pg Bouncer, etc.

  • You have experience delivering major features, system components or deprecating existing functionality in a system through the definition of a technical and execution plan. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.

  • You thrive in ambiguity, and are comfortable moving from low level language idioms all the way to the architecture of large systems to understand how they work.

  • Your growth and impact trajectory demonstrates that you have mastered gathering and iterating on feedback from your engineering and cross-functional peers.

  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.

  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Pay Grade - P

Equity Grade - 7

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

CAN base pay range per year: $181,000 - 241,000 CAD

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

#LI Remote

This remote role is open only to candidates residing in Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, or Saskatchewan.

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.

We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:

  • Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents
  • Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses
  • Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge
  • ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount

We believe It’s On Us to provide an inclusive interview experience for all, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process.

[For U.S. positions that could be performed in Los Angeles or San Francisco] Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Affirm will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and hereby freely and unambiguously give informed consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of your personal information as described therein.

jobs.excerpt: Payroll CoordinatorThe Payroll Coordinator provides day-to-day payroll administration and support to ensure accurate and timely payroll processing for hourly and salaried employees.
jobs.description:
Payroll Coordinator

The Payroll Coordinator provides day-to-day payroll administration and support to ensure accurate and timely payroll processing for hourly and salaried employees. This role is responsible for maintaining payroll data, processing payroll-related transactions, assisting employees and managers with routine payroll inquiries, and supporting payroll audits and reporting activities.

The Payroll Coordinator works closely with Payroll, HR, Benefits, Finance, and field leadership to ensure payroll processes are executed accurately and in compliance with company policies and applicable federal, state, local, and provincial regulations. Complex issues and exceptions are escalated to the Payroll Specialist or Payroll Manager as appropriate.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Support end-to-end payroll processing activities for hourly and salaried employees, ensuring payroll transactions are completed accurately and timely.
  • Support payroll schedules and processing calendars to ensure payroll deadlines are met.
  • Process and maintain payroll data for new hires, transfers, promotions, pay changes, leaves of absence, and terminations.
  • Review timekeeping information, monitor exceptions, and coordinate corrections with managers and employees.
  • Maintain employee tax profiles, direct deposit information, garnishments, and PTO/Sick Time accrual records.
  • Assist employees and managers with routine payroll questions and requests while providing excellent customer service.
  • Process employment verifications, wage garnishments, and payroll-related documentation.
  • Prepare and distribute standard payroll reports and supporting documentation.
  • Perform routine payroll audits and data validations to identify discrepancies and coordinate corrections.
  • Support quarter-end and year-end payroll activities, including preparation of reports and documentation related to payroll tax filings and year-end forms.
  • Assist with payroll reconciliations and provide support for internal and external audit requests.
  • Participate in payroll system testing, upgrades, and process improvements as directed.
  • Collaborate with Payroll, HR, Benefits, Finance, HR Systems, and external vendors to resolve payroll-related issues.
  • Maintain payroll procedures and documentation to support consistency and compliance.
  • Protect confidential employee and company information, and maintain the integrity of payroll records.
  • Comply with all company policies, procedures, and safety practices.
  • Complete special projects and perform other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Working knowledge of payroll practices, wage and hour laws, and payroll administration processes.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information appropriately.
  • Strong customer service, written communication, and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to effectively interact with employees, managers, and cross-functional business partners.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and payroll/HRIS systems.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities and meet established deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to identify issues and escalate complex matters appropriately.
  • Ability to maintain accuracy while handling high volumes of transactions and meeting strict payroll deadlines.

Experience and Credentials

  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Accounting, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 3+ years of payroll, HR, accounting, or related administrative experience.
  • Experience supporting multi-state payroll environments required.
  • Experience with ADP Lyric preferred; experience with ADP Workforce Now or comparable payroll systems required.
  • Experience working with integrated systems such as timekeeping, benefits, and financial systems preferred.
  • Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills and experience working with reporting tools required.
  • Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC) preferred but not required.

Physical & Work Environment Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in person, over the phone, and via digital platforms.
  • Occasional travel may be required for meetings or training.

Location: Remote (Work from Home)
Contract Type: Self-Employed Contractor
Rate: £30 per hour
Hours: Flexible full-time and part-time opportunities available

Start date: 1st September
Shift Pattern: Initial pilot phase operating Monday to Friday between 9:00am and 6:00pm. Following successful completion of the pilot period (approximately 2 weeks the service is expected to expand to operate 7 days per week between 8:00am and 8:00pm.

About GPDQ

GPDQ provides nationwide healthcare services for individuals, businesses and the NHS. Led by NHS GP, Founder and Chief Medical Officer Dr Anshu Bhagat, our multidisciplinary clinical team harnesses technology to improve access to high-quality healthcare across the UK.

We deliver a range of services including GP consultations, physiotherapy, mental health support, health assessments, diagnostics, vaccinations and more. Through innovative digital healthcare solutions, we are committed to making healthcare more accessible, convenient and patient-centred.

About the Role

We are seeking experienced and motivated Clinical Prescribing Pharmacists to join our growing remote clinical workforce.

Working as an autonomousIndependent Prescriber, you will assess, diagnose and manage a wide range of primary care presentations through digital consultations. This role is ideally suited to pharmacists with strong primary care experience who are confident managing minor illnesses, prescribing independently and delivering high-quality patient care remotely.

You will work within a well-established clinical governance framework alongside a multidisciplinary team including GPs, Advanced Clinical Practitioners, Nurses, Mental Health Practitioners, Physiotherapists and Pharmacists.

This is an excellent opportunity to work flexibly while delivering safe and accessible healthcare to patients across the UK.

Why Join GPDQ?

At GPDQ, we're committed to delivering outstanding patient care while giving clinicians the flexibility and support they need to thrive.

What We Offer

  • Competitive contractor rates
  • Fully remote working with no commuting required
  • Initial pilot hours Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 6:00pm
  • Opportunity to support service expansion following the pilot phase, with operating hours expected to extend to 7 days per week, 8:00am to 8:00pm
  • Opportunity to work autonomously while being supported by experienced Clinical Leads and a multidisciplinary clinical team
  • Robust clinical governance framework focused on patient safety and clinician support
  • Ongoing learning, peer review and professional development opportunities
  • Exposure to innovative digital healthcare technology and modern models of care
  • Collaborative and supportive clinical culture
  • The opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient access to healthcare across the UK

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Practice

  • Conduct independent patient consultations via video, telephone and asynchronous digital platforms.
  • Assess, diagnose and manage a range of acute and minor illness presentations.
  • Independently prescribe within your scope of practice in accordance with GPhC standards and clinical governance requirements.
  • Review clinical information and provide safe prescribing decisions asynchronously where appropriate.
  • Recognise limitations of practice and refer patients appropriately when presentations fall outside your clinical scope.
  • Deliver high-quality, patient-centred care while maintaining excellent patient experience standards.

Medicines Optimisation and Safety

  • Practise in accordance with established clinical governance and prescribing frameworks.
  • Maintain accurate, timely and legally compliant clinical records.
  • Contribute to audit activity, quality improvement initiatives and significant event reviews where required.
  • Support safe prescribing practices and antimicrobial stewardship principles.
  • Participate in peer review, supervision and ongoing professional development activities.

Collaboration and Service Development

  • Work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary healthcare team.
  • Share pharmacy expertise and evidence-based guidance with colleagues.
  • Contribute to service improvements, pathway development and innovation projects.
  • Participate in team meetings, educational events and clinical updates.

Safeguarding

  • Promote a culture of patient-centred safeguarding practice.
  • Recognise and respond appropriately to safeguarding concerns relating to adults, children and vulnerable individuals.
  • Escalate concerns in line with safeguarding procedures and relevant legislation.
  • Support implementation of the Mental Capacity Act, Mental Health Act and associated national guidance.

Essential

Qualifications

  • MPharm degree (or equivalent).
  • Current registration with the General Pharmaceutical Council (GPhC).
  • Qualified Independent Prescriber with annotation recorded on the GPhC register.
  • Minimum 1 year's independent prescribing experience.
  • Able to prescribe autonomously from day one.

Experience

  • Minimum 2 years' post-qualification experience working within a primary care setting.
  • Demonstrable experience managing minor illness and undifferentiated presentations autonomously.
  • Experience prescribing independently within primary care.
  • Experience conducting remote consultations via phone and video.

Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of GPhC standards, prescribing governance and patient safety requirements.
  • Knowledge of clinical governance principles within digital healthcare environments.
  • Understanding of safe remote consultation and prescribing practices.

Skills

  • Excellent clinical assessment and decision-making skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to document consultations professionally and accurately.
  • Proficiency using clinical systems and digital healthcare platforms.
  • Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities effectively.
  • Commitment to patient-centred care and continuous professional development.
  • Ability to build effective working relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.

Desirable

Qualifications & Experience

  • Completion of the CPPE Primary Care Pharmacy Education Pathway.
  • Experience conducting asynchronous consultations and prescribing.
  • Experience working within digital healthcare services.
  • Experience contributing to clinical audits, quality improvement projects or pathway development.

Skills

  • Experience supporting multidisciplinary teams through medicines optimisation expertise.
  • Experience sharing knowledge and evidence-based practice with colleagues.
  • Familiarity with digital collaboration platforms such as Microsoft Teams or Slack.

Pre-Employment Checks

This role is subject to satisfactory identity verification, professional registration checks, references and an enhanced DBS check where applicable.

GPDQ is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of patients and expects all clinicians working with us to share this commitment.

Equality, Diversity and Inclusion

GPDQ is an equal opportunities organisation. We understand that not all people are the same, and it is our mission to support people throughout their healthcare journey.

We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and welcome applications from all suitably qualified individuals. We believe that diversity strengthens our organisation and helps us deliver better outcomes for our patients, colleagues and communities.

All applicants will be treated fairly throughout our recruitment and selection process regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other protected characteristic.

Rate: £30 per hour (Self-Employed Contractor)
Location: Remote
Pilot Hours (1st September): Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 6:00pm
Future Service Hours (15th September onwards: Expected to expand to 7 days per week, 8:00am to 8:00pm following the pilot phase.

Apply now to join GPDQ and help shape the future of accessible, patient-centred healthcare.

jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.What this opportunity involves:
We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 8+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paidEffort estimate

Tasks for this project are estimated to take 30 hours to complete, depending on complexity. This is an estimate and not a schedule requirement; you choose when and how to work. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation:
Up to $200/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~30 hours each; you set your own schedule.

Job Description:
The primary purpose of this position is to manage, maintain, implement, and improve cloud-focused, platform-agnostic IT infrastructure environments supporting Government customers and regulated workloads. This position focuses on secure cloud, hybrid cloud, and multi-cloud environments, including Microsoft Azure Government/GCC High and/or Amazon Web Services (AWS) GovCloud, and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Supported environments will include multi-cloud platforms; compute, storage, networking, security, identity, observability, automation, backup, database, and service management capabilities; and customer or hosted data center environments. This position ensures high levels of availability, security, performance, compliance, and operational stability for supported Government systems and business applications. The ideal candidate will have advanced technical expertise across multiple cloud platforms, the ability to design and operate secure Government cloud environments, experience applying compliance frameworks and security controls, and the ability to support mission-critical customer environments through participation in a 24x7 on-call rotation.

What You Will Do:

  • Provide operational support, administration, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management for Government customer cloud and hybrid infrastructure environments across Azure Government/GCC High, AWS GovCloud, and/or GCP.
  • Monitor, maintain, and optimize customer cloud environments to ensure availability, performance, security, compliance, and adherence to defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  • Perform incident, problem, change, and request management activities following established ITIL, security, compliance, and operational processes.
  • Respond to and resolve customer incidents, service requests, alerts, and operational issues across cloud compute, storage, networking, identity, security, automation, monitoring, backup, and platform services.
  • Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation supporting critical Government customer environments, including after-hours, weekends, holidays as required.
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and remediation of complex cloud and infrastructure issues while driving preventative actions to improve reliability.
  • Support secure cloud operations by applying Government compliance requirements and security frameworks, including FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, DISA STIGs, CIS Benchmarks, and other applicable standards.
  • Manage and maintain cloud configurations, access controls, security controls, monitoring, logging, automation, and operational documentation.
  • Implement approved changes, upgrades, patches, migrations, and configuration updates while following established change management processes.
  • Develop and maintain automation, Infrastructure as Code, scripts, runbooks, knowledge articles, and operational procedures to improve efficiency and consistency.
  • Perform capacity management, performance analysis, health assessments, and proactive remediation activities to improve customer environments.
  • Provide technical guidance and recommendations to improve cloud architecture, operational maturity, security posture, automation, and service delivery outcomes.

  • Ability and drive to further technical education through achieving certification and training plans specific to relevant cloud, infrastructure, automation, security, or service management technologies.
  • Ability to establish customer trust and confidence in CDW Managed Services knowledge of and concern for customers’ business needs.
  • Experience applying Government and industry compliance frameworks, including FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, FISMA, DISA STIGs, CIS Benchmarks, or comparable security standards.

jobs.description:
Why Pythian:

At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence. Pythian, a multinational company, was founded in 1997 and started by ensuring the reliability and performance of mission-critical databases. We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics.

Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy.

Why you:

This role sits on one of the largest database estates in the world, supporting one of our biggest clients — the kind of scale most infrastructure engineers never get direct access to. Changes made here don't touch one system, they touch a fleet, so the impact of good (and bad) engineering is outsized.

We're looking for an infrastructure/DevOps engineer to own the AWS platform our clients' RDS and Aurora databases run on — not the databases' internals. You'll manage the Terraform and CI/CD pipeline (GitLab, Harness) that provisions them, maintain the supporting tooling that handles user and schema management, and be the escalation point when a team's Terraform, pipeline, or process has gone wrong. A big part of the job is making that go wrong less often: improving documentation, and building out the tooling that automatically routes support queries to the right place instead of everything landing on-call.

If this is you, and you wonder what it would be like to work at Pythian, reach out to us and find out!

Intrigued to see what a life is like at Pythian? Check out #pythianlife on LinkedIn and follow @loveyourdata on Instagram!

Not the right job for you? Check out what other great jobs Pythian has open around the world! Pythian Careers

What you will be doing:

Support & Troubleshooting:

Act as the escalation point when clients or internal teams break their Terraform, break their pipeline, or don't follow documented process — diagnose the actual problem and get them unblocked.

Write clear Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports for significant incidents.

Infrastructure & Automation:

Build and maintain Terraform for provisioning AWS database infrastructure (RDS/Aurora), and the GitLab/Harness pipelines that deploy it.

Maintain the supporting tooling that manages database users and schemas, ensuring it stays correctly integrated with the databases it manages.

Automate recurring operational work with Python or Go.

Apply AWS security best practices — IAM roles, KMS encryption, Security Groups, Network ACLs — across managed environments.

Enablement & Tooling:

Build and improve the incident-response tooling so support queries get automatically routed to the right place, rather than landing on the person who is on call.

Own and improve documentation — runbooks, operational guides, disaster recovery procedures — so people stop making the same mistakes.

What we need from you:

  • 5+ Years of experience with AWS and Terraform in a production environment
  • Provisioning AWS infrastructure through a CI/CD pipeline (GitLab, Github, Harness, or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with RDS/Aurora operations — backup/restore, replication, disaster recovery — at the infrastructure level
  • Solid understanding of AWS security and compliance controls.
  • Experience automating operational tasks with Python or Go.
  • Proficiency in AWS networking (VPC, Subnets, Transit Gateways).
  • Comfortable being the person people come to when infrastructure or a pipeline is broken — clear communication under pressure, no hand-holding needed to trace a symptom to its root cause.
  • Nice to have: Docker, Vault, ProxySQL, and general relational database familiarity (MySQL or similar).

What you will receive:

  • Love your career: Competitive total rewards package. Blog during work hours; take a day off and volunteer for your favorite charity.
  • Love your work/life balance: Flexibly work remotely from your home, there’s no daily travel requirement to an office! All you need is a stable internet connection.
  • Love your coworkers: Collaborate with some of the best and brightest in the industry!
  • Love your development: Hone your skills or learn new ones with our substantial training allowance; participate in professional development days, attend training, become certified, whatever you like!
  • Love your workspace: We give you all the equipment you need to work from home including a laptop with your choice of OS, and an annual budget to personalize your work environment!
  • Love yourself: Pythian cares about the health and well-being of our team. You will have an annual wellness budget to make yourself a priority (use it on gym memberships, massages, fitness and more). Additionally, you will receive a generous amount of paid vacation and sick days, as well as a day off to volunteer for your favorite charity.

HiringDisclaimer

  • Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in any aspect of the selection process.

AI Disclaimer

Pythian may utilize Enterprise Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools or features throughout its hiring process. These tools help us manage high volumes of applications efficiently and may be employed to review applications, analyze resumes, and assist with other recruitment steps. While Pythian uses AI in its hiring process, it does not substitute for human judgment. All final hiring decisions are made by, and remain the responsibility of, human decision-makers. Quality Assurance Engineer (Manual + Automation | SaaS) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (flexibility for releases and sprints)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Quality Assurance Engineer (QA Tester) to ensure software products are thoroughly tested, reliable, and production-ready before release.

This is a hands-on QA role combining manual testing, test automation, defect management, API testing, and close collaboration with engineering teams.

You’ll act as a critical quality gate throughout the software development lifecycle — identifying bugs, validating fixes, testing edge cases, and helping prevent issues from reaching production.

If you naturally look for what could break, think through edge cases, and care deeply about delivering reliable software, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Test Planning & Coverage

  • Create and maintain:
    • Test plans
    • Test cases
    • Test scenarios
    • Acceptance criteria
  • Define appropriate test coverage across new features, integrations, and regression flows.
  • Review requirements and identify potential gaps or risks before development is completed.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to ensure requirements are testable and clearly understood.

Manual Testing – Core Responsibility

  • Execute:
    • Functional testing
    • Regression testing
    • Integration testing
    • UI/UX validation
    • Cross-browser testing
    • Cross-device testing
  • Identify bugs, inconsistencies, and edge cases before release.
  • Log and manage defects using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
  • Provide developers with clear:
    • Reproduction steps
    • Expected vs. actual behavior
    • Screenshots or recordings
    • Environment details
  • Retest fixes and perform regression testing on impacted functionality.

Automation Testing

  • Build, maintain, and improve automated test scripts using tools such as:
    • Selenium
    • Cypress
    • Playwright
  • Automate repetitive and high-value regression scenarios.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD workflows using:
    • GitHub Actions
    • Jenkins
    • GitLab CI
  • Investigate failed automated tests and distinguish product defects from test-script issues.

API & Performance Testing

  • Test APIs and backend functionality using Postman or similar tools.
  • Validate:
    • API responses
    • Status codes
    • Data integrity
    • Error handling
    • Integration behavior
  • Conduct performance, load, and stress testing using tools such as:
    • Apache JMeter
    • Locust
  • Support security and vulnerability testing where required.

Defect Tracking & Release Validation

  • Track bugs from discovery through resolution.
  • Prioritize issues based on severity, impact, and release risk.
  • Validate builds before production deployment.
  • Conduct regression and release-readiness testing.
  • Clearly communicate critical defects and potential release risks to stakeholders.

Documentation & Quality Reporting

  • Maintain organized documentation for:
    • Test plans
    • Test cases
    • Test results
    • Defects
    • Regression suites
  • Track quality metrics including:
    • Defect density
    • Test coverage
    • Pass/fail rates
    • Production defects
  • Provide stakeholders with clear visibility into product quality and release readiness.

Engineering Collaboration

  • Work closely with developers to reproduce and investigate defects.
  • Participate in:
    • Sprint planning
    • Daily standups
    • Retrospectives
    • Release discussions
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams throughout the SDLC.
  • Advocate for quality without unnecessarily slowing down delivery.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely succeed in this role if you:

  • Naturally identify edge cases others overlook.
  • Write clear, structured, and repeatable test cases.
  • Are methodical without becoming a bottleneck.
  • Can clearly explain technical issues to developers.
  • Understand when automation adds value and when manual testing is more effective.
  • Take ownership of bugs through validation and resolution.
  • Care about the overall user experience, not simply whether a test passes.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional QA or software testing experience.
  • Strong hands-on manual testing experience.
  • Experience with functional and regression testing.
  • Experience documenting and tracking defects using Jira or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with test management platforms such as:
    • TestRail
    • Zephyr
  • Familiarity with at least one automation framework:
    • Selenium
    • Cypress
    • Playwright
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
    • Agile development
    • QA methodologies
    • Defect lifecycle management
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Clear written and verbal English communication.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with performance testing using JMeter or Locust.
  • Exposure to security or vulnerability testing.
  • Experience working within compliance-heavy software environments.
  • Familiarity with Git and modern engineering workflows.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may start by reviewing new requirements and writing test cases for an upcoming feature. You’ll execute manual tests, run regression suites, investigate failed automated tests, and document any defects you uncover.

Throughout the day, you’ll work directly with developers to reproduce issues, validate fixes, test APIs or integrations, and assess whether builds are ready for release.

In short: you find and help resolve problems before customers encounter them.

Key Metrics for Success

  • High percentage of defects caught before production.
  • Strong regression test coverage.
  • Low number of critical production defects.
  • Fast and accurate defect validation.
  • Reliable automated test suites.

Why This Role Stands Out

Interview Process

Apply Now

This position will also support onboarding, training, nesting, precepting, coaching, calibration, quality reviews, and operational readiness as the program scales.

Job title:

Clinical Operations Supervisor

Operational Leadership

jobs.description:
Job Title: Solutions Engineer

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Solutions Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Solutions Engineer, you are the technical owner of the merchant relationship from first sales conversation through live integration and beyond. You will focus on our enterprise and strategic merchants: the national retailers and high-volume brands running custom, hand-built integrations across web, mobile app, and in-store. These are our most complex merchants and our largest revenue drivers, and they do not come with an off-the-shelf plugin.

You will partner with Sales, Product, and Engineering to scope what a merchant needs, design the integration that gets them there, and stay with them once they are live. You own the technical side of pre-sales: demos, architecture discussions, RFP responses, and solution proposals. When a merchant needs something custom, you define the requirement, shape the solution with our engineering team, and drive it to launch.

This is a customer-facing engineering role. You will spend as much time on calls with merchant developers as you will in documentation and test environments, and you need to be credible in both rooms.

This role combines technical expertise and sales acumen to support sales teams. They work closely with the sales team and clients, understanding customer needs and translating them into effective, tailored solutions. Acting as a bridge between technical and business functions, a Solutions Engineer not only helps demonstrate and implement the product’s capabilities but also communicates complex technical details in a way that resonates with clients. Their role requires both the ability to engage with customers directly and the technical know-how to ensure the product meets client requirements effectively.

What You'll Do:

  • Own technical discovery for prospective merchants: understand their stack, their checkout flow, and their constraints, then map them to the right Sezzle integration path
  • Lead product demos and technical presentations for merchant engineering and business stakeholders
  • Design integration solutions across our API, SDKs, and platform plugins (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, WooCommerce, Wix, and custom builds)
  • Write technical proposals and complete RFP and security questionnaire responses
  • Support merchant mobile app integrations: SDK implementation, in-app checkout, and native versus webview handoff
  • Validate integrations in sandbox and in production before launch, including checkout flow, widget and messaging placement, redirect and handoff behavior, and settlement
  • Troubleshoot live integration issues alongside Support and Engineering, and own the technical narrative back to the merchant
  • Translate recurring merchant needs into product feedback, and push for the fixes that unblock revenue
  • Build and maintain integration documentation, runbooks, and internal enablement so the team scales without you in every call
  • Act as the trusted technical advisor for your merchants after launch, spotting optimization opportunities they haven't asked for yet

What We Look For:

  • 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role: solutions engineering, sales engineering, implementation, solutions architecture, or technical account management
  • Experience with mobile SDK integrations on iOS and Android, including the ability to guide merchant mobile developers through implementation and debug what breaks
  • Experience supporting enterprise merchants through complex, multi-stakeholder integrations with custom-built commerce stacks
  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs, webhooks, and reading API documentation critically
  • Working knowledge of web technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
  • Familiarity with at least one major e-commerce platform (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, WooCommerce, Wix) and how payment methods integrate into it
  • Understanding of e-commerce workflows: cart, checkout, payment authorization and capture, refunds, shipping, and product management
  • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences, and business context clearly to engineers
  • Strong written communication. You will produce documentation and proposals that merchants and internal teams rely on
  • Comfort managing several merchant integrations at once in a fast-moving environment
  • Ability to read code in at least one language well enough to debug a merchant's implementation
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools effectively in day-to-day work, including research, technical documentation, problem-solving, and workflow automation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at a payments company, PSP, or BNPL provider
  • Familiarity with payment gateway architecture and how alternative payment methods are surfaced at checkout
  • Experience with in-store or omnichannel payment integrations
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewNakupuna Federal is seeking a Senior Business/Functional Analyst to join our team of talented consultants providing Contractor Support Services (CSS) to the Naval Supply Systems Command (NAVSUP) Business Systems Center (BSC).
jobs.description:
Overview

Nakupuna Federal is seeking a Senior Business/Functional Analyst to join our team of talented consultants providing Contractor Support Services (CSS) to the Naval Supply Systems Command (NAVSUP) Business Systems Center (BSC). Support under this contract includes technical services supporting application development efforts to modernize NAVSUP supply and logistics applications and manage associated technical debt. The Senior Business/Functional Analyst will provide functional and business analysis expertise throughout the software development lifecycle and work closely with Government and contractor team members in an Agile delivery environment.

Responsibilities

The following reflects management's definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign additional duties and responsibilities to this job at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons:

  • Provide functional knowledge and subject matter expertise for assigned applications and perform assigned application support activities.
  • Elicit, analyze, document, validate, and maintain business and functional requirements obtained from customers, users, and other stakeholders.
  • Create, update, and maintain work items in the Enterprise Platform, currently AzDO, ensuring activities and supporting information are accurately documented and kept current within five business days.
  • Work with the Government PO/PM to decompose requirements and stories into work that can reasonably be completed within a sprint, generally within 10–15 business days and assist in defining Acceptance Criteria and the sprint Definition of Done.
  • Identify and document the tasks required to successfully complete Product Backlog Items (PBIs) in AzDO.
  • Develop PBI estimates and project roadmaps in support of project requirements, priorities, and schedules.
  • Establish and maintain traceability and dependencies between requirements, including Epics, Features, PBIs, Stories, Tasks, and associated systems, within AzDO.
  • Work closely with the Government to continually maintain the Product Backlog in alignment with the Agile cadence, ensuring necessary Release and Sprint Backlog items are defined with Acceptance Criteria and available for Government prioritization before the start of each release and sprint.
  • Support development priorities in accordance with the Program Backlog.
  • Adhere to Scrum best practices and participate in recommended Scrum Events and Artifacts in accordance with the 2020 Scrum Guide, Agile Kanban practices, or other Agile or Scrum practices approved by the Government PO.
  • Effectively facilitate and participate in Scrum and Agile events and practices.
  • Support the full range of System/Software Development Lifecycle activities, including requirements, analysis, design, development, testing, security, and deployment.
  • Coordinate analysis, design, development, testing, and deployment activities necessary to complete assigned stories in accordance with Acceptance Criteria and the Definition of Done.
  • Propose Minimum Viable Product (MVP) solutions that provide an initial capability to end users while enabling user feedback to influence future development sprints.
  • Develop documentation in accordance with Agile Scrum best practices and the NAVSUP BSC Service Delivery Model.
  • Identify, define, or modify interfaces with other systems and applications and ensure agreements with interfacing systems/applications are formally documented.
  • Analyze system requirements and translate functional designs into detailed logic sufficient to support coding of assigned software systems, modules, and components.
  • Review individual modules and overall system designs for validity, including validation of record input, data elements, and output reports.
  • Perform required testing based on established Acceptance Criteria and Definition of Done to verify software and system quality and functionality.
  • Prepare release packages for Government approval.
  • Provide pre-implementation training resources to customers and users.
  • Support the resolution of Production Outages.
  • Work with the Government PO/PM and SM to define and deliver metrics supporting project objectives. Metrics may include release burnup, sprint burndown, planned versus accepted PBI estimates, escaped defects, velocity, and other evolving measures, with a maximum of 10 metrics per team.
  • Provide comprehensive application Transfer of Knowledge to NAVSUP BSC application team personnel through concise, shop-usable lesson plans and other appropriate knowledge-transfer activities.
  • Actively provide daily mentoring to Government team members while performing assigned activities to increase Government personnel knowledge and familiarity with analyst tasks and support independent performance of similar future activities.
  • Support documentation of mentoring and knowledge-transfer activities for inclusion in monthly progress reports.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess strong business and functional analysis capabilities and have experience operating as part of an Agile application development team. Specifically, the candidate should possess the following knowledge, skills, and abilities:

  • Demonstrated ability to elicit, document, analyze, and validate business and functional requirements.
  • Knowledge and practical experience with Agile concepts, principles, practices, and team-based delivery.
  • Proficiency with data analysis tools and techniques, including SQL and Microsoft Excel.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to analyze data and derive meaningful insights.
  • Ability to identify, analyze, and assist in resolving complex business and functional problems.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers, users, technical personnel, Government stakeholders, and team members at varying organizational levels.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy and completeness in requirements, work items, and supporting documentation.
  • Ability to adapt to changing business needs, priorities, requirements, and Agile delivery schedules.
  • Ability to establish effective working relationships and collaborate successfully within cross-functional Government and contractor teams.
  • Knowledge of business processes, applicable industry trends, and business analysis best practices.
  • Ability to think strategically and align proposed business and functional solutions with organizational and program goals.
  • Prior DoN or DoW information technology experience is a plus.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen.
  • Must be able to successfully complete the background investigation required for a Public Trust position.

Experience: Minimum of three (3) years of experience with Agile concepts and principles and experience participating as a member of Agile teams. Minimum of five (5) years of experience eliciting, documenting, and validating business requirements.

Education: Minimum of two (2) years of college/work experience, in accordance with contract requirements

Location: Remote position. Minimal travel may be required at the client's request.

Physical Requirements: The ideal candidate must at a minimum be able to meet the following physical requirements of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation:

  • Ability to perform repetitive motions with the hands, wrists, and fingers.
  • Ability to engage in and follow audible communications in emergency situations.
  • Ability to sit for prolonged periods at a desk and working on a computer.

The Nakupuna Companies use a market-based compensation strategy to ensure that our employees are compensated within applicable market ranges commensurate with multiple factors, including but not limited to the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability, organizational requirements, and position location. The projected compensation range for this position is $115,000 to $130,000 (annualized USD). The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Nakupuna Companies' total compensation package for employees.

Job Description:

About The Chicago School

The Chicago School educates the next generation of change-makers in innovative theory and culturally competent practice to strengthen the integrated health of individuals, organizations, and communities. We enroll over 6,000 students across 40+ academic programs culminating in a bachelor's, master's, or doctoral degree or a professional certificate, and our unique approach to impact-focused education has made us a leading nonprofit university for over 45 years.

As an employee at The Chicago School, you can become a member of an inclusive community committed to excellence. At The Chicago School, we celebrate individuals of all backgrounds and identities for who they are and what they can contribute. We take pride in hiring and retaining the most dynamic, talented, and passionate professionals who will help us continue to innovate for decades to come.

Position Summary:

The Program Chair of the Master of Public Health (MPH) program is directly responsible to the Associate Dean within the college for the program. The Program Chair is a member of the faculty as an Administrative Faculty member and responsible for new student enrollment, faculty recruitment, scheduling and course sequencing, student affairs within the program, and student review process. The Program Chair works closely with Academic Leadership, Student Support, and Admissions.

The Program Chair will teach up to 12 credits per academic year. The Program Chair leads department meetings, participates in institutional and departmental committees, provides academic leadership, and performs duties as assigned by the Associate Dean and/or College Dean. As an administrative faculty member, the Program Chair is a member of the Faculty Council.

Main Key Areas of Responsibility

Program Growth and Development

  • Ensure ongoing compliance with Council on Education for Public Health (CEPH) accreditation and lead program review processes, working with Accreditation and Licensures, Associate Dean, and public health faculty and staff.
  • Lead continuous quality improvement (CQI) activities, including annual assessment planning, competency evaluation, systematic review of student learning outcomes, and implementation of improvement initiatives informed by assessment data and stakeholder feedback.
  • Identify, establish, and foster positive engagement across practice sites for Public Health faculty including initiation and maintenance of practice agreements in support of the Applied Practice Experience or Integrative Learning Experience required by CEPH.
  • Develop and execute a plan for community engagement in support of expanding awareness and driving new student enrollment at The Chicago School.
  • Establish and facilitate an active Public Health Advisory Board that engages community stakeholders, alumni, employers, and practice partners in continuous program improvement and workforce alignment.
  • Recruit, hire, and manage program faculty to support the institution's diverse student body from recruitment to matriculation, in alignment with budget allowances and university needs.
  • Collaborate with the admissions team to ensure timely review of admissions files and development of materials to support achievement of new student recruiting goals.
  • Develop and implement comprehensive student engagement initiatives that promote academic success, professional identity development, career readiness, alumni engagement, and lifelong connection to the program.

Academic Operations

  • Manage the day-to-day operations of the program to ensure quality student experience and faculty performance expectations are maintained.
  • Direct course scheduling in a manner that supports the student experience via ensuring adequate class size and assigning faculty who are properly credentialed and trained to deliver assigned course content.
  • Represent the department at meetings, student events, and other related events to facilitate collaborative decision making, student engagement, building program and university awareness in the community.
  • Lead the development of strategic academic and budget plans for the department, including recommendations from the assessment and department review process to inform student enrollment growth targets and program staffing needs.
  • Seek and implement opportunities to integrate emerging instructional technology into curriculum delivery models.

People Management

  • Build and manage a faculty team that is welcoming and supportive of diverse voices, new perspectives, and innovation at the institution.
  • Mentor, supervise and evaluate the teaching, advisement, and other duties performed by Faculty members to meet program academic goals.
  • Develop and apply a structured, data-driven system for mentoring, supervising and evaluating the teaching, advisement, and other duties performed by faculty members to ensure student achievement of program and institutional learning outcomes.
  • Ensure department faculty remain active in scholarship and service as evidenced by membership in institutional committee work, professional organizations, publications, presentations, and colloquia.

Academic Quality & Innovation

  • Ensure curriculum mapping, competency alignment, and assessment processes remain consistent with CEPH accreditation requirements, workforce expectations, and institutional learning outcomes.
  • Identify and pursue external funding opportunities, including grants, partnerships, and scholarships.
  • Monitor satisfactory academic progress supporting student progress through the curriculum and timely degree completion.
  • Ensure student concerns are effectively addressed in a timely and responsive manner in support of student satisfaction and retention.

Position Qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Doctoral degree (DrPH, Ph.D., MD, or equivalent) in public health or closely related field from an accredited institution.
  • MPH degree or equivalent graduate training in public health.
  • Minimum three years of academic administration experience including working with students at the undergraduate or graduate level is strongly desired.
  • Strong scholarly background in research and publications, presenting at conferences, and conducting program assessments.
  • Demonstrated understanding of CEPH accreditation standards and processes.
  • Experience with online or distance education delivery.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certified in Public Health (CPH) credential
  • Direct experience leading or participating in CEPH accreditation processes
  • Experience developing or directing graduate public health programs
  • Demonstrated success in curriculum development and assessment
  • Grant writing and external funding acquisition experience

Saddleback Solutions offer Consultancy and Professional Services to our Partners and Clients. We partner Palo Alto Networks, Juniper Networks and Arista worldwide, and we indirectly Partner AWS, so there are always lots of varying opportunities that come up.

We have long standing and close relationships with our consultants and our partners so we can represent you fully. We offer free training for all our consultants should they wish to expand their knowledge and profiles while with us.

We have an education services arm also, so our consultants once qualified can also offer their services running workshops or bootcamps between projects or even full time.

We will support you the best way we know how.

Tasks

  • Lead the Kickoff and Planning Phase for XSIAM deployments, defining project scope, objectives, timelines, and resource requirements.
  • Conduct comprehensive Architectural Discovery sessions to understand client environments, security requirements, and integration points for XSIAM.
  • Oversee and actively participate in the Deployment of Cortex XSIAM infrastructure, including complex multi-tenant deployments with child tenants.
  • Provide expert guidance and hands-on support for Data Source Onboarding, ensuring efficient and accurate ingestion of security telemetry into XSIAM.
  • Specialize in Endpoints Tuning within the XSIAM ecosystem to optimize data quality and reduce noise for effective threat detection.
  • Develop and implement sophisticated Correlation Rules to identify advanced threats and streamline alert generation.
  • Leverage and configure Attack Surface Management (ASM) capabilities within XSIAM to provide clients with comprehensive visibility into their digital attack surface.
  • Design, develop, and refine Data Models/Parsers to ensure accurate and actionable data representation within XSIAM.
  • Collaborate with clients to identify opportunities for Alert Automation (PSC) and Playbook implementation, subject to discovery, and potentially supported by extended expertise.
  • Advise on and implement best practices for Threat Intel Management within XSIAM, integrating various threat intelligence sources for enhanced detection.
  • Work with clients to define requirements for and, as needed, contribute to the development of Custom Widgets and reports (to be further defined and potentially delivered through extended expertise).
  • Lead and contribute to SOC Transformation initiatives, leveraging XSIAM to modernize security operations centers, streamline workflows, and enhance overall security posture.
  • Produce high-quality, comprehensive Documentation throughout the project lifecycle, including architectural designs, configuration guides, and operational runbooks.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in cybersecurity, with a strong focus on Security Operations Centers (SOC), incident response, and threat detection.
  • Proven experience in leading and delivering complex cybersecurity extended expertise engagements.
  • Demonstrable expertise in deploying, configuring, and optimizing Palo Alto Networks Cortex XSIAM.
  • Extensive experience with SIEM platforms, SOAR technologies, and endpoint security solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with data source integration, parsing, and data model creation.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python) for automation and data manipulation is a plus.
  • Technical Skills:
  • Deep understanding of security frameworks (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK, NIST).
  • Expertise in network security, endpoint security, cloud security, and threat intelligence.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization technologies is highly desirable.

Soft Skills:

  • Exceptional communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust with clients.
  • Excellent organizational and project management abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a distributed team.
  • A proactive, results-oriented mindset with a commitment to client success.

Certifications (Preferred):

  • Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer (PCNSE)
  • Palo Alto Networks Certified Security Automation Engineer (PCSAE)
  • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, GCIH, GCFA)

If you have hands-on Cortex XSIAM experience and are looking for an opportunity to work on an enterprise cybersecurity project with Palo Alto Networks, we'd love to hear from you.
