jobs.description:
About our Client:

Our client has been developing point of sale (POS) software and payment solutions since 2006 and is an Australian market leader in delivery of end-to-end software, hardware, payment and integration solutions for the Hospitality industry. Their services include all hospitality venue types including high-end restaurants, wineries, bars, pubs, hotels and bottle shops. Our client remains a fast and nimble business that moves quickly to provide innovative solutions, including their own payments platform designed to enhance the customer experience at every touchpoint. They now provide a one-stop-shop POS and Payments solution allowing us to eradicate outdated monthly fees.

About Teamified

Teamified is a talent partner helping companies build exceptional remote teams across IT, software, product, and digital innovation. We collaborate with leading enterprises and fast-scaling tech businesses worldwide to help them access world class talent and accelerate growth. With operations across the globe our mission is to make building high performing global teams simple, fast, and cost-effective. Teamified has hundreds of clients with more than 200 engineers, testers, product managers, designers, and technology experts delivering impactful solutions every day

About the Role:

We are looking for a customer-focused Level 1 Support Technician to provide high-quality remote, telephone, email, and chat support to clients using business-critical Point of Sale (POS) systems.

As a Level 1 Support Technician, you will be one of the first points of contact for customers experiencing technical issues. You will be responsible for understanding the problem, troubleshooting according to established processes, resolving issues within your technical capability, and ensuring more complex cases are appropriately documented and escalated.

This role combines technical troubleshooting with excellent customer service. You will work closely with Level 2 Support, Systems Administration, Account Management, Customer Success, installation and training teams, and after-hours support teams to ensure customers receive timely and effective assistance.

A key measure of success will be your ability to resolve customer issues efficiently, increase first-contact resolution, reduce repeat calls, and maintain clear communication with customers throughout the support process.

The role operates 5 days per week on a rotating roster, including weekends, with normal working hours of 11:00 AM–7:00 PM AEST. There may also be a requirement to provide after-hours coverage, including 12-hour shifts with appropriate breaks, when required to support team leave coverage.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Act as the first point of contact for customers across phone, SMS, email, chat, and other support channels.
  • Respond to incoming POS software, hardware, system, and connectivity issues and troubleshoot them according to established support guidelines and internal processes.
  • Diagnose and resolve Level 1 technical issues within your capability and escalate more complex incidents to the appropriate technical team.
  • Ensure all customer calls, incidents, and support requests are accurately logged, prioritised, updated, and escalated when necessary.
  • Work within established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and ensure customers receive timely updates throughout the resolution process.
  • Deliver a high standard of customer service and maintain clear, professional, and empathetic communication in every interaction.
  • Aim to maximise first-contact resolution and reduce repeat customer calls and tickets.
  • Provide customers with basic system and product training over the phone or through remote support channels when required.
  • Create sales orders for additional software or hardware requirements identified through customer interactions.
  • Escalate customer complaints and significant service concerns to the Level 1 Team Leader or appropriate manager.
  • Collaborate effectively with Level 2 Support, Systems Administration, Customer Success, Account Management, installation and training teams, and after-hours support teams.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of troubleshooting activities, customer communications, resolutions, and escalations.
  • Participate in training, coaching, knowledge-sharing, and professional development opportunities.
  • Continuously develop technical knowledge across POS software, hardware, networking, and related technologies.
  • Identify opportunities to improve support processes, customer experience, and team efficiency.
  • Follow company security, workplace health and safety, operational, and customer service policies and procedures.
  • Demonstrate the company's values through teamwork, accountability, customer focus, continuous improvement, open communication, and pride in the quality of your work.

Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in a Level 1 Help Desk, Service Desk, Technical Support, Application Support, POS Support, or similar customer-facing technical support role.
  • Demonstrated Level 1 technical troubleshooting knowledge and the ability to diagnose common software, hardware, system, and connectivity issues.
  • Experience supporting Point of Sale (POS) systems or hospitality/retail technology is highly desirable.
  • Intermediate computer skills with a good understanding of software and hardware; basic networking knowledge would be an advantage.
  • Strong customer service skills with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to non-technical customers.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple tickets, systems, and customer interactions while meeting competing deadlines and service-level requirements.
  • Ability to accurately document technical issues, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and escalations.
  • Strong initiative, self-motivation, and the ability to work effectively with limited supervision.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain positive working relationships with customers and internal teams.
  • Comfortable working within structured processes while using sound judgement to identify when an issue requires escalation.
  • Willingness and ability to work 11:00 AM–7:00 PM AEST on a rotating 5-day roster, including weekends.
  • Flexibility to provide after-hours coverage when required, including extended shifts to cover team member leave.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and developing technical knowledge as products, systems, and support processes evolve.
  • Diploma or Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline is advantageous but not essential.

Benefits:

  • Flexibility in work hours and location, with a focus on managing energy rather than time.
  • Access to online learning platforms and a budget for professional development
  • A collaborative, no-silos environment, encouraging learning and growth across teams
  • A dynamic social culture with team lunches, social events, and opportunities for creative input
  • Health insurance
  • Leave Benefits
  • Provident Fund
  • Gratuity

If you possess the required skills and are eager to contribute to our team's success, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Apply now!

jobs.excerpt: Job Description Director, Clinical Pharmacy Stars Performance A bit about this role:As Director, Clinical Pharmacy Stars Performance, you are the tactical owner of every clinical pharmacy-related measure in our Medicare Advantage and Part D Star Ratings portfolio.
jobs.description:
Job Description

Director, Clinical Pharmacy Stars Performance

A bit about this role:

As Director, Clinical Pharmacy Stars Performance, you are the tactical owner of every clinical pharmacy-related measure in our Medicare Advantage and Part D Star Ratings portfolio. Your job is to drive our clinical pharmacy Stars enterprise strategy into daily reality, measure by measure, member by member, week by week. This is the most consequential set of measures we own.

You will be the enterprise clinical subject matter expert on pharmacy quality: the person Medical Directors call before they call anyone else, the person who reads the Technical Notes the day they drop, and the person who can tell us in February where a cut point is going to land in October and what we need to do about it now. You will also be the person building the tracker, setting the objectives and key results, and personally auditing whether the outreach was actually effective.

You will report directly to the AVP, Pharmacy, carrying the portfolio into executive meetings, leading cross-functional escalations, and owning outcomes.

Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Performance Management & Insight Generation. Own the performance trajectory of the full clinical pharmacy Star portfolio, including the triple-weighted medication adherence measures (Diabetes, RAS Antagonists, Statins), Statin Use in Persons with Diabetes (SUPD), Polypharmacy: Use of Multiple Anticholinergic Medications in Older Adults (Poly-ACH), and Concurrent Use of Opioids and Benzodiazepines (COB). Forecast measure trajectories against projected cut points, identify risk months before it shows up in a year-end score, and translate the analysis into daily, weekly, and monthly operating directives that internal teams and vendors can actually execute against.

  • Clinical Subject Matter Expertise & Clinical Collaboration. Serve as the authoritative clinical voice on pharmacy quality. Track regulatory specification changes and clinical guideline shifts and interpret what they mean for our operations. Lead peer-to-peer dialogue with clinical leaders within Devoted and our growing provider network.

  • Future Measure Readiness. Keep us ahead of the measure set rather than reacting to it. Track what CMS is developing, what sits on the display page, and what the measure developer pipeline is producing. Build the data and operational capability for a measure while it's still on display, so that when it enters Stars we are already performing instead of standing up a workflow. Own the read on every Advance Notice, Proposed Rule, and Final Rule, translate them into what specifically changes for Devoted, and bring us a point of view.

  • Strategy & Innovation. Design organization-wide strategies across the portfolio of clinical pharmacy measures to deliver 5-Star performance at scale. You will identify innovative opportunities to eliminate friction points along members’ healthcare journeys, empowering them to achieve their healthiest lives.

  • Excellent Cross-Functional Execution. Manage performance against operating KPIs and clinical outcomes metrics by partnering with internal Devoted teams and external partners, including our PBM, to design and implement solutions that improve clinical and care coordination interventions. You will translate goals into actionable strategies and guide initiatives from pilot phase through full-scale implementation across our member population as well as our provider and pharmacy networks.

  • Market Awareness. Keep a pulse on the vendor landscape: who is doing credible work in adherence stratification, pharmacist-led intervention, and pharmacy network engagement, what those platforms actually deliver versus what the sales deck promises, and whether there's a case for bringing one in. We build rather than buy by default. We expect you to have an informed opinion on when that calculus should change, and to be able to defend it either way.

  • Servant Leadership. Drive execution through a blend of direct management and leadership through influence, operating with a true servant-leader mindset that prioritizes enabling, unblocking, and supporting teams. You will translate complex operational goals into daily workflows that set our teams - and our members - up for success.

Required skills and experience:

  • PharmD or equivalent clinical degree. The role demands clinical credibility and independent clinical judgment on complex medication management strategies.

  • 7+ years of progressive leadership in managed care, a health plan, or a PBM, with dedicated ownership of Medicare Advantage and Part D quality programs and a documented, quantifiable track record of moving clinical pharmacy Stars measures in a volatile cut point environment.

  • Execution instinct. You are a relentless self-starter who refuses to let initiatives die in committee. You will roll up your sleeves to manipulate raw data, draft a workflow, or personally audit a vendor's call dispositions. You measure yourself on what shipped, not what was discussed. You thrive in environments where you need to move fast and adapt quickly.

  • Insight generation. Advanced analytical acumen and the ability to see past the surface of a dashboard to the root cause of non-adherence, then design the targeted, cost-effective intervention that addresses it. Comfort with business intelligence tooling and with sizing an opportunity before committing resources to it.

  • Demonstrated leadership impact and collaborative excellence, with experience successfully influencing outcomes across organizational levels, whether through direct management, cross-functional project leadership, or matrix reporting relationships that require building consensus without formal authority. You are energized by working with diverse backgrounds, and deeply motivated by helping our front line teams do their best work and members achieve their best, healthiest lives.

  • Clinical diplomacy. You can hold a nuanced clinical conversation with a skeptical clinical leader, earn their respect, and change prescribing behavior without authority over them.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Motivated by learning quickly in complex clinical and operational domains. You read the source material yourself and are excited to catch everyone up.

  • AI explorations. Curiosity about emerging technologies and a pragmatic approach to using them. Experience using LLMs to build complex prompts and tools is a strong plus.

  • Skill and rigor in using and analyzing data. You understand the pitfalls of metrics (e.g., how open vs. closed periods affect data, or how denominators shift over time). You are comfortable thinking in ranges and probabilities rather than false precision, and you can distinguish between a metric changing and the underlying reality changing.

Salary Range: $182,000 - $247,000 a year

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.

We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business.

Candidates residing within 50 miles of a hub location will be subject to in-office requirements.

This is a grade 13-14 range posting depending on experience and qualifications.

The Senior Claims Specialist works within a Claims Team, using the latest technology to review, analyze and process claims that are routinely characterized as moderately complex to complex within assigned authority limits. This includes making decisions about liability/compensability, evaluating losses, negotiating settlements and managing an inventory of commercial property/casualty claims involving bodily injury or property loss. The Senior Claims Specialist may also assist the Claims Team Manager with assigning new claims to team members, providing technical direction, and monitoring caseloads.

Refers to claim to subrogation group or Special Investigations Unit as appropriate.
  • Assesses policy coverage for submitted claims and notifies the insured of any issues; determines and establishes reserve requirements, adjusting reserves, as necessary, during the processing of the claim.
  • Assesses actual damages associated with claims and conducts negotiations, within assigned authority limits, to settle claims.
  • Coordinates the litigation activities associated with assigned claims to ensure a timely and cost-effective resolution; attends trials as a representative of the company.
  • Acts as senior technical professional on team, assisting team members with escalated issues. Mentors and trains new team members. Participates in Quality Review process.
  • Participates in conducting Suit Committees, Roundtables, Arbitrations, Mediations, field investigations and may assist in conducting closed file reviews.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills to communicate and negotiate with customers and conduct investigations required.

SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.

Job Description Summary:

The Principal Fire Protection Engineer serves as the technical authority and strategic lead for fire and life safety systems across utility-scale energy storage, power, and industrial EPC projects. This role ensures that all fire protection systems meet applicable codes, standards, insurance requirements, and client specifications while supporting safe and cost-effective project delivery from conceptual design through commissioning.

This role is fully remote. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

Job Description:

*This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned

Position Responsibilities and Duties:

Technical Subject Matter Expertise (SME)

  • Provide expert-level guidance on complex fire safety challenges and risk mitigation.

  • Establish company-wide engineering standards, design criteria, and best practices.

  • Lead and actively participate in national fire protection code and standards committees, contributing technical expertise to energy storage fire and life safety codes.

  • Serve as primary technical interface with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs), fire marshals, insurers, and independent engineers on fire and life safety topics while leveraging 3rd party EORs as needed. Travel to attend in-person meetings as required.

Project-level oversight of the BESS fire protection system

  • Develop project-specific basis-of-design documents for fire protection systems.

  • Develop scopes of work, RFPs, and evaluation criteria for 3rd party fire protection engineers-of-record (EOR) firms and equipment vendors.

  • Daily management and oversight of fire protection EORs, including design deliverable schedules and engineering budgets.

  • QA/QC of 3rd party work products (Hazard Mitigation Analysis, Emergency Response Plan, Fire Alarm Design, etc.) to ensure consistency with industry standards, SOLV standards, OEM Requirements, and project requirements.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with other engineering disciplines (primarily electrical and SCADA) to ensure design consistency and project efficiency.

  • Support the fire protection design optimization for cost, performance, and constructability.

  • Provide technical support during fire system testing and commissioning.

Leadership

  • Lead engagement with Owners as needed to answer relevant questions around fire protection design and strategy.

  • Provide technical training to the larger SOLV team as needed.

Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements:

  • 10+ years of fire protection engineering experience with at least 2 years of energy infrastructure experience.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Fire Protection Engineering or a closely related discipline (Mechanical, Electrical, or similar) from an accredited institution.

  • A license (P.E.) in Fire Protection Engineering is preferred.

  • Proven experience working with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs), including fire marshals and code officials, to secure approvals, ensure regulatory compliance, and successfully navigate permitting, design review, and inspection processes for complex fire protection systems.

  • Advanced understanding of fire protection engineering principles.

  • Demonstrated experience managing or reviewing work by external engineering consultants, owner’s engineers, or peer review on complex projects.

  • Working knowledge of applicable building codes (NFPA, IBC, UL 9540/9540A, UL855 etc.), engineering principles, and industry best practices

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Ability to work effectively both independently and within a team environment.

  • Proven ability to work across disciplines and time zones, and to manage multiple consultant contracts and deliverables in parallel.

  • Commitment to safety

  • Strong sense of urgency

  • Strong communication and project coordination skills

  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.

jobs.excerpt: About Routeware, Inc.  Routeware is the industry leader in providing software and data analysis that enables public and private enterprises to improve the effectiveness of their waste and recycling programs.
jobs.description:
About Routeware, Inc.

Routeware is the industry leader in providing software and data analysis that enables public and private enterprises to improve the effectiveness of their waste and recycling programs. Our solutions help organizations save time and money, increase efficiency, improve safety and help make our world a greener place.

Based in Portland, Oregon, the company employs a distributed team across North America and the UK. Our brands, products, and services provide an all-in-one platform to municipal and private waste haulers and other fleet services. As part of an essential and growing industry, we seek solution-oriented team players who want to positively impact the environment. Our work environment is collaborative, dynamic, fast-paced, and fun with a strong appreciation for innovation and initiative.

Our Mission:

  • Transform waste collection to drive a better future for generations to come.

Our Values:

  • Adaptability - The waste industry and technology are ever-changing, and the Routeware team never stops adapting to be at the forefront of technology innovation, supporting our customers to stay ahead.
  • Mission-driven - At Routeware, it matters to us that our work has a lasting positive impact on our customers' outcomes, our fellow team members' well-being, and the long-term sustainability of our environment.
  • Human-first - While technology drives our products; the real, live, caring people at Routeware are the true drivers of meaningful outcomes for our customers.

POSITION OVERVIEW

Routeware’s Business Operations product line manages the all-in-one connected front and back office for private haulers. Our customer is a municipal program manager; our user is a resident who just wants to know if Tuesday is a holiday and whether pizza boxes go in recycling.

We’re hiring a Product Manager to help drive day-to-day execution on this product line. You’ll partner closely with the VP of Product, taking on roadmap delivery, story writing, sprint execution, and validation work. Over time, as we unify teams and integrate further with the rest of the Routeware platform, your scope and ownership will grow. You’ll also work with a distributed engineering team that includes offshore developers, which means written clarity, detailed acceptance criteria, and async-friendly working habits matter.

This is a meaningful seat for a PM with a few years under their belt who wants to ship product in a B2B SaaS environment with a real societal impact. It’s also a great place to apply AI to a real-world problem, both exploring opportunities and helping ship production features that drive adoption.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Roadmap Execution & Delivery: Partner closely with the VP of Product to execute the product line roadmap. Own daily execution: discovery, story writing, sprint planning, acceptance criteria, and validation. Ship clean, on time, and with quality.
  • Cross-Product Collaboration: Contribute to integration work between Business Operations and the broader Routeware platform. Partner with PMs on adjacent product lines as we work toward a more unified portfolio.
  • Distributed Delivery & Engineering Partnership: Work effectively with a distributed engineering team that includes offshore developers. Write specs that don’t require a hallway conversation to interpret. Run sprint ceremonies in an async-friendly way.
  • AI Feature Delivery: Help identify, scope, and ship AI-powered capabilities in the resident journey — smarter search, conversational sorting guidance, personalized education, contamination reduction.
  • Launch & Adoption: Partner with Marketing, CS, and Support on go-to-market — release readiness, internal enablement, customer comms, and adoption tracking after launch.
  • Voice of Customer & Measurement: Stay close to Support and Customer Success — triage escalations, feed real-world signal back into the roadmap, and track KPIs for your scope (adoption, engagement, education effectiveness).

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Background shipping B2B products. You understand engagement, retention, and how to design for a non-expert end user.
  • 2–3+ years in Product Management or Product Ownership in SaaS, with progressive scope and ownership.
  • Strong agile fluency: backlog management, story writing, sprint planning, prioritization frameworks.
  • Experience working with distributed or offshore engineering teams — or strong evidence of the written clarity and async habits that make it work.
  • Strong analytical instincts — comfortable with product analytics, experimentation, and metrics-driven prioritization.
  • Familiarity with AI / LLM-powered product capabilities and the judgment to know where they add real value vs. where they’re overkill.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management; able to translate between customers, internal teams, and executives.
  • Hands-on fluency with Jira, Confluence, and a product analytics tool (Pendo, Amplitude, Mixpanel, similar).

Bonus

  • Background in civic tech, waste/recycling, utilities, or other municipal-adjacent SaaS.
  • Experience with behavior-change product design or educational/content-heavy product surfaces.
  • Track record contributing to product integration or unification work across multiple product lines.
  • Experience shipping AI features into a consumer-facing product.
  • Familiarity with localization, accessibility, and multi-tenant product configurability.

BENEFITS

  • Comprehensive benefits (medical with HSA option, vision, dental, and life insurance)
  • Paid parental leave
  • Medical and Dependent FSA
  • 401K match
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Ten company holidays
  • 1 Volunteer day
  • Summer Friday's

At Routeware, we are committed to the principle of equality, and all employment decisions are based on job requirements, business needs, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

jobs.description:
Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and succeed in the AI-driven content era. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

Marketers get a visual editor with reusable components, in-context preview, and workflows to launch fast and stay on brand. Developers have freedom to use their favorite frameworks and integrate with anything through the API-first platform. Brands get one source of truth for content that is accurate, flexible, and measurable.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact. It’s Joyful Headless™, and it changes everything.

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

  • Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)
  • Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding
  • Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays
  • Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material
  • VSOP (Virtual Stock Option Plan)
  • The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers
  • As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules
  • An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

JOB SUMMARY

We’re looking for a Senior QA Engineer who combines strong Playwright and TypeScript engineering skills with a proactive, collaborative mindset. You'll be a key contributor to how we deliver quality, raising the bar for our automation codebase and partnering closely with engineering to define how testing responsibility is shared across the team.

You’ll join our dynamic and growing Product Engineering team at Storyblok, playing an instrumental role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our flagship CMS platform. This platform empowers businesses to create and deliver seamless digital content experiences.

In this role, you'll work closely with product owners, designers, and developers to design and maintain clean, scalable, well-architected TypeScript automation, establish clear guidelines on which test level is right for a given change, and continuously refine QA strategies to maintain best-in-class software quality. Your work will directly contribute to delivering an exceptional user experience by ensuring flawless performance across every facet of our application.


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Own projects end-to-end with clarity, technical excellence, and accountability, ensuring high-quality standards across teams.
  • Champion strong TypeScript engineering practices and coding standards across the QA codebase, promoting engineering excellence and driving continuous improvement.
  • Design, implement, and maintain efficient, well-typed, and reliable automated tests across frontend and backend using Playwright.
  • Raise the team's TypeScript bar: introduce stronger typing patterns, reusable abstractions, linting/tooling standards, and code review practices that improve maintainability across the automation codebase.
  • Partner with engineering to define, implement, and enforce the test pyramid in practice, establishing clear guidelines on which test level (unit, integration, E2E) is appropriate for a given change, and driving adoption so both developers and QAs consistently write tests at the right level.
  • Perform manual and exploratory testing; document, track, and verify defects to ensure product excellence and analyze test results and monitor key testing metrics to identify patterns and opportunities for improvement.
  • Participate actively in project kick-offs to understand requirements, anticipate risks, and influence testability from the earliest stages.
  • Identify and communicate issues, risks, or dependencies early, escalating to product leadership when necessary.
  • Mentor and support teammates on TypeScript proficiency and Playwright best practices, fostering an open, empathetic environment that encourages learning and feedback.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • 7+ years of relevant experience as a QA Engineer or Software Engineer in Test.
  • Deep proficiency in TypeScript, including a strong command of advanced typing and code architecture, as well as Playwright.
  • Practical experience partnering with engineers to define and roll out test pyramid guidelines, including setting expectations for which test level is appropriate and holding both developers and QAs accountable for following them.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and experience creating and maintaining containerized test environments.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence and align across technical and product teams.
  • High attention to detail, proven ability to deliver results, and a strong motivation to contribute to organizational growth in a high-performing environment.
  • Experience mentoring engineers, defining and driving TypeScript and test automation standards across teams.
  • Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience writing and maintaining Ruby on Rails code.
  • Experience with observability and error tracking tools (eg. Grafana, Kibana, Sentry) and identifying errors, trends, and issues.
  • Experience with performance testing and best practices.

MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS

Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space

GENERAL TERMS

Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. About Tailscale

Tailscale is building the new Internet by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We’re seeking a talented and motivated full-time Software Engineer to join our growing team. You will work as part of the engineering team to:

  • Develop the Tailscale product, contributing to client code and backend services. The client code is a mix of C#, XAML, and Go. Prior Go expertise is not a requirement.
  • Bring a special focus on our Windows platform, building and maintaining our Windows client using the modern WinUI/Windows App SDK stack, while contributing to common code that supports macOS, mobile, and other core client platforms.

Because we’re an early-stage and fully remote company, we’re looking for a motivated individual who can help move the product forward. The ability to think on your feet, collaborate with highly technical teams, and comfort working asynchronously are essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with engineers on a native Windows desktop client using Windows App SDK, WinUI, C#, XAML and Go
  • Implement support for the latest Windows platform features while maintaining compatibility with a subset of older versions
  • Develop and optimize product features on Windows, with a focus on UI components and platform integration
  • Develop and maintain unit and integration tests using Microsoft Testing Platform v2 and xUnit
  • Contribute to common, cross-platform Tailscale code

What We Are Looking For

  • Four or more years of experience in software development
  • Strong understanding of software development principles, capabilities, and limitations of the Windows platform
  • Proficiency in C# and modern native UI frameworks (WinUI/UWP/WPF)
  • Experience with general networking concepts - DNS, VPNs, IP Networking, routing, etc.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to give and process constructive feedback, as well as work independently
  • Flexibility to adjust to the dynamic nature of a startup

Nice to Have

  • Experience with WinUI 3 and Windows App SDK
  • Experience developing native Windows applications and services
  • Familiarity with Windows networking stack and Windows Filtering Platform
  • Familiarity with Windows security model, session isolation, access tokens and related concepts
  • Proficiency in Go

Ziply Fiber is a local internet service provider dedicated to elevating the connected lives of the communities we serve. We offer the fastest home internet in the nation, a refreshingly great customer experience, and affordable plans that put customers in charge.

As our state-of-the-art fiber network expands, so does our need for team members who can help us grow and realize our goals.

Our Company Values:

  • Genuinely Caring:We treat customers and colleagues like neighbors, with empathy and full attention.
  • Empowering You:We help customers choose what is best for them, and we support employees in implementing new ideas and solutions.
  • Innovation and Improvement:We constantly seek ways to improve how we serve customers and each other.
  • Earning Your Trust:We build trust through clear, honest, human communication.

Job Summary

Ziply Fiber is building one of the most technically advanced fiber-first broadband networks in the Pacific Northwest, and we're moving fast. As Vice President of Network Architecture & Engineering, you will serve as the chief technical authority for our full network stack — access, voice, subscriber edge, IP core, transport, and infrastructure. You will lead a team of Principal Architects and Directors, own the multi-year technology roadmap, and drive the transformation programs that reduce cost, accelerate deployment, and position Ziply for competitive leadership in every market we enter.

This is an executive role that demands equal command of technical depth and business impact. You will build the business cases, secure the investments, and deliver the results — measured in dollars saved, deployment velocity accelerated, and operational dependencies eliminated.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The Essential Duties and Responsibilities listed below are a range of duties performed by the employee and not intended to reflect all duties performed.

Network Architecture Strategy & Transformation

·Define and own the multi-year network architecture roadmap across voice, access, subscriber edge, IP core & metro, transport, and infrastructure domains.

·Drive technology transformation programs: legacy platform exits, vendor-agnostic architecture adoption, zero-touch provisioning, and network automation.

Leadership & Organizational Capability

·Lead and scale a team of Principal Architects and Directors; build organizational capability through director- and principal-level hiring and development.

·Represent the technology organization in executive-level discussions, board briefings, and strategic partnership negotiations.

·Set clear objectives, success metrics, and accountability for architecture and engineering leaders; coach teams through complex technical, financial, and organizational tradeoffs.

·Develop succession depth and leadership bench strength for critical architecture and engineering functions.

Business Case, Investment & Financial Planning

·Develop and own business cases for major network investments — quantifying cost savings, stranded asset recovery, and competitive positioning for executive and board approval.

·Deliver measurable cost reductions through optics standardization, technology consolidation (DACS, legacy platforms), and operational independence from TSA and vendor lock-in agreements.

·Collaborate with the Enterprise Delivery Office on CapEx and OpEx planning for all network engineering initiatives.

Technology Certification, Vendor Strategy & Selection

·Establish and operate a technology certification program: device qualification, PoC lab management, vendor-donated equipment programs, and accelerated certification cycles.

·Own vendor and technology selection: RFPs, PoCs, architecture reviews, and contract negotiations across the network stack.

Cross-Functional Operations & Execution

·Partner with Network Planning, Platform Ops, IT/Platform Technology, and NOC to ensure architecture enables operational efficiency and autonomous network operations.

Other Duties

·Performs other duties as required to support the business and evolving organization.

Required Qualifications:

·High school diploma or GED.

·Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience.

·15+ years of progressive network engineering and architecture experience, with 5+ years in a senior leadership role at a broadband ISP, CLEC, or telco.

·Proven track record of delivering large-scale network transformation programs with quantifiable business impact — cost savings, asset recovery, or competitive differentiation measured in the tens to hundreds of millions.

·Experience scaling high-performance architecture or engineering teams; demonstrated ability to add director- and principal-level talent to strengthen organizational capability.

·Hands-on experience with transport (400G/100G), fiber voice/VoIP business cases, and CPE/modem platform migrations at scale.

·Deep familiarity with zero-touch provisioning, vendor-agnostic orchestration, and network automation platforms.

·Experience exiting legacy technology dependencies: TSA agreements, end-of-life platforms (DACS, TDM, legacy ACS), and third-party operational agreements.

·Strong business acumen: ability to build, defend, and deliver on multi-million-dollar investment cases at the executive level.

·Excellent cross-functional leadership: able to align engineering, operations, finance, and vendor partners around shared outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications:

·Advanced degree such as MS, MBA, or equivalent executive-level business or technical education.

·Experience establishing or operating a technology lab or architecture center (vendor certification, PoC environments, donated equipment programs).

·Background in digital transformation or operations modernization — omni-channel, automation, AI-assisted operations, or field technician tooling.

·Intellectual property, publication, patent, or industry thought-leadership experience in networking, automation, platform modernization, or subscriber experience domains.

·Prior experience at a fiber-first or fiber-overbuilder ISP in a competitive broadband market.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

·Ability to work independently and apply sound judgment and reasoning skills to a variety of situations.

·Ability to multi-task and collaborate effectively with other personnel to meet deadlines.

·Strong verbal and written communication, attention to detail, and organizational skills.

·Ability to work within critical deadlines.

·Ability to adjust to rapidly changing priorities and schedules.

·Ability to provide excellent customer service.

·Executive presence with the ability to influence across Technology, Operations, Finance, Legal, Product, and executive leadership.

·Strong analytical, financial, and decision-making skills with the ability to balance technical excellence, customer impact, operational risk, and business value.

·Ability to build trust, lead through ambiguity, and drive alignment in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the US for any employer. Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Essential and marginal functions may require maintaining physical condition necessary for bending, stooping, sitting, walking, or standing for prolonged periods of time; most of time is spent sitting in a comfortable position with frequent opportunity to move about. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

Work is performed in an office setting with exposure to computer screens and requires extensive use of a computer, keyboard, mouse, and multi-line telephone system. The work is primarily a modern office setting.

Unless otherwise prohibited by law, employees may not hold outside employment nor be self-employed without obtaining approval in writing from Ziply Fiber. In holding outside employment or self-employment, employees should ensure that participation does not conflict with responsibilities to Ziply Fiber or its business interests.

jobs.excerpt: United We Dream (UWD) is the largest immigrant youth-led community in the country.
jobs.description:
United We Dream (UWD) is the largest immigrant youth-led community in the country. We create welcoming spaces for young people – regardless of immigration status – to support, engage, and empower them to make their voice heard and win!

With an online reach of over 2 million, more than 500,000 members as well as over 100 local groups, UWD is made up of fearless youth fighting to improve the lives of our members and their families. Our vision is a society which celebrates our diversity and believes in a multi-ethnic, intersectional path to getting there.

Whether we’re organizing in the streets, providing immigration services, building innovative technology systems, opening doors for LGBTQ immigrant youth, clearing pathways to education, stopping deportations or creating alliances across social movements, United We Dream puts undocumented immigrant youth in the driver’s seat. UWD is a fast paced, dynamic

organization which has become a leading voice in social change and has appeared in every major news outlet in the country.

We are driven by the priorities and needs of our members; have trained thousands of individuals; and have supported countless local organizing groups. Our grassroots-driven approach has a proven record of success and we’re looking for talented folks to join our team!

POSITION SUMMARY

The Leading the Dream Campaign Fellowship is a fellowship program for college students (sophomores, juniors, and seniors) who are passionate about social justice and energized to advocate for change in their communities. The program will provide fellows with training, coaching, and hands-on experience to grow their skills as organizers and leaders. Fellows will also have the opportunity to become part of a community of like-minded youth advocates and to become a part of the United We Dream Network. Fellows will be expected to fully engage with the training curriculum to build up their campaign and advocacy skills and to complete a set of assignments putting those skills into action. This is a remote, part-time position.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Participate in weekly workshops throughout the 10 weeks of the program to grow your critical thinking skills, develop key campaign and organizing skills, and deepen your understanding of social justice advocacy and transformation.
  • Build relationships with UWD members, student organizations and local interest groups, forging strategic partnerships to amplify the visibility of member campaigns and mobilize collective action.
  • Participate in recurring trainings, meetings, check-ins, and one-on-ones with UWD staff, members, and partners to build and strengthen relationships, complete assignments as needed, and put your campaign skills into practice.

Video Editor (Adobe Premiere, Social Media & Marketing Content) – Remote | U.S. Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours, with flexibility for launches, campaigns, and deadlines

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re hiring a Video Editor for one of our clients to create engaging, polished, and performance-driven video content across social media, marketing campaigns, paid advertising, websites, and internal communications.

This is more than a technical editing role. You’ll be responsible for turning raw footage into compelling stories designed to capture attention, increase watch time, improve audience retention, and strengthen campaign performance.

You’ll create and optimize content across platforms including TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube, LinkedIn, websites, and paid advertising channels.

If you understand how editing pace, storytelling, hooks, visuals, and platform-specific formats influence content performance, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Video Editing & Content Creation

  • Edit raw footage into polished, engaging, and professional videos.
  • Create both short-form and long-form content.
  • Work with editing platforms such as:
    • Adobe Premiere Pro
    • Final Cut Pro
    • DaVinci Resolve
  • Build edits around strong storytelling, pacing, and audience attention.
  • Create compelling openings and maintain viewer interest throughout each video.
  • Align every edit with brand guidelines, campaign objectives, and marketing goals.
  • Adapt editing styles based on platform, audience, and content purpose.

Social Media & Platform Optimization

  • Create platform-native video content for:
    • TikTok
    • Instagram Reels
    • YouTube & YouTube Shorts
    • LinkedIn
    • Websites
    • Paid advertising campaigns
  • Adapt content into multiple aspect ratios, including:
    • 16:9
    • 9:16
    • 1:1
  • Repurpose footage into multiple pieces of content without making each version feel repetitive.
  • Optimize exports for the appropriate combination of quality, file size, and platform requirements.
  • Understand how editing styles differ between short-form social content, long-form video, and advertising creative.

Motion Graphics & Visual Enhancements

  • Add professional:
    • Captions
    • Titles
    • Lower thirds
    • Motion graphics
    • Transitions
    • Visual overlays
  • Use tools such as Adobe After Effects and Canva when appropriate.
  • Maintain consistent typography, visual language, and brand presentation.
  • Enhance videos without over-editing or distracting from the core message.

Audio & Color

  • Clean and balance audio for professional output.
  • Improve dialogue clarity and reduce unwanted background noise.
  • Handle audio syncing and volume leveling.
  • Add appropriate licensed music and sound effects.
  • Perform color correction and grading.
  • Maintain visual consistency between different cameras, clips, and environments.

Footage & Project Management

  • Import, organize, and maintain raw footage and creative assets.
  • Keep project files and folder structures clean and consistent.
  • Maintain clear version control throughout revision cycles.
  • Archive completed projects so footage and assets can be easily retrieved and repurposed.
  • Manage multiple editing projects and deadlines simultaneously.

Collaboration & Revisions

  • Work closely with:
    • Marketing teams
    • Content strategists
    • Creative teams
  • Receive and manage feedback through tools such as Frame.io and shared review systems.
  • Turn revisions around quickly while maintaining quality.
  • Communicate clearly about timelines, creative requirements, and deliverables.
  • Incorporate stakeholder feedback without losing consistency or creative direction.

Performance Optimization

  • Review content performance metrics including:
    • Watch time
    • Audience retention
    • Engagement
    • CTR
  • Identify patterns in high- and low-performing content.
  • Apply performance insights to future edits.
  • Collaborate with marketing teams to test new hooks, formats, pacing, and creative approaches.
  • Continuously improve editing decisions based on actual audience behavior.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You understand that great video editing is about storytelling and attention, not just transitions and effects.
  • You know how to make the opening seconds of a video count.
  • You can edit both short-form and long-form content effectively.
  • You understand how content consumption differs across TikTok, Reels, YouTube, LinkedIn, and paid ads.
  • You can execute quickly without sacrificing quality.
  • You’re highly organized and comfortable managing multiple projects.
  • You take ownership of your work from raw footage through final export.
  • You’re receptive to feedback and can handle revision cycles professionally.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional video editing experience.
  • Strong proficiency with one or more of:
    • Adobe Premiere Pro
    • Final Cut Pro
    • DaVinci Resolve
  • Experience editing social media and marketing content.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Video pacing
    • Storytelling
    • Viewer retention
    • Platform-specific content
  • Experience with:
    • Audio cleanup and syncing
    • Color correction
    • Captions and graphics
    • Multi-platform formatting
    • Platform-specific exports
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Portfolio demonstrating professional video editing work.

Preferred Experience

  • Adobe After Effects and motion graphics experience.
  • Experience editing:
    • Paid advertising creatives
    • UGC-style videos
    • Performance marketing content
    • Short-form social content
    • Long-form YouTube content
  • Familiarity with performance metrics such as:
    • Watch time
    • Audience retention
    • CTR
    • Engagement
  • Experience using Frame.io or similar creative review platforms.
  • Background supporting:
    • SaaS companies
    • E-commerce brands
    • Marketing agencies
    • Media companies

What a Typical Day Looks Like

A Video Editor’s day revolves around turning raw footage into content people actually want to watch. You will:

  • Review and organize incoming footage and creative briefs.
  • Edit short-form and long-form videos.
  • Create social media and marketing campaign content.
  • Add captions, graphics, transitions, and sound design.
  • Perform audio cleanup and color correction.
  • Create platform-specific versions and exports.
  • Review feedback and complete revisions.
  • Analyze content performance to improve future edits.
  • Archive completed projects and maintain organized creative files.

In short: you transform raw footage into polished, platform-native video content that captures attention, tells a compelling story, and drives measurable engagement.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • On-time delivery of video projects.
  • Strong audience watch time and retention.
  • Improved engagement across video content.
  • Consistent brand quality across platforms.
  • Reduced and efficient revision cycles.
  • Accurate platform-specific formatting and delivery.
  • Organized, scalable project and asset management.
  • Positive feedback from marketing and creative stakeholders.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High ownership over creative output.
  • Direct impact on marketing and content performance.
  • Opportunity to create content across multiple platforms and formats.
  • Exposure to organic social, paid advertising, and brand content.
  • Performance-driven environment where creative decisions can be measured.
  • Fully remote collaboration with U.S.-based teams.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Video Editor
    • Creative Lead
    • Senior Content Producer
    • Content Director

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Portfolio Review + Practical Editing Task
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you:

  • Love video editing and visual storytelling
  • Understand Adobe Premiere Pro and modern editing workflows
  • Know what makes social media content engaging
  • Can edit for both short-form and long-form formats
  • Understand pacing, hooks, watch time, and audience retention
  • Thrive in a fast-moving creative environment

We’d love to see your work.

Apply today with your portfolio or video editing reel and help create content that captures attention, strengthens brands, and drives performance.

Business Area:

Product Mgmt.

Job Description:

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

As a designer at Cloudera your main focus is to let your curiosity drive you. You will use your passion and knowledge to create precision-crafted designs that bring simplicity and innovation to our products and services. The Cloudera Platform helps customers manage the lifecycle of their data, from the edge to AI. Our hybrid data platform delivers unprecedented value to our customers and is key to our overall strategy and success. We need an experienced and talented designer to drive enterprise ready improvements and cross cutting product design initiatives related to the Cloudera Platform.

You will be leading the full user-centered design process, from user interviews, competitor analysis, high fidelity interface designs, prototypes, feature validation, and working with engineering to uphold the quality of implementation. All while partnering closely with other designers and your product triad to deliver the most usable solutions possible. Additionally, you will work closely with the entire design team to improve our process, our design system, and our design culture. The culture of the Cloudera Design team is human first, we actively seek to grow each member’s career through outside education and candid, compassionate feedback from other experienced designers.

As a Lead UX Designer you will:

  • Design user flows, diagrams, wireframes, and designs to satisfy product requirements and follow product design standards.

  • Create high-fidelity visual designs and/or prototypes that demonstrate user flows.

  • Deliver design specifications and supporting assets to the development teams.

  • Participate in design reviews to collect feedback from designers and stakeholders.

  • Facilitate collaborative workshops that unlock innovation.

  • Be the champion of the Product Triad to inspire meaningful collaboration to help your team realize their best work possible

  • Iterate on existing application features to improve usability and drive key metrics.

  • Assist in the planning and estimating of design activities, participating in broader workflow coordination and setting of expectations.

  • Conduct product research and usability studies.

  • Dive deep into domain research, understanding the customers and the technology.

  • Conduct competitive analysis of other products and services.

  • Contribute to and maintain design pattern libraries.

  • Provide mentorship and guidance to other members of the design team.

We are excited if you have (Required Experience):

  • 6+ years of professional experience in UX design, UI design, product design, and/or web

  • Self-starter with excellent time management skills and ability to handle multiple projects with shifting priorities.

  • Portfolio exhibiting the ability to conceptualize and demonstrate visual communication skills. Examples of process and design approaches are highly recommended.

  • Strong understanding of user centered design processes and methodology, particularly as applied to enterprise software, PAAS, and on-prem applications.

  • Mastery of design principles with a firm understanding of grid systems, typography, and color.

  • A strong attention to detail and consistency in design.

  • Experience in coordinating and conducting qualitative and quantitative research, including usability studies, discovery interviews, and product analytics data analysis.

  • Strong collaborator experienced in working with cross-functional, international teams.

  • Demonstrable systems thinking skills.

  • Proficient in Figma, Figma Make, Zeplin, and relevant AI-assisted design and prototyping tools.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field required or equivalent experience.

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills are required.

  • Experience working with cloud, on-prem and hybrid data platforms, or other similar technologies.

You might also have:

  • Strong opinions & curiosity of AI & Design, along with your own experiments, workflows and AI x design processes.

  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, front-end javascript frameworks, and mobile centric design patterns.

  • Experience designing for data streaming, data engineering, data warehousing, machine learning and AI applications.

This is a full-time contract role.

The anticipated hourly range for this position is: 65.00-70.00/HR

Join the National Leader in Cloud-Based Property Management

Our Story: 🏡

PropertyMe is Australia’s number one property management platform. With over 60% market share, more than 35,000 real estate professionals rely on PropertyMe every day to manage over 1.8 million properties across Australia and New Zealand. Backed by EQT, a global investment firm with deep expertise in technology and vertical SaaS, we’re not resting on our laurels.

We’re building something bigger. PropertyMe is expanding from a best-in-class property management platform into a connected ecosystem that brings property management, CRM, payments, trust accounting and AI-driven productivity tools together in one place. The recent launch of PropertyMe Grow – our purpose-built CRM and growth platform for real estate agencies – marks a significant new chapter. For the first time, agencies can manage their entire operation, from winning new business to managing properties and everything in between, on a single platform.

Your work here won’t be abstract. It will directly shape how thousands of Australian real estate professionals, tenants and property owners experience their day-to-day lives.

Your Mission: 🚀

We’re looking for a New Business Representative to join our mid-market sales team. This is a true hunter role focused on winning new logos and expanding existing customers.

You’ll engage agency principals and directors on platform transformation—guiding strategic conversations, not just selling software. In real estate, trust and relationships are key, and we need someone who understands that.

With PropertyMe Grow and our payments platform, you’ll bring a differentiated, multi-product story—positioning an integrated solution across operations, CRM, payments, trust accounting, and AI workflows.

Responsibilities 🏢

Win New Business

  • Identify, qualify and close new agency opportunities within defined mid-market segments across Australia and New Zealand.
  • Lead discovery conversations with agency principals and leadership teams, positioning PropertyMe as the platform that replaces fragmentation with clarity.
  • Drive daily prospecting and outbound activity – the sort of consistent, disciplined effort that turns pipeline into revenue.

Sell the Platform Story

  • Articulate the full PropertyMe ecosystem: property management operations, Grow (CRM), trust accounting, payments and AI productivity tools.
  • Demonstrate value through product demonstrations and consultative conversations, not feature dumps.
  • Guide customers through platform consolidation decisions, helping them see what their business looks like when it actually works together.

Expand Existing Accounts

  • Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities within existing mid-market customers, particularly around Grow and the broader product suite.
  • Build deep relationships that naturally surface expansion opportunities, rather than relying solely on transactional touchpoints.

Build and Manage Pipeline

  • Develop a healthy pipeline through marketing-generated leads, industry relationships, events, partner introductions and your own proactive outreach.
  • Maintain impeccable pipeline hygiene and CRM accuracy in Salesforce to ensure confident forecasting and timely follow-ups.

Engage with the Industry

  • Represent PropertyMe at industry events, conferences and networking opportunities as someone who genuinely knows the space.
  • Develop relationships with franchise groups, industry bodies, influencers and agency leaders.
  • Monitor competitor activity, market trends and legislative changes – and feed those insights back to inform product and sales strategy.

Collaborate Across Teams

  • Partner with onboarding, customer success and support to ensure a seamless handover from sale to long-term platform adoption.
  • Act as a conduit between the market and our product team, ensuring customer feedback shapes what we build next.

What you bring 🌟

Required

  • A track record of success in SaaS new business sales, with experience selling into mid-market or enterprise segments.
  • Proven ability to close complex B2B deals and consistently meet or exceed revenue targets.
  • Experience engaging senior decision-makers – principals, directors and C-suite – in consultative, value-led sales conversations.
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms (Salesforce strongly preferred).
  • The ability to self-manage, self-motivate and maintain a high-activity rhythm without someone standing over your shoulder.

Highly Regarded

  • Experience selling into the real estate or property management industry.
  • Experience in platform or multi-product SaaS sales, where cross-selling is a core growth lever.
  • A working understanding of agency operations, PropTech or the property management ecosystem.
  • Prior experience in a high-growth, PE-backed SaaS environment.

Who you are 💭

A Strategic Hunter. You get genuine satisfaction from opening doors that others walk past. You build pipeline with intent, not hope.

A Platform Storyteller. You can take a complex, multi-product ecosystem and distil it into a clear, compelling vision of what an agency’s future looks like.

A Commercial Thinker. You translate product capability into tangible operational and financial outcomes. You speak the language of business impact, not just features.

Relationship-Driven. You understand that trust takes time to build and seconds to lose. In real estate, that matters more than most industries.

Resilient and Self-Driven. You thrive in a fast-moving environment; own your territory like it’s your business and maintain the daily discipline that separates consistent performers from occasional ones.

Why PropertyMe 🩵

Market Leader – Over 60% market share in Property management This isn’t a challenger brand; it’s the platform thousands of agencies already trust.

Multi-Product Momentum – The launch of PropertyMe Grow creates a genuinely new sales motion and cross-sell opportunity that didn’t exist twelve months ago.

Backed by EQT – Serious investment behind serious ambition. The resources and strategic support to scale.

Uncapped Earning Potential – Competitive base salary plus commission structure designed to reward hunters who deliver.

Career Trajectory – A growing company with expanding teams, new products and new markets means genuine opportunities to grow with us.

Impact – Your work directly affects how real estate professionals, tenants and property owners experience their daily lives.

It’s uncertain times at the moment, but there’s nothing uncertain about the opportunity here at PropertyMe, we’re building something special and we want to chat with you about joining us, no matter your background. Apply now or check out our People & Culture team on LinkedIn, we’re always open for a chat!

Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

As a Dedicated Sales Activation Specialist, you will support the setup and launch of our new clients 401(k) plans while representing our White Label partners. This joint effort means you'll be on the front lines with our new clients/partners, working with a wide variety of companies (anything from the local plumber to the nationwide robotics firm), helping them set up and launch their new 401(k) plans. You'll own keeping the sales activation process on-track while ensuring that customers and partners are engaged and happy. Process-driven and people-focused - you are organized, friendly and flexible.

You will be accountable for hitting key performance metrics, identifying and escalating operational blockers to consistently launch a high volume of plans while delivering an exceptional customer experience. If you are energized by helping business owners meet their goals, being challenged with monthly targets, and fast-changing environments, this is the opportunity for you. We move at 24,791 mph - you should be ready to lead at speed

What you get to do every day

  • Communicate extensively with our customers to identify their needs and help them establish their 401(k) plans
  • Educate, guide, and inform our newly signed customers about the choices they have to help their employees save for retirement
  • Meet monthly activation targets by closely working client pipelines, managing client timelines, objection handling to keep clients in the flow and ensuring adherence to process and talk tracks.
  • Actively follow onboarding workflows to increase velocity, remove bottlenecks, and drive operational excellence.
  • Partner cross-functionally with internal teams and Leadership to resolve customer escalations and continuously improve the sales activation experience.

  • Drive processes forward, managing internal and external stakeholders to keep our customers engaged, happy, and on-track

What you bring to the role

  • Strong PC skills, including experience working with G-Suite products

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own.
