Position Title: Security Engineer, Cloud

Position Location: Remote in the United States

Job Summary:

The Cloud Security Engineer is responsible for securing and improving the organization’s cloud environments, with a primary focus on Microsoft Azure. This role partners closely with platform, engineering, infrastructure, and Security Operations teams to implement cloud security governance, secure architecture patterns, identity and access controls, monitoring capabilities, and compliance-aligned security controls. The ideal candidate combines hands-on Azure security expertise with strong knowledge of cloud governance, landing zone architecture, and secure deployment practices to help create a cloud environment that is secure, scalable, and operationally sustainable by design.

Essential Functions:

  • Design, implement, and maintain cloud security guardrails across Microsoft Azure environments, including subscription governance, resource organization, role-based access controls, and secure configuration baselines.
  • Develop and support Azure landing zone architectures, including management group hierarchy, policy enforcement, governance standards, tagging strategies, and security controls that minimize organizational risk.
  • Configure and maintain cloud security capabilities including encryption, secrets management, logging, monitoring, alerting, and secure remote administration solutions.
  • Collaborate with platform, engineering, and infrastructure teams to conduct architecture reviews and implement secure cloud networking and hardening initiatives.
  • Perform cloud security posture reviews to identify misconfigurations, excessive permissions, security gaps, and compliance drift within cloud environments.
  • Support the investigation, detection, and remediation of cloud security incidents in partnership with Security Operations and infrastructure teams.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation and evidence demonstrating cloud security control implementation, monitoring, and compliance alignment.
  • Support secure infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and deployment practices by establishing repeatable security guardrails and standards across environments.
  • Provide recommendations for secure connectivity, segmentation, workload hardening, and monitoring coverage to improve cloud security maturity.
  • Coordinate with Security Operations, Governance Risk and Compliance (GRC), architecture teams, and auditors to support cloud control validation and compliance reviews.
  • Enable engineering and delivery teams to adopt secure cloud development and deployment practices while ensuring security requirements are measurable and consistently applied.

Required Skills/Abilities/Competencies:

  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure cloud security architecture, including subscription governance, resource organization, and role-based access control (RBAC).
  • Experience designing and implementing Azure landing zones, management group structures, governance frameworks, and policy-based security controls.
  • Expertise in cloud identity and access management, privileged access controls, policy enforcement, secrets management, encryption, logging, and monitoring.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking, segmentation, workload hardening, and secure connectivity principles.
  • Experience conducting cloud security assessments, posture reviews, and remediation planning.
  • Ability to build, refine, and support cloud detection capabilities and coordinate cloud security investigations and response activities.
  • Working knowledge of infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and policy-as-code concepts, including secure and repeatable deployment methodologies.
  • Proficiency in scripting, automation, and cloud operational tooling to improve security effectiveness and efficiency.
  • Ability to document technical architectures, communicate security requirements clearly, and collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience mapping cloud security controls to audit, compliance, and evidence requirements.
  • Knowledge of centralized logging, security monitoring, and detection engineering practices within cloud environments.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, collaboration, and project coordination skills.
  • Demonstrated competencies in Cloud Security Engineering, Azure Governance, Cloud Identity and Access Management, Secure Networking, Logging and Monitoring, Secrets Management, Cloud Posture Management, Infrastructure as Code Security, and Architecture Review.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of hands-on cloud security, cloud infrastructure security, or related cybersecurity experience.
  • Experience implementing and supporting Microsoft Azure security controls, governance frameworks, and cloud architecture best practices.
  • Experience performing cloud security assessments, control reviews, remediation planning, and security posture management activities.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code, cloud automation, and cloud architecture concepts.
  • Experience supporting audit, compliance, and evidence collection activities related to cloud security controls is preferred.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Defender for Cloud or equivalent cloud security posture management and cloud workload protection tools is preferred.
  • Exposure to AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environments is preferred, particularly in multi-cloud governance or security programs.
  • Experience participating in cloud architecture reviews, landing zone implementations, or cloud security assessments is preferred.
  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500), CISSP, CCSK, or equivalent cloud security certifications are preferred.

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.

jobs.title: Principal UI Developer
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleThe Appointment Scheduling platform at Engageware is the front door to some of the most important moments in a customer's day — booking time with their banker, checking in at the branch, waiting in queue, or meeting virtually with a specialist.
jobs.description:
About the Role

The Appointment Scheduling platform at Engageware is the front door to some of the most important moments in a customer's day — booking time with their banker, checking in at the branch, waiting in queue, or meeting virtually with a specialist. Behind those experiences sits a suite of purpose-built applications: a multi-tenant admin console, customer-facing scheduling interfaces, in-branch self-check-in kiosks, queue management and concierge tools for branch staff, and virtual channel integrations — all running at enterprise scale for leading banks, credit unions, and healthcare organizations.

We're looking for a Principal UI Developer who can own this surface end-to-end. That means leading the migration of our Angular application estate to React, setting the front-end architecture and design system, owning features all the way through the API layer when needed, and bringing strong design sensibility to interfaces that have had limited dedicated design attention. This is a high-leverage role, and we expect AI tooling to be a meaningful part of how you operate — scaffolding components, generating tests, assisting with Angular-to-React migration, exploring design directions quickly — so the scope is real but so is the support.

What You'll Do

React Migration & Front-End Architecture

  • Own the migration strategy for the Appointment Scheduling front-end estate — defining how and in what sequence we move existing Angular applications (admin console, scheduling flows, kiosk, queue management, concierge) to a modern React foundation.
  • Establish the shared component library, design tokens, state management patterns (React Query, Zustand, or Redux Toolkit), and routing architecture that all new and migrated applications are built on.
  • Make pragmatic migration decisions — incremental strangler-fig patterns vs. targeted rebuilds — balancing speed, risk, and continuity for live enterprise customers.
  • Define the module boundaries and shared abstractions that allow Angular and React to coexist safely during the transition.

Design System & Interface Quality

  • Own the visual and interaction language for the Appointment Scheduling platform: component library, spacing system, color tokens, typography, and interaction patterns — maintained in Storybook and connected to Figma where design work happens.
  • Bring design sensibility to every interface you ship. In the absence of dedicated design resources, you are the person who catches the awkward empty state, the unclear confirmation flow, the button that doesn't belong. You use AI design tools (Figma AI, v0, Claude) to explore and prototype directions quickly rather than waiting for a design brief.
  • Ensure all applications meet WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards — a non-negotiable for banking and healthcare customers with regulatory obligations.
  • Optimize for the full deployment surface: responsive web, touch-screen kiosks (constrained sizes, high-contrast, minimal input complexity), and staff-facing branch tablets in fast-paced environments.

API Layer & End-to-End Feature Ownership

  • Own features end-to-end when the critical path runs through the front end: design and build the BFF (Backend for Frontend) endpoints, lightweight Spring Boot routes, and data-shaping layers the UI requires — without waiting on someone else to unblock you.
  • Design clean REST API contracts between front-end applications and the scheduling platform services, with clear error-handling conventions and versioning.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers on deeper service-layer work, contributing meaningfully to API design reviews and surfacing front-end integration requirements early.
  • Handle the full stack of front-end reliability concerns: caching strategies, optimistic UI, graceful degradation, and real-time event handling (WebSockets, SSE) where the scheduling experience demands it.

Test-Driven Development & Quality

  • Champion test-driven development across all front-end work: unit tests, component tests, and end-to-end tests written alongside code, not after.
  • Establish and enforce testing standards using Vitest or Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright or Cypress — so the team can migrate, refactor, and ship with confidence.
  • Use AI-assisted test generation as an accelerant, not a shortcut: AI scaffolds the coverage, you ensure it's meaningful and deterministic.
  • Lead front-end code reviews focused on testability, maintainability, and architectural consistency.

AI-Augmented Development

  • Operate with AI as a core part of your workflow: use coding agents (built on Claude) for component scaffolding, Angular-to-React migration assistance, test generation, accessibility audits, and design exploration via v0 or Figma AI.
  • Help the team adopt AI-augmented development confidently — setting the guardrails (review standards, coverage requirements) that keep quality high when AI is doing real work.
  • Stay current on agentic development patterns (including MCP-based tooling) as the ecosystem evolves rapidly.

Technical Leadership

  • Set the front-end technical direction for the Appointment Scheduling team, documenting architectural decisions so the team builds consistently.
  • Mentor front-end engineers on React, TypeScript, testing, accessibility, and API integration.
  • Partner directly with the Principal PM and Team Lead on new features — shaping what is buildable, raising UX and implementation concerns early, and influencing decisions before specs are locked.

What We're Looking For

Must-have qualifications:

  • 8+ years in front-end or full-stack web development, with 3+ years at a senior or principal IC level owning front-end architecture for a production application suite.
  • Expert-level React and TypeScript — hooks, concurrent features, performance optimization, and common state management patterns.
  • Real experience migrating Angular applications to React in production, with the judgment to choose incremental migration over rewrites where appropriate.
  • Strong Angular fluency (multiple versions) — you need to read, reason about, and migrate existing codebases confidently.
  • Ability and willingness to own the API layer for front-end features: BFF patterns, REST endpoint design, and working in Spring Boot (Java) for UI-adjacent services.
  • Genuine design sensibility — you can look at an interface and know what's wrong with it, and you're comfortable making design decisions in the absence of a dedicated designer.
  • Rigorous test-driven development discipline — tests come with the code, not after.
  • Proficiency with React Testing Library, Jest or Vitest, and Playwright or Cypress.
  • Solid WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility knowledge — designed and built in from the start.
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding and design tools as a genuine productivity multiplier, not a curiosity.
  • Based in the United States, with willingness to travel occasionally for team and customer meetings.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building scheduling, calendar, or real-time availability interfaces.
  • Background in financial services, banking, credit unions, healthcare, or retail technology.
  • Figma proficiency — able to create and maintain a component library and design tokens, not just consume them.
  • Experience with Storybook for component documentation and testing.
  • Micro Frontend architecture or module federation experience for managing multi-app front-end ecosystems.
  • Depth in kiosk or large-format touch UX — the constraints are different from a browser tab and most candidates haven't been there.

Our Stack

Knowing our stack is not a requirement, but this is what you'll be working with:

  • Frontend (current): Angular (multiple versions) — the estate you'll be migrating from
  • Frontend (target): React with TypeScript — the standard for all new and migrated applications
  • Design: Figma, Storybook; AI design tooling (v0, Figma AI)
  • API layer: Spring Boot (Java 17) and Scala/Akka services over REST
  • Testing: React Testing Library, Jest / Vitest, Playwright / Cypress
  • Data: SQL Server and PostgreSQL
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes on AWS
  • AI: Claude models (Anthropic), with MCP-based agent tooling

jobs.excerpt: About UsIn partnership with Sony and SBI — two of Japan's largest companies — we are building the infrastructure to bring the world's assets on-chain: Strium, a next-generation DeFi L1 powered by a fully on-chain orderbook exchange, and Startale App, a consumer super-app.
jobs.description:
About Us

In partnership with Sony and SBI — two of Japan's largest companies — we are building the infrastructure to bring the world's assets on-chain: Strium, a next-generation DeFi L1 powered by a fully on-chain orderbook exchange, and Startale App, a consumer super-app. Distributed across Tokyo, New York, and Singapore; English-operating; built to a world-class standard.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to take ownership of the backend systems powering StartaleApp and other products across the Startale ecosystem.

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role for someone who can own complex backend systems end-to-end - from designing APIs and backend services, to building scalable data pipelines, managing databases, integrating blockchain infrastructure, and operating production systems under real-world load.

We are looking for an engineer who thrives in a startup environment and is comfortable taking responsibility for any part of the backend stack depending on what the product needs. One month you may be building user-facing APIs, another month designing blockchain indexers, optimizing database performance, improving system reliability, or architecting entirely new backend services from scratch.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone who has previously built and operated large-scale production systems serving real users at meaningful scale. You should have firsthand experience designing systems that handle high traffic, large datasets, reliability challenges, and the operational complexity that comes with running critical backend infrastructure in production.

You should be excited by solving difficult engineering problems, building systems that scale, and owning critical infrastructure with a high degree of autonomy.

You will work closely with product, infrastructure, and protocol teams to build reliable systems that power seamless user experiences across both traditional and blockchain-based applications.

Because our core product is a Web3 wallet, we highly value engineers who understand how decentralized applications work in practice — not just at the protocol level, but also from the perspective of real-world user interactions with wallets, DeFi protocols, and blockchain-based financial systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of backend architecture and implementation across multiple products within the Startale ecosystem.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable production APIs and backend services used by customer-facing applications.
  • Build and operate high-performance distributed systems capable of serving large user bases and handling significant production traffic reliably.
  • Design backend systems with strong focus on scalability, fault tolerance, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Build and maintain data pipelines, background workers, asynchronous processing systems, and event-driven architectures.
  • Build and maintain blockchain integrations and indexing systems that ingest, process, and serve on-chain data to internal services and user-facing applications.
  • Design efficient database schemas, optimize complex queries, and ensure long-term scalability of data storage systems.
  • Work across both Web2 and Web3 backend infrastructure, integrating traditional backend systems with blockchain protocols and decentralized infrastructure.
  • Diagnose and solve complex production issues, performance bottlenecks, reliability problems, and scaling challenges.
  • Build systems with strong observability, monitoring, alerting, and operational tooling.
  • Continuously improve backend architecture, deployment pipelines, system reliability, and engineering practices.
  • Move quickly, make sound technical decisions independently, and take ownership of delivering production-ready systems.

Requirements

Core Backend Engineering

  • Extensive experience building and operating production backend systems in modern engineering environments.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and modern backend frameworks (NestJS, Fastify, Express, or similar).
  • Strong understanding of backend architecture, API design, service-oriented architecture, and distributed systems design.
  • Ability to independently design and deliver complex backend systems with minimal oversight.

Large-Scale Systems Experience

  • Proven track record building and operating backend systems serving large numbers of users in production environments.
  • Experience designing systems that operate reliably under high traffic, heavy workloads, and demanding production conditions.
  • Strong understanding of performance optimization, scalability bottlenecks, concurrency, fault tolerance, and infrastructure reliability.
  • Experience operating systems where uptime, consistency, and reliability directly impact end users.
  • Strong operational mindset and experience handling production incidents and scaling challenges in live systems.

Data & Infrastructure

  • Deep expertise with PostgreSQL, including schema design, indexing, query optimization, migrations, and production database management.
  • Experience building systems that process large amounts of structured or event-driven data.
  • Strong understanding of observability, logging, monitoring, and service health management.

Web2 + Web3 Engineering

  • Experience building backend systems for modern Web2 applications.
  • Experience integrating with blockchain infrastructure, node APIs, smart contracts, or decentralized protocols.
  • Familiarity with blockchain indexing systems, event processing pipelines, or other on-chain data infrastructure.
  • Good understanding of wallet architecture, transaction lifecycle, signing flows, and blockchain data models.
  • Familiarity with DeFi protocols and blockchain-based financial applications, either as a developer or an advanced user.

Strong Plus

  • Experience building backend services in Go.
  • Experience with Kafka, NATS, RabbitMQ, or similar messaging systems.
  • Experience with blockchain indexing frameworks such as The Graph, Subsquid, or custom indexers.
  • Experience deploying and operating services using Docker and modern CI/CD pipelines.
  • Contributions to open-source backend, infrastructure, or blockchain tooling projects.
  • Strong understanding of the DeFi ecosystem and hands-on familiarity with products such as decentralized exchanges, lending protocols, staking systems, bridges, or other on-chain financial infrastructure.
  • Experience building or integrating backend systems that interact with DeFi protocols.

What We Value

We care less about specific technologies and more about engineers who can:

  • Take ownership of complex technical problems from design to production.
  • Work comfortably across different parts of the backend stack depending on what the product needs.
  • Build systems that reliably serve large numbers of users and continue operating under scale and production pressure.
  • Make pragmatic engineering decisions in fast-moving startup environments.
  • Learn unfamiliar technologies quickly and adapt to changing product requirements.

Why Join Us

  • Build the core infrastructure powering StartaleApp and the broader Startale ecosystem.
  • Work on technically challenging problems spanning backend engineering, distributed systems, and Web3 infrastructure.
  • Join a highly technical startup environment where engineers have significant ownership and direct product impact.
  • Work alongside world-class engineers building ambitious next-generation infrastructure.
  • Competitive compensation, ownership opportunities, and a direct role in shaping the future of Web3 products.

Hello! We're Teya.

Teya is a payment and software service provider, headquartered in London serving small, local businesses across Europe. Founded in 2019, we build easy to use, integrated tools that enable our members to accept payments and boost business performance.

At Teya we believe small, local businesses are the lifeblood of our communities.

We’re here because we don’t believe there’s a level playing field that gives small businesses with a fighting chance against the giants of the high street.

We’re here because we see banks and legacy service providers making things harder for them. We don’t think the best technology or the best service should be reserved for those with the biggest headquarters.

We’re here to fight for a future where small, local businesses can thrive, and to commit the same dedication they offer all of us.

Become a part of our story.

We’re looking for exceptional talent to join our mission. We offer a chance to create impact in a high-energy and connected culture, while benefiting from continuous learning opportunities, a supportive community which is proud to serve our mission, and comprehensive benefits.

Role description

We are seeking a highly skilled and passionate Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our ePOS Integration team, with a specialised focus on building and scaling the frontend experience for our product and enhancing its supporting backend services:

In this pivotal role, you'll design, develop, and maintain the partner developer web portal that empowers our integration partners and third-party developers to manage accounts, spin up sandbox environments, complete integration certifications, access development support, and navigate our API documentation. As a full-stack engineer, you'll work across the frontend and contribute to the backend services that power the portal. Your work will directly shape how partners build on top of our platform, from their first sandbox call to production go-live.

You'll be joining an exciting remake of the product, meaning you'll have a foundational role in defining the web experience for partner developers from near the ground up. You'll translate complex integration and certification workflows into intuitive, secure, and high-performance developer interfaces, while supporting the backend services behind them, collaborating closely alongside product managers, UX/UI designers, backend engineers, and platform teams. Your expertise will be instrumental in delivering a developer experience that makes integrating with us fast, clear, and reliable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable, responsive full stack features for the Business Account portal using React, TypeScript, and GraphQL, with ownership spanning both frontend implementation and integration with backend services.

  • Work closely with product and design teams to understand merchant needs and translate complex financial workflows—such as transfers, scheduled payments, account management, and Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) flows—into secure, end-to-end user experiences backed by reliable APIs.

  • Build and maintain data-rich, high-performance interfaces for transaction feeds, balances, statements, and multi-currency views, ensuring efficient data fetching, state management, and seamless interaction with backend services.

  • Develop and maintain GraphQL schemas, resolvers, and API integrations, ensuring consistency between frontend requirements and backend data models while promoting type safety and end-to-end reliability.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code across the stack, applying strong TypeScript practices and contributing to overall system stability, security, and scalability.

  • Actively participate in code reviews across frontend and backend contributions, helping establish engineering best practices in a team transitioning from a mobile-first to a full stack, web-capable organization.

  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, data inefficiencies, and production issues across the full stack, ensuring a smooth, reliable experience for merchant users.

  • Stay up-to-date with the latest frontend technologies, trends, and best practices, applying them to enhance our merchant-facing web platform.

Your Story

  • 5+ years of professional experience in frontend/web development.

  • Expert-level proficiency in TypeScript, including advanced type manipulation, generics, and understanding of complex type inference.

  • Strong proficiency in React.js and its core principles, developed with a type-safe approach.

  • Experience supporting Backend services in Java and Spring Boot

  • Extensive experience with Next.js for server-side rendering, static site generation, and API routes, with a focus on TypeScript integration.

  • Solid understanding of modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3.

  • Experience with state management libraries (e.g., Redux, Context API, Zustand) in a TypeScript environment.

  • Strong experience consuming GraphQL APIs (e.g., Apollo Client), with an understanding of how to define and use types for API responses.

  • Strong understanding of web performance optimisation techniques.

  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git).

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • Strong communication and collaboration abilities, especially when working within cross-functional teams spanning product, design, backend, and mobile engineering.

Optional Tech Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Proficiency with UI component libraries such as Chakra UI or Material UI, with experience leveraging their TypeScript definitions.

  • Experience with RESTful API integration.

  • Familiarity with internationalisation (i18n) frameworks for multi-language, multi-market web applications.

Differentiators (What Sets You Apart)

  • Experience in fintech or banking web applications, including secure and compliant interfaces with SCA/2FA, PSD2, and RBAC

  • Proven ability to build and translate mobile-first products into responsive web experiences

  • Practical use of AI coding tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate development while maintaining code quality

  • Experience launching and localising web products across multiple European markets, including currency, regulatory, and language requirements

jobs.title: 시니어 소프트웨어 엔지니어, JavaScript/TypeScript (Senior Software Engineer)
jobs.excerpt: 회사 소개Bjak은 ASEAN 지역 사람들에게 저렴하고 지속 가능한 금융 서비스에 대한 접근을 제공하는 데 집중하고 있습니다.
jobs.description:
회사 소개

Bjak은 ASEAN 지역 사람들에게 저렴하고 지속 가능한 금융 서비스에 대한 접근을 제공하는 데 집중하고 있습니다. 본사는 말레이시아에 있으며, Bjak은 동남아시아 최대의 보험 포털입니다. 주요 플랫폼인 Bjak.com은 수백만 명의 사람들이 최고의 가성비와 보장 범위를 갖춘 보험 상품을 찾을 수 있도록 돕고 있습니다.

Custom API, 트레이딩 시스템, 데이터 사이언스 등 다양한 기술에 투자함으로써, 기존에는 접근이 어려웠거나 이해하기 힘들었던 금융 서비스를 보다 쉽게 사용할 수 있도록 만들고 있습니다. Bjak은 말레이시아 내 사업 확장을 이어가며, 이 여정에 함께할 역동적인 인재를 찾고 있습니다. 우리의 비전을 공유하고 Bjak의 다음 성공 챕터에 기여하고 싶은 분들의 많은 지원을 기다립니다.

주요 업무

  • NodeJS를 사용하여 고품질의 백엔드 시스템을 개발하고, 코딩 베스트 프랙티스를 준수

  • ReactJS 및 NextJS를 사용하여 고품질의 프론트엔드 애플리케이션 개발

  • 운영 환경의 안정성을 확보하고, 중요한 문제를 신속하게 해결하여 비즈니스 영향을 최소화

  • 기존 코드 분석을 통해 개선 및 최적화 기회 발굴

  • 크로스펑셔널 팀의 변경 요청을 효율적으로 처리하여 협업 지원

  • 주니어 개발자를 멘토링하며, 소프트웨어 개발 베스트 프랙티스를 전수

  • 동료의 코드 리뷰를 통해 코드 품질과 일관성을 유지

자격 요건

  • 컴퓨터공학, 소프트웨어 엔지니어링, 정보기술 등 관련 전공의 학사 학위

  • 알고리즘 및 자료구조에 대한 탄탄한 기초

  • 소프트웨어 엔지니어링 경력 3년 이상

  • NodeJS, NestJS, ExpressJS, GraphQL, Postman 등 백엔드 개발 기술 숙련

  • ReactJS, NextJS, Styled-components 등 프론트엔드 개발 기술 숙련

  • MongoDB, MySQL 등 데이터베이스 관리 경험

  • Selenium, Cypress, Puppeteer 등 자동화 도구에 대한 이해

  • 스스로 문제를 해결하고, 프로그래밍에 대한 열정을 갖춘 분

우대 사항

  • 관련 프로젝트 포트폴리오 보유 시 우대

  • GCP 또는 AWS 클라우드 서비스 및 Infrastructure as Code 실무 경험

  • UI/UX 디자인 경험

  • 테스트 주도 개발(TDD), 행동 주도 개발(BDD)에 대한 이해

  • Pug, Slim 등 웹 템플릿 언어 경험

  • 기술 문서 작성 경험

복지 혜택

  • 완전 원격 근무: 언제 어디서든 자유롭게 일할 수 있는 환경

  • 혁신적인 과제: 빠르게 변화하고 도전적인 고유의 비즈니스 문제를 해결

  • 커리어 성장: 학습과 성장 기회를 제공하는 체계적인 개발 계획

  • 글로벌 환경: 수평적 조직 구조의 국제적인 업무 환경

  • 경쟁력 있는 급여: 업계 수준 이상의 보상 패키지 제공

Bjak is focused on providing access to affordable and sustainable financial services for people in ASEAN. Headquartered in Malaysia, Bjak is the largest insurance portal in Southeast Asia. Our main portal, Bjak.com, helps millions find the insurance policy with the best value and highest coverage for them. Our investments in technology such as Custom API, trading systems and data science is to enable easy access to financial services that were previously inaccessible or difficult to understand. Join us on this exciting journey as we expand our operations in Malaysia. We're looking for dynamic individuals who share our vision and want to contribute to the next chapter of Bjak's success.

Responsibilities

  • Develop high-quality backend systems using NodeJS, adhering to best coding practices.

  • Develop high-quality frontend applications using ReactJS / NextJS, adhering to best coding practices.

  • Ensure production stability and promptly resolve critical issues to minimize operational impact.

  • Analyze existing code and identify opportunities for enhancement and optimization.

  • Support cross-functional teams by addressing change requests efficiently.

  • Mentor and guide junior developers on best practices in software development.

  • Review peer pull requests to maintain code quality and consistency.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, with a strong foundation in algorithms and data structures.

  • Over 3 years of full-time experience in software engineering.

  • Proficient in backend development technologies such as NodeJS, NestJS, ExpressJS, GraphQL, and Postman.

  • Proficient in frontend development technologies such as ReactJS, NextJS, and Styled-components.

  • Experienced in database management, including MongoDB and MySQL.

  • Familiar with automation workflows using tools like Selenium, Cypress, and Puppeteer.

  • Demonstrated passion for programming and problem-solving independently.

Bonus Points

  • A portfolio of relevant projects is highly advantageous.

  • Experience with GCP or AWS cloud services and Infrastructure as Code practices.

  • Experience in UI/UX design.

  • Familiarity with Test-Driven Development (TDD) or Behavior-Driven Development (BDD).

  • Experience with web templating languages such as Pug or Slim.

  • Experience in technical documentation is a plus.

Benefits:

  • Fully Remote Role: Work from anywhere and enjoy the freedom of a fully remote position.

  • Innovative Challenges: Work on fast-moving, challenging, and unique business problems.

  • Career Growth: Benefit from strong learning and development plans for your career growth.

  • Global Environment: Thrive in an international work environment with a flat organizational structure.

  • Competitive Salary: Receive a competitive salary package.

jobs.description:
Bjakについて

Bjakは、ASEAN地域の人々に手頃で持続可能な金融サービスへのアクセスを提供することに注力しています。本社はマレーシアにあり、Bjakは東南アジア最大の保険ポータルです。主力サイト「Bjak.com」は、何百万人ものユーザーが最適な価格で最高水準の補償を受けられる保険商品を見つけることを支援しています。Custom API、取引システム、データサイエンスなどのテクノロジーへ積極的に投資し、これまで利用が難しかった金融サービスを誰でも簡単に利用できるようにしています。

マレーシアでの事業拡大に伴い、私たちのビジョンを共有し、Bjakの次章を共に築く情熱的な人材を募集しています。

職務内容

  • NodeJSを用いた高品質なバックエンドシステムの開発（ベストプラクティスの遵守）

  • ReactJS／NextJSを用いた高品質なフロントエンドアプリケーションの開発（ベストプラクティスの遵守）

  • 本番環境の安定性を確保し、重大な問題を迅速に解決して業務への影響を最小化

  • 既存コードを分析し、改善・最適化の機会を特定

  • 変更要求に効率良く対応し、クロスファンクショナルチームを支援

  • ジュニア開発者へのメンター・指導を通じてベストプラクティスを浸透

  • ピアのプルリクエストをレビューし、コード品質と一貫性を維持

応募資格

  • コンピュータサイエンス、ソフトウェアエンジニアリング、ITまたは関連分野の学士号（アルゴリズムとデータ構造の確かな基礎を有すること）

  • ソフトウェアエンジニアとして3年以上の実務経験

  • NodeJS、NestJS、ExpressJS、GraphQL、Postmanなどのバックエンド開発技術に精通

  • ReactJS、NextJS、Styled-componentsなどのフロントエンド開発技術に精通

  • MongoDBおよびMySQLなどのデータベース管理経験

  • Selenium、Cypress、Puppeteerなどを用いた自動化ワークフローに関する知識

  • 自主的にプログラミングし、課題を解決する情熱

  • GCP／AWSなどのクラウドサービスおよびIaC（Infrastructure as Code）の実践経験

Fullstack Engineer (m/f/d)

Berlin, Bangalore, Remote

Hello 👋 I am Servesh, Co- founder and CTO at Kayzen, and I am now looking for a Fullstack Engineer to join our Console team. 🙌 But wait, you have not heard of Kayzen before? 😃

Kayzen is a mobile demand-side platform (DSP) dedicated to democratizing programmatic advertising. We enable leading apps, agencies, media buyers, and brands to run programmatic customer acquisition, retargeting, and brand performance campaigns through its self-serve and managed service options. Built on the three core pillars of performance, transparency, and control, Kayzen powers the world’s best mobile marketing teams with bespoke solutions that fuel business growth and deliver a competitive advantage. With an unprecedented scale of 160B+ daily ad requests from 1.6B+ unique users worldwide, we serve up to 1B+ ads per day in 180 countries. Kayzen is accessible through our APIs and user interface.

The Team

The Console team owns the user-facing applications and interfaces that power the Kayzen platform — from our self-serve campaign management dashboard and real-time reporting suite to internal tooling used by our managed service teams. We work closely with product managers, designers, backend engineers, and data teams to deliver seamless, high-performance experiences. We are responsible for some of the most impactful work at Kayzen, including:

  • “The Console” which is the face of Kayzen we are very proud of.
  • Complex features which surface a lot of backend infrastructure via console
  • Almost 100% uptime with very well planned & executed project management

Sounds interesting. Isn’t it?

About the Role

We are looking for a coding-first Fullstack Engineer who thrives on turning complex product requirements into high-performance UIs. You should be comfortable working across the stack, contributing to architecture discussions, and be an early adopter of AI-assisted engineering (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) in your daily coding workflow. This role is a strong individual contributor position with room to grow into deeper technical ownership over time.

Responsibilities

    • Design, build, and maintain high-quality features across the Fullstack stack, from UI to API integration

  • Project & Execution Management

    • Deliver work reliably within sprint commitments, flagging blockers or scope changes early

Requirements

Fullstack Technical Excellence (Core Focus)

  • 5+ years of professional Fullstack development experience with modern JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Solid expertise in at least one major framework (React, Angular, or Vue) and its ecosystem
  • Strong understanding of HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, and cross-browser compatibility
  • Experience building data-heavy UIs, ideally including real-time data visualization
  • Good grasp of Fullstack performance optimization, including bundle size, rendering, lazy loading, and caching strategies
  • Experience with state management patterns (Redux, MobX, Zustand, or similar)

Less About

Nice to Have

jobs.description:
Vaga 100% remota

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo

Sensedia é uma multinacional brasileira provedora de plataforma de gerenciamento de APIs, governança de agentes e soluções de integração, além de serviços profissionais. A companhia impulsiona a transformação digital de grandes empresas habilitando arquiteturas mais ágeis, modernas e escaláveis, possibilitando assim que seus clientes ofereçam produtos e experiências digitais a todo o seu ecossistema.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.
Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Conheça + em nosso site:


Qual a missão do Cargo?

Projetar, automatizar, implantar e operar ambientes de software de alta disponibilidade, utilizando práticas modernas de DevOps, Cloud e Infraestrutura como Código, promovendo a cultura de automação, observabilidade, segurança e entrega contínua, garantindo a estabilidade das soluções e o sucesso das implementações nos clientes.

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Provisionar e manter infraestrutura em AWS utilizando Terraform e Terragrunt.
  • Criar e manter automações utilizando Ansible, Shell Script e PowerShell.
  • Criar, manter e melhorar pipelines de CI/CD, automatizando build, testes, deploy e rollback.
  • Criar e manter imagens e containers utilizando Docker.
  • Realizar deploy, configuração, atualização e troubleshooting de aplicações em Kubernetes.
  • Administrar e realizar troubleshooting em servidores Linux e Windows Server.
  • Configurar e manter servidores web e de aplicação, como Nginx, Apache, Tomcat e JBoss.
  • Monitorar ambientes e aplicações por meio de logs, métricas, dashboards e alertas.
  • Atuar na análise e resolução de incidentes e problemas em produção.
  • Apoiar a operação e troubleshooting de bancos de dados como PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, MongoDB, Redis e AWS RDS.
  • Apoiar os times de desenvolvimento na implantação e sustentação de APIs e microsserviços.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de segurança e DevSecOps em infraestrutura, containers e pipelines.
  • Realizar configurações e troubleshooting relacionados a redes, DNS, balanceadores e conectividade.
  • Acompanhar disponibilidade, desempenho e consumo de recursos dos ambientes.
  • Automatizar atividades operacionais e processos manuais recorrentes.
  • Executar mudanças e deploys nos ambientes de desenvolvimento, homologação e produção.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica e procedimentos operacionais.
  • Participar das cerimônias ágeis e colaborar com os times de Desenvolvimento, Operações e Arquitetura.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua, automação e padronização dos ambientes.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

  • AWS: Experiência sólida e prática com AWS, incluindo provisionamento de infraestrutura, configuração de serviços, redes, escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade.
  • Containers e Orquestração: Experiência prática com Docker e Kubernetes, incluindo criação de imagens, publicação de containers, gerenciamento de clusters, escalabilidade e atualizações sem indisponibilidade.
  • Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Experiência com Terraform, Terragrunt, Ansible e Shell Script, incluindo automação e versionamento da infraestrutura.
  • CI/CD: Experiência com ferramentas como Jenkins, GitHub, Bitbucket, CodeDeploy, Git e SVN, além da criação de pipelines e automação de builds, testes, deploys e rollbacks.
  • Administração de Sistemas: Conhecimento em Linux (Ubuntu, CentOS e RHEL) e Windows Server, incluindo administração, troubleshooting, hardening e automação com Shell/PowerShell.
  • Servidores Web e de Aplicação: Experiência com Nginx, Apache, Tomcat e JBoss.
  • Bancos de Dados: Conhecimento em MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Oracle, PostgreSQL e AWS RDS.
  • Observabilidade: Conhecimento em Elasticsearch, Kafka, monitoramento, logs, métricas e alertas.
  • APIs e Microsserviços: Conhecimento em APIs REST, serviços web e arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Experiência com Scrum, Kanban, Lean e Agile.
  • Cultura DevOps: Conhecimento sólido em Integração Contínua (CI), Entrega Contínua (CD), IaC, automação, observabilidade, versionamento e melhoria contínua.

Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?

  • Linguagens de Programação (Preferencialmente Python, Node);
  • Inglês Intermediário;
  • Conhecimento Segurança e Redes

Aqui você vai encontrar:

  • Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (Cartão Flash benefícios), Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, PPR, TotalPass, Auxílio Creche, Programa Well-Being (destinado para saúde física e mental), Universidade Corporativa (nossa #SensediaAcademy), com diversas trilhas de desenvolvimento; Parceiros culturais e educacionais, com descontos especiais; Somos uma empresa cidadã, proporcionando licença maternidade e licença paternidade estendida.

    Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores, e o sentimento é de que exista apenas uma Sensedia em qualquer lugar que você esteja trabalhando.

Esta oportunidade também é para PCD! ;)

Suas experiências são compatíveis? Se candidate e venha conhecer a maior referência de APIs no Brasil! Queremos você em nossa equipe!!

About DocuSketch:
DocuSketch, with its European Headquarters in Potsdam, Germany, is a leading European software technology provider for the digital real estate economy. With our product brands Immoviewer and DocuSketch, we have become one of the most successful and fastest-growing software vendors in the rapidly expanding property tech sector. Our enthusiastic customer base is located across Europe and North America. DocuSketch's groundbreaking digital technology greatly facilitates real estate companies and building restoration companies to digitize, visualize, and virtualize real estate properties. Our solutions help our clients realize tremendous cost-saving potentials, process optimization, and revenue growth.
You’ll be working in a team that drives the company's AI development to develop algorithms for a variety of different use cases. This includes e.g. working with equirectangular, phone, or satellite images to detect doors, windows, or other objects inside of buildings or finding facets on the roof. You’ll be challenged by solving complex 3D geometry problems and working closely with our labeling team to ensure the best possible data quality.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build and operate the platform that enables our engineering teams to ship safely, quickly, and reliably.
You will lead complex infrastructure and delivery initiatives across teams, improve platform scalability, reliability, and security, and help shape our long-term approach to cloud operations, deployment, observability, and automation.
This role combines strong hands-on engineering with technical leadership, operational ownership, and close collaboration with Engineering, Security, IT, and Product.

  • Lead complex infrastructure and delivery initiatives across teams and environments.

  • Design and operate scalable, secure, and cost-efficient cloud platforms.
  • Work with Infrastructure-as-Code, Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD, and automation frameworks.
  • Improve monitoring, alerting, tracing, SLOs, disaster recovery, and incident-management practices.
  • Lead root-cause analysis and drive sustainable post-incident improvements.
  • Build security and compliance into infrastructure and delivery processes, including least-privilege access, identity federation and OIDC, short-lived credentials, secrets management and rotation, auditability, certificate management, supply-chain security, and policy-as-code.
  • Implement automated testing, linting, validation, and rollback processes for infrastructure and delivery pipelines.
  • Use AI agents responsibly to improve infrastructure design, automation, incident analysis, and operational workflows while applying strong engineering judgement and quality guardrails.
  • Act as a technical partner to Engineering, Product, Security, and IT leadership.
  • Mentor engineers, improve documentation and standards, and contribute to the long-term direction of DevOps practices.

  • Ability to use AI tools effectively to deliver fast results and create reliable, repeatable workflows that improve the reliability and stability of systems.

  • Hands-on experience with Terraform, Helm, GitHub Actions, and GitOps tools such as Argo CD.
  • Experience with production observability, including metrics, logs, traces, alerting, and platforms such as SigNoz.
  • Experience designing reliable systems and improving operational readiness, observability, and incident response.
  • Understanding of infrastructure security, compliance, identity, access management, and supply-chain security.
  • Experience creating automated testing, linting, validation, and rollback mechanisms for infrastructure or delivery pipelines.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to lead root-cause analysis for complex incidents.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Professional fluency in English.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with cost governance and cloud-financial management.
  • Experience with SLOs, error budgets, disaster recovery, and reliability engineering.
  • Experience with policy-as-code and automated security scanning.
  • Strong scripting or programming experience, for example Python, Go, or Bash.
  • Experience introducing AI-assisted engineering workflows with appropriate safeguards.
  • Experience supporting AI-platform or hybrid-cloud workloads, including GPU scheduling or cluster operations with tools such as Karpenter, Cilium, or KubeRay.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or contributing to organisation-wide technical standards.
We are seeking a performance-driven, high-energy personality who has several years of experience in the field. jobs.excerpt: Who We ArePindrop is the Real Human + Right Human® Identity Trust Platform for the AI era.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Pindrop is the Real Human + Right Human® Identity Trust Platform for the AI era. As AI-driven fraud and deepfakes erode trust in digital communication, Pindrop delivers continuous identity verification and deepfake detection across voice, video, and digital interactions in real time.

Enterprises rely on Pindrop to secure billions of high-risk customer interactions each year, including top U.S. banks, as well as leading insurers and healthcare providers. Powered by models trained on more than 1.5 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents, Pindrop restores trust while reducing fraud, lowering operational costs, and improving customer experience.

Recognized by TIME as one of the Top 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

What you’ll do

As Senior Manager, DevOps & Platform Engineering, you will lead the strategy, execution, and evolution of the teams and systems that help Pindrop build, deploy, and operate reliable SaaS products at scale.

You will own the DevOps and platform engineering roadmap across developer tooling, internal platforms, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, release workflows, environment management, observability, and cloud operations. Your work will improve developer experience, accelerate the path from code commit to production, strengthen reliability, and increase operational efficiency across the engineering organization.

This role is both strategic and hands-on. You will lead a high-performing team, establish scalable engineering practices, partner across Engineering, SRE, Security, and Product, and remain technically credible in architecture and execution.

  • Define and execute the DevOps and platform engineering strategy, roadmap, operating model, and success metrics.
  • Lead the development of internal platforms, self-service infrastructure, golden paths, and developer tooling that improve engineering productivity and delivery safety.
  • Own CI/CD systems, infrastructure as code, release workflows, environment management, and deployment automation across the organization.
  • Partner with Engineering, SRE, Security, and Product to establish clear service ownership, platform standards, reliability objectives, and scalable developer workflows.
  • Build resilient multi-cloud practices across AWS and GCP, including Kubernetes-based delivery, infrastructure automation, and operational tooling.
  • Improve observability, alert quality, uptime discipline, incident response, and root-cause analysis for critical systems.
  • Lead cloud cost, capacity, and performance optimization as Pindrop’s platform scales.
  • Remove production and delivery bottlenecks by improving platform capabilities, automation, and engineering operating rhythms.
  • Develop team capabilities, set clear priorities, manage project plans, and create a high-accountability culture that scales with company needs.
  • Evaluate and responsibly adopt AI-assisted engineering and operations tools that improve documentation, troubleshooting, monitoring, and team productivity.
  • Establish appropriate governance, security, and compliance practices for AI-enabled infrastructure and operational workflows.

Who you are

  • A platform-minded engineering leader: You understand how internal platforms, developer experience, reliability, and operational excellence work together to improve product delivery.
  • Technically credible: You can move fluidly between strategy, cloud architecture, platform design, and day-to-day execution.
  • A people leader: You build strong teams, coach managers and engineers, clarify ownership, and create an environment of accountability and growth.
  • An influential communicator: You align priorities, influence stakeholders, and translate complex infrastructure and platform needs into clear business outcomes.
  • Resilient and pragmatic: You exercise sound judgment in ambiguity, shifting priorities, and high-stakes production incidents.
  • A continuous improver: You look for practical ways to reduce toil, improve developer experience, strengthen reliability, and increase delivery velocity.

Your skill-set

Must-haves:

  • 6+ years of experience leading teams in DevOps, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, or SRE, with direct accountability for team performance and delivery.
  • Proven experience designing, building, and operating internal developer platforms, self-service tooling, Kubernetes platforms, CI/CD systems, and infrastructure as code.
  • Strong experience operating large-scale SaaS platforms in AWS, GCP, or comparable cloud environments, with a solid understanding of distributed systems.
  • Practical experience with Terraform or similar infrastructure-as-code tools, scripting in Python or Go, observability platforms, incident management, and production operations.
  • Experience establishing platform standards, service ownership models, reliability practices, and developer-facing workflows across multiple engineering teams.
  • A track record of improving measurable outcomes such as deployment lead time, release safety, uptime, incident resolution, developer productivity, or cloud cost efficiency.
  • Hands-on experience evaluating and adopting AI-assisted engineering or operational tools with appropriate human oversight and quality controls.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice-to-haves:

  • A strong foundational background as a DevOps, platform, infrastructure, SRE, or software engineer before moving into leadership.
  • Experience supporting live migrations or cloud transformation initiatives across AWS and GCP.
  • Experience building platforms for machine learning, data-intensive, security, or other high-scale products.
  • Experience navigating fast-paced, high-growth SaaS environments or startups where speed and scale intersect.
  • Experience with developer portals, platform-as-a-product practices, golden paths, internal APIs, or service catalogs.

What’s in it for you

This is a high-impact opportunity to shape how Pindrop scales and operates its cloud platform, offering direct influence over engineering productivity, release velocity, platform reliability, and cost efficiency. In an era where synthetic media, deepfakes, and identity manipulation are accelerating, our work directly protects financial institutions, enterprises, and consumers from fraud. You will wake up every day knowing your work has a tangible, real-world impact.

You will work alongside some of the best technical minds in security, AI, and voice intelligence. If you want to build something that matters—and have strong strategic visibility and organizational influence while doing it—this is that opportunity.

What Success Looks Like

  • Engineering teams can provision infrastructure, deploy services, and access operational information through reliable self-service workflows.
  • Developers experience a shorter, safer, and more predictable path from code commit to production.
  • Critical services have clear ownership, meaningful reliability objectives, actionable observability, and effective incident practices.
  • The organization improves delivery velocity and operational efficiency without compromising security or reliability.
  • Cloud capacity and spend are actively managed using clear data, forecasts, and tradeoffs.
  • The DevOps and platform engineering teams have a clear roadmap, strong operating cadence, and measurable impact.

What we offer

As a part of Pindrop, you’ll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here’s a snapshot of the benefits we offer:

  • Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long-term success.

AI - A Transformative Force

At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.

Besides a competitive salary package, you can be part of a friendly, innovative, and open-minded team.

We are seeking an experienced Python Software Architect to design, build, and continuously enhance complex enterprise-grade applications, data-intensive services, and automation platforms. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on delivering robust, secure, and high-performance Python systems that operate reliably within distributed and mission-critical production environments. The ideal candidate will bring deep Python expertise combined with strong fundamentals in software architecture, data engineering, and operational support, and will partner closely with product, data, and infrastructure teams to translate ambiguous business problems into well-engineered technical solutions. You will be expected to think beyond surface-level fixes, identify root causes of complex issues, and proactively raise the engineering bar across the team.

  • Provide end-to-end design, development, and advanced technical troubleshooting for complex enterprise-grade Python applications, reaching beyond routine approaches to solve novel and non-trivial technical problems.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Strong experience building and maintaining large-scale production applications with significant uptime and reliability requirements.
  • Hands-on experience with relational database systems such as Oracle, MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or Sybase, including query tuning and schema design.
  • Strong understanding of the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements, design, build, test, release, and ongoing support.
  • Proven hands-on experience across system design, application development, automated testing, and operational support.
  • Strong working knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and computational efficiency, with the ability to make sound design trade-offs.
  • Demonstrated experience debugging and maintaining complex, enterprise-level applications in production.
  • Solid understanding of Agile methodologies, CI/CD practices, application resiliency patterns, and secure coding standards.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in dynamic, fast-changing environments while keeping stakeholders well informed.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience collaborating with both technical and business teams.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Strong shell scripting skills in UNIX/Linux environments and comfort working with command-line tooling.
  • Solid grounding in mathematical and statistical concepts and the ability to translate them into code.
  • Hands-on experience with the Python data and ML ecosystem, including NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, and PyTorch.
  • Working exposure to AWS cloud services and cloud-native storage technologies such as S3, RDS, DynamoDB, and Glue.

jobs.title: Senior Python Engineer - AI Coding Agent Evaluation (Freelance)
jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.What this opportunity involves:
We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 8+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paidEffort estimate

Tasks for this project are estimated to take 30 hours to complete, depending on complexity. This is an estimate and not a schedule requirement; you choose when and how to work. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation:
Up to $150/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~30 hours each; you set your own schedule.

jobs.description:
About Abalone Bio

Abalone Bio is a biotech company pioneering the discovery and design of functionally active antibodies, with an initial focus on G-protein coupled receptors (GPCRs). We overcome the major challenge of discovering rare GPCR agonist antibodies by using our proprietary Functional Antibody Selection Technology (FAST), a high-throughput, yeast cell-based platform.

Our drug discovery engine is fundamentally differentiated by generating millions of direct antibody sequence-to-function relationships through Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) of functionally active clones. These robust, high-quality functional datasets are orders of magnitude larger than industry standards and serve as the foundation for our cutting-edge AI/ML-driven design capabilities. We utilize sophisticated machine learning models, including Protein Large Language Models (PLLMs) and Reinforcement Learning (RL), to both discover functional activity and design novel, optimized antibody agonists.

We are seeking a talented ML Research Consultant to help us on our mission. You will work closely with our ML team to ideate, implement, and validate the machine learning classifiers and generative models that will ultimately improve our therapeutic design platform, translating functional activity data into breakthrough biologics.

What You Will Do

  • Evaluate Sequence-Function Models: Design, implement, and evaluate state-of-the-art machine learning models, including Protein Large Language Models (PLLMs), to predict functional activity of GPCR agonist antibodies.

  • Implement Generative Models: Design, implement, and evaluate state-of-the-art generative models using Reinforcement Learning or Bayesian Optimization for de novo GPCR agonist antibody design.

  • Experimentation: Design and execute rigorous ML experiments with clear hypotheses and documented outcomes and next steps.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s (5+ years of experience) or Ph. D. degree (2+ years of experience) in Bioinformatics, Biophysics, Computational Biology, or a related quantitative field.

  • Experience solving complex business problems in the life sciences using ML or statistical methods

  • Excellent communication skills particularly in the context of cross-functional life science teams

  • Understanding of modern deep learning architectures and optimization techniques as well as fundamentals of machine learning.

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience developing deep learning models using frameworks like PyTorch.

  • Strong proficiency in python and the scientific computing stack (NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn).

  • Proficiency with software engineering best practices, version control (Git), and testing frameworks.

  • Experience with Transformer architectures, Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), or Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) applied to biological sequence or molecular/structural data.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Theoretical foundations and practical experience with methods in computational structural biology, e.g., protein structure prediction, molecular dynamics, coarse-grained modeling, etc.

  • Experience with high-throughput screening data, particularly NGS analysis, flow cytometry, or other assays that link genotype to phenotype.

  • Direct experience with Protein Large Language Models (PLLMs), generative modeling, and/or Reinforcement Learning (RL) in a protein engineering context.

  • Background in developing models predicting antibody developability characteristics (e.g., stability, aggregation).

  • Background in molecular/cell biology, antibody discovery, bioinformatics.

Rate: 125-250 per hour depending on experience, up to 10 hours / week
